title: Using LMs to Model the Effects of Context and Coreference during Sentence Comprehension
summary: Language models (LMs) are often used as a tool to model human language processing. Recent studies suggest that severely restricting LMs' context window improves their fit to human psycholinguistic data by simulating human working memory constraints. However, it is possible that this strict memory-decay approach overlooks humans' reliance on long-range structural representations, such as discourse structre. In this work, we systematically vary the context window size of GPT-2 across four large-scale naturalistic English reading-time datasets and observe a U-shaped relationship: Although restricted contexts (< 20 tokens) successfully capture local memory limitations, expanded contexts (500--1,000 tokens) ultimately yield the highest overall psycholinguistic fit. To investigate the mechanism driving this benefit, we conduct a counterfactual inference-time experiment that disrupts cross-sentential entity chains by pronominalizing repeated discourse entities. Obscuring these structural linkages significantly degrades the predictive power of larger context windows by 20% to 40%. Our experiments demonstrate that tracking long-range coreference relations is one important factor for the alignment between LM surprisal and human reading behavior, and approximate the extent to which human comprehenders use global discourse relations during language processing.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统改变GPT-2上下文窗口大小，发现其与人类心理语言学数据的拟合呈U形关系，最优表现出现在500–1000 token的扩展上下文，而非严格受限的短窗口；通过代词化破坏跨句实体链的反事实实验表明，长距离指代追踪是模型惊讶度对齐人类阅读行为的重要机制。
AI.motivation: 近期研究认为严格限制语言模型上下文窗口可模拟人类工作记忆约束，从而提升其对心理语言学数据的拟合。但作者质疑这种严格的记忆衰减假设忽视了人类对长距离结构表征（如篇章结构）的依赖，因此需要系统检验上下文窗口大小的影响及其背后的机制。
AI.method: 在四个大规模自然英语阅读时间数据集上系统变化GPT-2的上下文窗口大小；并通过反事实的推理时实验，对重复出现的篇章实体进行代词化处理，以破坏跨句实体链，观察其对预测能力的影响。
AI.result: 上下文窗口大小与心理语言学拟合呈U形关系：受限上下文（<20 token）能捕捉局部记忆限制，但扩展上下文（500–1000 token）总体拟合最佳；代词化破坏跨句实体链后，大上下文窗口的预测能力显著下降20%–40%。
AI.conclusion: 追踪长距离共指关系是语言模型惊讶度与人类阅读行为对齐的重要因素，该结果近似刻画了人类理解者在语言加工中使用全局篇章关系的程度。

title: PACT: Pairwise-Anchored Calibrated Tuning for Single-Token Typed Decisions
summary: Single-token typed-decision models answer a schema question by reading the logits of a few one-letter answer codes at a single position: they are fast and return a probability for every allowed answer, but they are trained with plain cross-entropy that ignores most of the structure in their training data. We study such a model whose data is curated as contrastive pairs---two contexts that differ in one edited fact that flips the answer---each carrying a machine-checked certificate that deleting the decisive sentence makes the fact unknown. We propose PACT, which turns this structure into four training terms that need no new annotation: a difference-in-differences margin over each pair that is invariant to any shared logit offset, a permutation-consistency term against answer-code position bias, an evidence-necessity term on certificate-verified ablated contexts, and an ordinal transport cost for rubric fields, plus a three-parameter contextual temperature. On a frozen 324-item holdout with three seeds, PACT matches the published recipe in accuracy ($84.6\%$ vs. $85.2\%$; McNemar $p \ge 0.50$ at every seed) while giving the lowest position bias of all runs (answer flips under relabelling $9.8\%$ vs. $13.8\%$) and the lowest ordinal error on rubric fields (MAE $0.232$ vs. $0.311$). Against a control with the same optimiser and schedule but cross-entropy only, PACT is significantly more accurate at two of three seeds, halves the seed-to-seed spread and lowers NLL by $26\%$. Seed-matched ablations and pre-specified falsification tests locate these gains precisely: no single term raises raw accuracy, and the method's value lies in robustness and stability rather than headline accuracy. Code, data splits, trained adapters, and all run records are available at https://github.com/BennyLinntu/PACT-Pairwise-Anchored-Calibrated-Tuning-for-Single-Token-Typed-Decisions.

AI.tldr: PACT将对比配对数据中的结构（配对差异、证书验证的证据必要性、答案码位置置换、有序评分）转化为四个无需新增标注的训练项，在单token类型化决策模型上以相当的准确率换取更低的选项位置偏置、更小的有序误差与更强的跨种子稳定性。
AI.motivation: 单token类型化决策模型读取单个位置上几个单字母答案码的logits，速度快且能给出每个允许答案的概率，但其训练仅用普通交叉熵，忽略了训练数据中已有的丰富结构：数据被整理为对比配对（两个上下文仅差一个被编辑的事实且答案翻转），且每条样本带有机器可检验的证书，证明删除决定性句子后该事实变为未知。作者希望在不增加新标注的前提下，把这些结构转化为有效训练信号，以提升鲁棒性与稳定性。
AI.method: 提出PACT，把数据结构转为四个无需新标注的训练项：(1) 每对样本上的双重差分（difference-in-differences）间隔，对任意共享logit偏移不变；(2) 针对答案码位置偏置的置换一致性项；(3) 在证书验证的消融上下文上的证据必要性项；(4) 面向评分字段的有序传输代价；另加一个三参数上下文温度。在冻结的324项留出集、三个随机种子上评估，并与已发布配方、以及使用相同优化器与调度但仅用交叉熵的对照做比较，进行种子匹配消融与预注册证伪检验。
AI.result: 在冻结324项留出集、三个种子上，PACT准确率与已发布配方相当（84.6% vs. 85.2%；每个种子McNemar p ≥ 0.50），但位置偏置最低（重标注下答案翻转9.8% vs. 13.8%），评分字段有序误差最低（MAE 0.232 vs. 0.311）。相比同优化器同调度但仅用交叉熵的对照，PACT在三个种子中的两个上显著更准，将种子间波动减半，并降低NLL 26%。种子匹配消融与预注册证伪检验表明：没有任何单个训练项能提升原始准确率，方法的价值在于鲁棒性与稳定性而非表头准确率。
AI.conclusion: PACT证明，仅靠对比配对、证书验证的消融与有序评分等既有数据结构即可构造无需新标注的训练目标，在不牺牲准确率的情况下显著改善答案码位置偏置、有序评分误差与跨种子稳定性；单一训练项均不提升原始准确率，说明收益来自各项协同带来的鲁棒性而非更高的峰值准确率。代码、数据划分、训练适配器与全部运行记录均已开源。

title: Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; 2-page supplementary material in ancillary files. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing. Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于2D高斯图像表示的隐写方法：将信息嵌入高斯参数而非像素，通过密钥选取子集微调参数，实现8位消息嵌入并保持高视觉保真度。
AI.motivation: 2D高斯图像表示日益流行，为隐写提供了新载体；现有隐写多作用于像素域，本文探索在高斯参数域嵌入信息的可行性与可靠性。
AI.method: 先对目标图像拟合高斯表示参数，再用密钥选择部分参数进行微调，从而嵌入8位消息；载荷通过三类高斯参数（对数各向异性、不透明度、颜色亮度）承载；在256×256自然图像上使用4,096个高斯进行验证，并设置九次拟合的简化配置（移除颜色亮度，参数类型由三类减为两类，减少33.3%，保留全部256个高斯）。
AI.result: 三张合成图像的30次拟合实验中，正确密钥可无误差恢复消息，错误密钥解码BER为0.543，接近随机猜测；相比随机选取，选择最小扰动编辑恢复更可靠（单侧p=0.031），平均PSNR代价仅0.091 dB。在112张256×256自然图像上，正确密钥BER为0.000，错误密钥BER为0.520。简化配置下正确密钥仍可无误差恢复，但错误密钥BER由0.514升至0.571，偏离随机猜测（0.5）。
AI.conclusion: 在高斯参数域嵌入信息可行，且保留参数子集时视觉代价极低；正确密钥解码高度可靠，错误密钥接近随机猜测。简化配置虽不影响正确恢复，但会削弱错误密钥解码的随机性，提示参数类型数量对安全性有影响。

title: Checking Leakage Witnesses versus Certifying Bounded Non-Leakage
summary: When a language-model audit finds no leak, what is needed to certify non-leakage? We study guarantees over a declared prompt domain under an executable leakage criterion and decoding rule. For general bounded polynomial-time evaluators, a supplied leaking execution is polynomial-time checkable, while leak existence is \NP-complete and deterministic certification is \coNP-complete. Exact stochastic certification is $\coNP^{\PP}$-complete at every fixed rational cutoff in $(0,1)$. Restricting the computation can change these bounds. For example, certification is in \coNP\ when all randomness is a terminal draw from an efficiently computed finite probability table. Attention models admit polynomial-time certification when local dependency windows of logarithmic length precede one global head, given deterministic decoding, fixed vocabulary, exact rational weighted means, a direct binary affine readout and finite-automaton prompt domains. A construction with two global layers instead makes certification \coNP-complete over template domains, with one head per layer, polynomial width, logarithmic precision and an inverse-polynomial logit margin. Planted-secret experiments measure what finite audits miss relative to complete references. Among 30 secret--model-state pairs that leak under greedy single-prompt execution on their secret's 4,096-prompt domain, uniformly selecting 256 recorded evaluations per pair misses every leak for an expected $41.06\%$ of these pairs. Batched and single-prompt checks disagree on one complete-domain decision among all 48 fine-tuned pairs, while a same-order repeat reproduces every single-prompt output. These results distinguish computational conditions for certification from the coverage and execution conditions needed to interpret a negative audit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型"未泄漏"审计的认证复杂度：泄漏存在性为NP完全，确定性认证为coNP完全，精确随机认证为coNP^PP完全；对注意力模型，特定受限条件下可多项式时间认证，而双层全局构造则使认证coNP完全；实验表明有限审计会系统性漏检泄漏。
AI.motivation: 当审计未发现泄漏时，需要什么才能认证"确实不存在泄漏"？作者希望在声明的提示域、可执行的泄漏判据与解码规则下，刻画认证泄漏不存在的计算复杂度，并区分"认证的计算条件"与"解释阴性审计所需的覆盖与执行条件"。
AI.method: 在声明的提示域上，以可执行泄漏判据与解码规则为设定，对一般有界多项式时间评估器分析泄漏存在性与认证的复杂度；对随机情形分析固定有理截断下的精确随机认证；再限制计算（如随机性为终末抽取）以及针对注意力模型（局部依赖窗口、全局头、确定性解码、精确有理加权平均、仿射读出、有限自动机提示域等）推导复杂度上界与下界；并设计植入秘密实验，用有限审计与完整参照对比，检验批处理与单提示检查的一致性。
AI.result: 一般有界多项式时间评估器下，给出泄漏执行可多项式时间检验，泄漏存在性为NP完全，确定性认证为coNP完全；每个固定有理截断(0,1)下精确随机认证为coNP^PP完全；若随机性仅为可高效计算有限概率表的终末抽取，认证属于coNP。注意力模型在局部依赖窗口为对数长度且先于单一全局头、确定性解码、固定词表、精确有理加权平均、直接二元仿射读出及有限自动机提示域下可多项式时间认证；改为两层全局结构（每层一个头、多项式宽度、对数精度、逆多项式logit间隔）在模板域上使认证coNP完全。实验中，30个秘密-模型状态对在其秘密的4,096提示域上按贪心单提示执行均泄漏，而每对均匀抽取256次记录评估时，期望41.06%的对漏检全部泄漏；全部48个微调对中批处理与单提示检查仅在一个完整域决策上不一致，同序重复可复现每个单提示输出。
AI.conclusion: 认证"无泄漏"的复杂度高度依赖于评估器计算能力与模型结构：一般情形下认证困难（coNP/coNP^PP完全），受限随机性或特定注意力结构可降至多项式或coNP。有限审计的阴性结果并不等于无泄漏，认证的计算条件与审计解释所需的覆盖、执行条件必须区别对待。

title: AquaBEV-Nav: Learned BEV Occupancy for Underwater Navigation and Exploration
summary: Safe underwater exploration requires a robot to understand where surrounding structures are located and which regions are available for motion. Existing vision-based underwater exploration systems commonly obtain this information indirectly by estimating monocular depth, unprojecting the geometry into 3D space, and accumulating it into a 2D bird's-eye-view occupancy map. This reliance on intermediate depth estimation is particularly problematic underwater, where scattering and wavelength-dependent attenuation degrade visual cues and limit the reliability of monocular depth estimates. We introduce AquaBEV-Nav, an underwater exploration framework that bypasses explicit monocular depth estimation through direct bird's-eye-view occupancy prediction. Built upon the CORAL hierarchical exploration framework, AquaBEV-Nav replaces its depth-based perception front end with AquaBEV. Given a single RGB frame, AquaBEV maps visual features into a learned polar representation, performs causal reasoning along the range dimension, and reconstructs local Cartesian occupancy without relying on intermediate depth prediction. The resulting occupancy map is accumulated into CORAL's persistent spatial memory, providing spatial context for VLM-based high-level planning and collision constraints for dynamics-aware local trajectory generation. Across ten simulated reef environments and six occupancy backbones evaluated under a single protocol, AquaBEV-Nav reaches 37.48 structure IoU and 53.2 target IoU, 88.95% closed-loop coverage with zero collisions.

AI.tldr: 提出 AquaBEV-Nav 水下探索框架，用直接 BEV 占据预测替代单目深度估计，提升感知与导航性能。
AI.motivation: 水下散射与波长相关衰减会削弱视觉线索，导致单目深度估计不可靠；现有系统依赖“深度估计→反投影→2D 鸟瞰占据”的间接流程，误差链长，难以保证安全探索。
AI.method: 基于 CORAL 分层探索框架，将其基于深度的感知前端替换为 AquaBEV：输入单张 RGB 帧，将视觉特征映射到学习得到的极坐标表示，沿距离维进行因果推理，直接重建局部笛卡尔占据，不依赖中间深度预测；占据图累积进 CORAL 的持久空间记忆，为 VLM 高层规划提供空间上下文，并为动力学感知局部轨迹生成提供碰撞约束。
AI.result: 在 10 个仿真珊瑚礁环境、6 种占据骨干网络、统一评测协议下，达到 37.48 结构 IoU、53.2 目标 IoU、88.95% 闭环覆盖率，且零碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 绕开显式单目深度估计的直接 BEV 占据预测可有效支撑水下安全探索，在多种环境与骨干配置下实现高覆盖率与零碰撞。

title: CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出 CausalDriveBench，基于 Pearl 因果层级（PCH）系统评估驾驶 VLA 的因果推理能力，发现现有模型的流畅推理与轨迹精度均不构成因果理解的证据。
AI.motivation: 驾驶 VLA 模型在输出轨迹的同时生成自然语言推理，但这种推理是否反映场景的因果结构此前未被检验，缺乏面向驾驶场景的因果推理评测基准。
AI.method: 构建基于 nuScenes 的因果场景图，区分因果活跃、休眠与干扰实体，将感知显著性与因果相关性解耦；覆盖 PCH 四个层级（关联、干预、反事实、因果发现）生成结构化视觉问答，并为高层级提供指定场景修改下的参考轨迹以实现动作级验证。共含 7,285 条经校验的因果 QA 对与 1,000 条反事实轨迹，评测 10 个驾驶专用 VLA 与 3 个通用 VLM。
AI.result: 最佳模型 QA 准确率仅 70.6%，13 个模型中 4 个低于随机水平；与共享语言骨干的通用 VLM 相比，驾驶微调的代价在因果 QA 上为 2–34 个百分点，差异由后训练设计决定；因果 QA 与轨迹精度在模型间统计不相关，反事实提示下预测轨迹要么过度反应、要么坍缩至观测场景基线。
AI.conclusion: 流畅的推理文本与准确的观测场景轨迹都不能作为因果理解的证据，驾驶 VLA 的因果推理能力仍存在实质性缺陷。

title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
comment: 25 pages, 8 tables. Corpus: 28 arXiv papers (19-24 September 2026); arXiv versions listed in Appendix A. Ancillary file: per-paper corpus sheet (versions and headline results)
summary: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probability distributions over caller-defined options without generating text. TypeSafe released Jev, a commercial typed decision model, on 15 September 2026, and a small body of evaluation and replication work appeared within days. We review 28 papers posted between 19 and 24 September and relate their findings to earlier work on label-probability classification, constrained decoding, reranking, calibration, and model cascades. In this early literature, the typed readout itself has not shown an independent accuracy advantage over comparable label-probability readouts. Jev's clearest gains are in latency and cost, while accuracy gaps remain on harder tasks. In practical deployments, confidence is often used to decide when to defer to a stronger model or a human. We use recurring weaknesses in these studies to derive a 14-item evaluation checklist for future TDM work. Because the evidence covers only the first nine days after the release of one hosted model, the review should be read as an early evidence map rather than a settled assessment of the model class.

AI.tldr: 综述28篇Jev发布后9天内的评估论文，发现类型化读出并未带来独立精度优势，主要增益在延迟与成本，并据此提出14项评估清单。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型（TDMs）直接输出调用者定义选项上的概率分布而不生成文本，2026年9月15日TypeSafe发布商用TDM Jev后数日内即出现一批评估与复现研究，亟需对这批早期证据进行梳理，并厘清其与既有标签概率分类、约束解码、重排序、校准与模型级联研究的关系。
AI.method: 综述2026年9月19日至24日间发布的28篇论文，将其发现与早期相关研究进行对照分析；同时归纳这些研究中反复出现的弱点，据此推导出一份14项评估清单。
AI.result: 在这一早期文献中，类型化读出本身相较可比的标签概率读出未表现出独立的精度优势；Jev最明显的增益体现在延迟和成本上，而在更难任务上仍存在精度差距。实际部署中，置信度常被用于决定何时将请求转交给更强模型或人工处理。
AI.conclusion: 由于证据仅覆盖单一托管模型发布后的头九天，该综述应被理解为一份早期证据地图，而非对该模型类别的定论；所提出的14项评估清单可用于指导未来TDM研究。

title: PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models
summary: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PruneForget，将机器遗忘与模型剪枝联合求解，利用遗忘集指导剪枝，使二者相互促进，在移除遗忘样本影响的同时获得更紧凑模型，性能接近"重训+剪枝"的 oracle。
AI.motivation: 现实中模型既需支持遗忘请求（如出于安全考虑），又需满足延迟与内存预算约束。已有工作通常将遗忘与剪枝视为独立问题（例如顺序执行），忽略了二者之间的内在联系。
AI.method: PruneForget 将遗忘集作为剪枝的引导信号：编码了被遗忘样本信息的参数正是天然的剪枝目标，因为遗忘与剪枝都要求"删除"这些参数。通过这种引导实现遗忘与剪枝的联合、相互感知求解。
AI.result: 在图像分类器与生成模型上的大量实验表明，PruneForget 在移除遗忘样本影响的同时生成更紧凑、推理开销更低的模型，与"从头重训以实现遗忘、再进行剪枝"的 oracle 相比性能差距可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘与剪枝本质上是自然对齐的，应联合求解而非顺序独立处理；这种联合视角可同时满足遗忘安全需求与推理效率约束，且几乎不损失性能。

title: PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
summary: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at https://github.com/huiyegit/PQR3D

AI.tldr: 提出PQR3D，在参考条件时间窗口内进行渐进式查询细化，实现随机帧采样与独立推理，无需序列感知训练和时序推理。
AI.motivation: 时序上下文对纯视觉多视角3D目标检测至关重要，但现有流式检测器需跨帧维护并传播查询状态，导致必须时序感知训练与按时间顺序推理，限制了训练与推理的灵活性。
AI.method: 在参考条件时间窗口内渐进式细化查询；将早期时间戳中运动对齐的高置信度查询逐级传递到目标帧；引入掩码自注意力，规范常规查询、传播查询与去噪查询间的交互，同时隔离去噪监督与检测查询；采用阶段解耦锚点嵌入，在自注意力之前注入位置信息，在之后注入尺寸、朝向与速度，以降低时间不一致属性的干扰。
AI.result: 在ViT-L骨干下，于nuScenes测试集取得71.6 NDS与64.9 mAP，刷新当前最优结果。
AI.conclusion: PQR3D通过参考条件时间窗口内的渐进式查询细化，摆脱了持久查询记忆，支持随机帧采样与独立推理，并在nuScenes上达到新的SOTA。

title: OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/

AI.tldr: 提出 OneFixer——面向自动驾驶仿真的单步自回归视频扩散修复器，用"部署匹配的共享 rollout"在一次任务特定适配中同时学习保真度与自回归鲁棒性，在 900 帧 rollout 下取得最低 FVD/LPIPS/DISTS，并以不到一半 GPU 小时匹配多阶段 DMD+Self-Forcing 管线。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 在自动驾驶仿真中需渲染时修复，要求高画质、时序一致且低延迟；单步因果生成中每个不完美预测立即成为后续帧上下文，现有分阶段训练+多模块+rollout 正则仍难以满足部署级质量。
AI.method: 单任务特定适配阶段训练的单步自回归视频扩散修复器：采用部署匹配的共享 rollout，将模型自身单步预测作为 flow matching 的因果上下文以暴露部署期误差，同时对同一 rollout 施加直接像素空间感知监督以保留细节；因优化当前帧质量的预测正是被复用为未来上下文的预测，故保真度与自回归鲁棒性联合学习，无需双向到因果转换或教师-学生蒸馏。并额外利用车道几何与动态智能体状态等驾驶仿真固有线索提升几何保真度。
AI.result: 在 Waymo 与自有驾驶场景、900 帧 rollout 上，一步生成下 FVD、LPIPS、DISTS 均为所有基线最低，时序一致性达到或超过多阶段 DMD 管线；在相同骨干与条件下，以不到一半 GPU 小时匹配多阶段 DMD-with-Self-Forcing 管线并突破其平台继续提升；闭环仿真中搭配驾驶策略将碰撞率相对原始 3DGS 渲染降低三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 通过部署匹配的单步共享 rollout 与像素级感知监督的联合优化，OneFixer 以单阶段训练实现高质量、时序一致的低延迟自回归视频修复，验证了其在自动驾驶闭环仿真中的实用性与效率优势。

title: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向大规模场景3D高斯泼溅(3D-GS)模型的资源高效联邦学习框架，通过设备端模型轻量化与3D-GS模型恢复机制，在严重资源受限的无线边缘环境下实现高效训练。
AI.motivation: 大规模3D-GS模型在无线边缘训练面临三大挑战：(1)边缘设备的通信、计算和GPU显存资源受限；(2)各本地模型间存在结构不一致问题，阻碍有效聚合；(3)原始视觉内容与相机参数带来隐私泄露风险。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心机制：(1)设备端模型轻量化机制——自适应选择与剪枝高斯点，量化评估每个设备上高斯点的重要性以指导剪枝，并采用新颖的"重要性-时延比"准则在GPU显存与计算/通信时延约束下确定剪枝数量；(2)3D-GS模型恢复机制——在不访问私有相机参数的前提下恢复本地3D-GS模型间的结构一致性，从而实现向全局模型的有效聚合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，相比最先进的联邦3D-GS基线方法，本方案显著加速收敛，保持高渲染质量，并降低训练时延。
AI.conclusion: 所提资源高效联邦学习框架能够有效应对无线边缘环境下大规模3D-GS模型训练的资源受限、结构不一致与隐私泄露问题，兼顾渲染质量与训练效率。

title: Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
summary: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双耳视听实例分割新任务BiAVIS，利用双耳音频空间线索解决同类别实例歧义问题，并构建两个基准数据集与相应模型，显著超越单耳方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视听分割方法多在单耳设定下开发，依赖跨模态语义对应，难以区分同一语义类别的视觉相似实例；而人类利用双耳听觉中的耳间差异及头部和耳廓产生的方向相关声学滤波，获取物理空间线索以精确定位声源。受此启发，作者引入双耳空间线索来解决实例级类内歧义。
AI.method: 提出BiAVIS任务（利用同步双耳音频与视频帧分割发声实例）；构建两个基准：对现有双耳视听数据集进行人工标注，并采集更具挑战性和多样性的真实数据集BiAVIS-Bench；提出BiAVIS模型，使用纯音频声源定位网络从双耳音频学习发声实例的空间与语义先验，并通过查询级视听融合策略将先验注入实例分割解码器。
AI.result: 在两个基准上的大量实验表明，BiAVIS模型优于以往单耳AVS方法，尤其在解决实例级类内歧义方面表现突出。在更具挑战性的BiAVIS-Bench上，BiAVIS模型相较最佳单耳基线分别提升mAP 17.22%和FSLA 7.71%。
AI.conclusion: 双耳空间线索为视听实例分割提供了有效的物理先验，能显著缓解类内实例歧义；BiAVIS任务、基准与模型为该方向建立了新的研究基础。

title: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture. Across four streaming and long-video benchmarks and three VLM backbones, KeyRec achieves the best compressed performance in 13 of 15 settings using only 10\% of the dense decoder-facing visual-token budget. It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.

AI.tldr: KeyRec：一种免训练的有界视觉记忆框架，通过视觉缓存与结构化事件库分离存储近期细节与长程历史，并用文本路由器分配固定读出预算，在仅10%视觉token预算下于15个设置中13个取得最佳压缩性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频与连续流的视觉token随视频时长累积，导致长上下文推理成本过高。现有免训练视觉token选择方法虽能降低成本，但会丢失连贯事件证据，且无法区分近期细节观测与长程历史。
AI.method: 提出KeyRec免训练框架，构建有界视觉记忆。查询无关的写入阶段：将细粒度近期观测保存在视觉缓存中，并把历史证据组织为结构化事件库；候选事件依据相对已存事件的新颖性提出，通过在线“添加—合并—剔除”更新维护。查询到来时，仅用文本路由器在近期记忆与事件记忆之间自适应分配固定读出预算，不重处理历史帧。方法作用于面向模型的视觉嵌入，支持模块化编码器—投影器VLM以及无编码器、无投影器的NEO-ov架构。
AI.result: 在四个流式与长视频基准、三个VLM骨干上，KeyRec在15个设置中13个取得最佳压缩性能，仅使用10%的密集解码器侧视觉token预算；在实时问题上比最强压缩基线高2.21–18.37个点，在六个长视频设置中五个取得最佳压缩结果，且在全部NEO-ov 2B设置中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: KeyRec以有界视觉记忆与固定读出预算实现免训练的长视频理解，在显著压缩视觉token的同时保持甚至超越密集推理性能，并具备跨架构的通用性。

title: Scalable In-Domain Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Dense Representation Transfer in High-Resolution Plant Imaging
summary: High-resolution plant imaging enables detailed characterization of plant morphology, but dense scientific analysis remains limited by costly pixel-level annotations, large image pixel dimensions, and substantial variation in imaging conditions. This work proposes a scalable in-domain self-supervised pretrained foundation model for high-resolution, high-pixel-dimension multi-species plant imagery. A masked autoencoder with a ViT backbone is pretrained on more than 10 million multi-view plant image tiles using distributed training. Following scalable pretraining, the learned foundation-model representations are comprehensively benchmarked across fine-grained dense prediction and coarse global feature recognition, with particular emphasis on limited supervision and realistic downstream imaging conditions. This work focuses on the domain gap of existing foundation models in dense feature representation and transfer. Through extensive experiments involving limited annotations, cross-view variation, and resolution degradation, the in-domain FM achieves a Mean Dice of 0.8686 and a Pooled Dice of 0.8959, outperforming an MAE counterpart pretrained on large-scale natural-image data by 0.0694 and 0.0613, respectively. The results further indicate that increasing pretraining scale produces consistent improvements in dense feature transfer. Overall, these findings suggest that scaling in-domain self-supervised pretraining can reduce the domain gap and improve transferable dense representations for high-pixel-dimension scientific imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向高分辨率、高像素、多物种植物图像的域内自监督预训练基础模型：在超1000万多视角植物图像块上以ViT骨干的掩码自编码器进行分布式预训练，并在有限标注、跨视角变化与分辨率退化条件下评测密集预测与全局特征识别，密集特征迁移优于自然图像预训练的MAE对应模型。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率植物成像可精细刻画植物形态，但其科学分析受制于：像素级标注成本高、图像像素维度大、成像条件差异显著；同时现有基础模型在密集特征表示与迁移上存在明显的域间差距。
AI.method: 构建可扩展的域内自监督预训练基础模型：以ViT为骨干的掩码自编码器（MAE），采用分布式训练在超过1000万多视角植物图像块上预训练；随后在细粒度密集预测与粗粒度全局特征识别两类任务上系统评测，重点考察有限监督与真实下游成像条件（有限标注、跨视角变化、分辨率退化）。
AI.result: 域内基础模型取得Mean Dice 0.8686、Pooled Dice 0.8959，分别较基于大规模自然图像预训练的MAE对应模型高出0.0694与0.0613；增大预训练规模可带来密集特征迁移的一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 规模化域内自监督预训练能够缩小域间差距，并为高像素维度的科学成像提供更具迁移性的密集特征表示。

title: Contamination, Prior, or Evidence? Decomposing and Training Evidence Use in Whole-Slide Vision-Language Models
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) are conventionally evaluated by accuracy, but accuracy alone does not measure evidence use: it may conflate dataset contamination, prior knowledge, and image evidence. In a motivating study of lymph-node metastasis prediction, we found that most public pathology VLMs showed minimal differences when changing from feeding the models with whole-slide images, an annotated lesion, or no image at all. To better understand the specific features leveraged by these models, this paper presents two contributions aimed at disentangling these factors. First, we present CleanSlide, a TCGA-based VQA benchmark designed to eliminate image- and question-side contamination. It contains 149K audited multiple-choice questions over 9,985 slides, with patient- and tissue-source-disjoint splits. Every question is audited for option shortcuts, stem leakage, cross-split duplication, and blind solvability. Second, we propose Pair-DPO, a preference loss over counterfactual slide pairs from the same question and source. By controlling for shared confounding factors, Pair-DPO cancels out the question-attributable signal and leaves image evidence as the source of preference. Specifically, each pair consists of two real slides with opposite, verified findings, introducing neither editing artifacts nor unverified labels for diffuse or graded features such as invasion, necrosis, and tumor grade. Experiments show that our method gains 15.29% from image evidence on the CleanSlide, compared with 2.81% for the best published model. On the external CPTAC and BCNB cohorts, our method achieves accuracies of 57.6% and 59.0%, outperforming all other evaluated models by 9.7% and 3.4%, respectively. We will release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 论文指出病理视觉语言模型仅用准确率评估会混淆数据污染、先验知识与图像证据，提出无污染的TCGA基准CleanSlide和Pair-DPO偏好损失，显著提升模型对图像证据的利用与外部泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有病理视觉语言模型（VLMs）通常仅以准确率评估，而准确率无法衡量模型是否真正使用了图像证据，可能混淆数据集污染、先验知识与图像证据等因素。作者在淋巴结转移预测的动机研究中发现，多数公开病理VLM在输入全切片图像、标注病灶或不输入图像时表现差异极小，说明模型可能并未有效利用图像证据，因此需要解耦并厘清这些因素。
AI.method: 提出两项贡献：（1）CleanSlide，一个基于TCGA的VQA基准，旨在消除图像侧和问题侧的污染，包含覆盖9,985张切片的149K道经审核多选题，采用患者与组织来源不相交的划分，每题均审核选项捷径、题干泄露、跨划分重复与盲解性；（2）Pair-DPO，一种基于同一问题与来源的反事实切片对的偏好损失，通过控制共享混杂因素，抵消问题可归因信号，使图像证据成为偏好来源，每对由两张具有相反且经验证发现结果的真实切片构成，避免编辑伪影及对侵袭、坏死、肿瘤分级等弥散或分级特征使用未验证标签。
AI.result: 在CleanSlide上，所提方法从图像证据中获得15.29%的增益，而最佳已发表模型仅为2.81%；在外部CPTAC与BCNB队列上，所提方法分别达到57.6%和59.0%的准确率，较所有其他评估模型分别高出9.7%和3.4%。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭准确率评估病理VLM不足以衡量图像证据的利用，CleanSlide基准与Pair-DPO方法能有效解耦污染与先验知识的影响，显著提升模型对图像证据的依赖与外部数据集泛化能力，作者将公开基准与代码。

title: Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并定义了文生图模型中的"喻体入侵"（Figurative Vehicle Intrusion）失败模式，提出多语言基准VISTA与诊断指标V-Score进行系统评测，并给出轻量缓解方案VISTA-Guard。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型虽能依据自然语言提示生成高质量图像，但在处理比喻性语言时存在失败：本应仅用于引导本体（tenor）描绘的喻体（vehicle），却被渲染为可见实体对象。此类错误中，侵入内容在文本上是允许的，但被赋予了错误的视觉角色，说明"视觉呈现"不等于"忠实性"，而面向呈现的评测方式会遗漏这类错误。因此需要系统研究这一问题。
AI.method: （1）形式化定义"喻体入侵"这一失败模式；（2）构建VISTA多语言基准，包含比喻性提示，并按"比喻形式"（Figurative Form）与"映射机制"（Mapping Mechanism）进行组织；（3）提出V-Score，一种基于问答的诊断性指标，用于评估生成图像中角色感知的比喻忠实性；（4）提出轻量缓解方法VISTA-Guard。
AI.result: 对近期高性能文生图模型的评测表明，喻体入侵在不同语言和不同比喻类别中普遍存在。作为轻量缓解手段，VISTA-Guard可部分减少喻体入侵。
AI.conclusion: 喻体入侵是当前文生图模型的跨语言、跨类别的系统性缺陷，暴露了面向呈现的评测盲区；VISTA基准与V-Score指标为角色感知的比喻忠实性评测提供了工具，VISTA-Guard则为更忠实的比喻性图像生成提供了可行路径。所有资源将公开释放。

title: ScopeIF: Improving Scope-Aware Precise Instruction-Following in Large Language Models via Graded Reward Modeling
summary: Precise instruction-following is a fundamental ability of large language models (LLMs), requiring their outputs to strictly satisfy objective constraints in input instructions. In complex application scenarios, these constraints often possess diverse scopes that govern specific response segments rather than the entire output. However, existing optimization methods often neglect constraint scope during data construction and rely on binary per-constraint rewards, yielding limited data diversity and sparse supervision for complex constraints. To this end, we propose ScopeIF, a novel training framework for scope-aware precise instruction-following. We first introduce a unified schema that factorizes objective constraints into three decoupled dimensions: Scope, Target, and Range. Grounded in this schema, we construct ScopeInstruct, a large-scale instruction dataset with diverse scope-aware constraints, and combine tool-grounded verification with graded reward modeling to quantify the violation degree of each constraint, providing dense supervision for policy optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScopeIF consistently outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex scope-aware constraints, while preserving general capabilities. Notably, it enables optimized Qwen3-4B and 8B models to rival or surpass strong frontier models such as Gemini-2.5-Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2, establishing an effective paradigm for advancing scope-aware instruction-following. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/thu-coai/ScopeIF.

AI.tldr: 提出ScopeIF框架，将指令约束解耦为Scope、Target、Range三要素，构建ScopeInstruct数据集并用分级奖励建模实现稠密监督，使Qwen3-4B/8B在范围感知指令遵循上媲美或超越Gemini-2.5-Pro与DeepSeek-V3.2。
AI.motivation: 现有精确指令遵循优化方法在数据构建时忽视约束的作用范围（scope），且依赖二元化的逐约束奖励，导致数据多样性受限、对复杂约束的监督信号稀疏，难以应对复杂应用场景中作用于特定响应片段的多样约束。
AI.method: 1）提出统一schema，将客观约束分解为Scope、Target、Range三个解耦维度；2）基于该schema构建大规模范围感知指令数据集ScopeInstruct；3）结合工具化验证（tool-grounded verification）与分级奖励建模（graded reward modeling）量化每条约束的违反程度，为策略优化提供稠密监督。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ScopeIF持续优于现有方法，在复杂范围感知约束上提升尤为显著，同时保持通用能力；优化后的Qwen3-4B与8B模型可媲美甚至超越Gemini-2.5-Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: ScopeIF为范围感知的精确指令遵循建立了有效范式，验证了约束解耦schema与稠密分级奖励在提升LLM指令遵循精度上的价值。

title: Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas
summary: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MOXAI多组学可解释深度学习框架，整合DNA甲基化与拷贝数变异数据对成人型弥漫性胶质瘤进行分子亚型分类，并实现基于CpG位点、基因与染色体区域的可解释性归因。
AI.motivation: 现有计算模型通常分别分析甲基化与拷贝数变异数据，无法捕捉二者整合带来的互补信息；同时缺乏类似传统肿瘤分级的类内风险评估机制，也缺少能够将分类决策归因到具体基因组位点的可解释性方法。
AI.method: 基于TCGA队列，构建整合甲基化与拷贝数数据的MOXAI深度学习框架，并设置单模态对照变体；分别使用ResNet50、DINOv2与图注意力网络（GAT）在甲基化单独、拷贝数单独及多模态联合数据上训练；开发基于类激活图（CAM）与梯度加权类激活图（Grad-CAM）的XAI方法，用于识别与分类决策最相关的CpG位点、基因及染色体区域。
AI.result: 多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高达92.98%，优于仅用CNV数据训练的模型；DINOv2泛化能力最强，在独立验证集上达到94.25%准确率（置信度>0.9）；XAI结果与已知的成人型弥漫性胶质瘤亚型分子特征一致，验证了框架的生物学可解释性。
AI.conclusion: MOXAI通过多组学整合与可解释性方法，提升了成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子亚型分类性能，并实现了与已知生物学特征一致的决策归因，表明多模态可解释AI在肿瘤分子诊断中具有应用价值。

title: Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
summary: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Devol-ONE，一种 Mixture of Transformers 架构，将视觉语言理解、潜在世界动态预测与动作生成统一到单一自回归框架中，实现预测与策略的架构级融合。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型仅以当前视觉与语言上下文直接条件化动作，缺乏对候选动作下场景演变的显式建模；WAM 虽预测未来状态，但预测与策略学习在架构上分离，仅通过预测输出（像素空间视频生成或独立训练的潜在预测模块）连接，导致动作专家无法持续受到动态预测的塑造。
AI.method: Devol-ONE 采用 Mixture of Transformers 架构，在视觉语言流与基于 V-JEPA 预训练的动态流上联合进行自回归预测，每层均关注视觉语言键值缓存，从而在语言引导下预测未来潜在状态；动作专家由语义推理与预测的物理动态持续塑造，而非依赖预先计算的固定表示。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RoboTwin2.0 以及 Flexiv 单臂与双臂真实环境上进行了大量实验；消融研究验证了动态流预测与逐层统一注意力的有效性，证实了模型架构的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将世界动态预测与动作生成统一于单一自回归 Transformer 框架，并让动作专家持续接收语义与动态信息，可有效提升 VLA 模型性能，架构层面的深度融合优于预测与策略分离的设计。

title: The Judge Is Not Its Twin: Post-training makes a model's writing more predictable but barely moves its taste, as a judge, toward predictable writing
summary: Language models are now routinely graded by other language models. If post-training makes a model's own writing more predictable, it may also teach the same model, acting as a judge, to reward predictable writing, so that progress on creativity would be invisible to automated evaluation. We follow two open model families, OLMo-2 and Zephyr (7B parameters each), through their public training stages and measure every stage twice, as a writer of short stories and as a judge of pairs of stories. As writers, the models drift as feared: each family's fully trained model finds the stories of its base, supervised fine-tuned (SFT) and preference-trained (DPO) stages progressively more familiar, in all ten prompts, and a model from the other family finds the trained stories 7.0 to 9.2 percent (OLMo-2) and 24 to 25 percent (Zephyr) less surprising per token. As judges, they barely move toward predictable writing. Asked which story is better, a question every judge can use to tell a story from its own words in scrambled order, no trained judge's estimated tilt toward the more predictable story grows by as much as one point in the probability of picking it. A post hoc one-sided 95% upper bound on that growth is 2.7 points on an average pair, about the size of the untrained OLMo-2 judge's own tilt. Asked which is more creative, no trained judge's estimate favors the predictable story more than its base's does. Training instead strengthens a preference for longer stories when the question is creativity, and for one answer slot, and it breaks "more creative" as a question: trained judges asked it no longer reliably prefer a story to its scrambled words. A follow-up could not build pairs that differ in predictability but not in quality, because the routes that made this writer's stories less predictable also broke some of them, often enough to fail a quality floor set in advance.

AI.tldr: 该研究追踪 OLMo-2 与 Zephyr 两个开源模型家族的公开训练阶段，发现后训练使模型作为"写作者"的文本更可预测，但作为"评判者"几乎未对可预测性产生偏好倾斜，自动评估难以捕捉创造性的变化。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常由其他语言模型评分。若后训练让模型自身写作更可预测，则同一模型作为评判者可能也学会奖励可预测文本，导致创造性进展在自动评估中不可见。研究旨在验证这一担忧。
AI.method: 对 OLMo-2 与 Zephyr（各 7B）逐阶段测量同一模型的两种角色：写作者（创作短故事）与评判者（对故事配对比较）。以"惊奇度/每 token 困惑度"衡量可预测性；评判者任务包括"哪篇更好""哪篇更有创意"及对照的"打乱词序"辨识任务。另进行事后单侧 95% 上界估计，并尝试构建"可预测性不同但质量相同"的配对。
AI.result: 作为写作者，两家族完全训练后的模型在全部十个提示下，对 base、SFT、DPO 各阶段故事愈发"熟悉"；另一家族模型对训练阶段故事的惊讶度降低：OLMo-2 降 7.0–9.2%，Zephyr 降 24–25%。作为评判者，向可预测写作的倾斜增长不足 1 个百分点；单侧 95% 上界为 2.7 个百分点（约等于未训练 OLMo-2 评判者自身偏好）。"更有创意"问题上，训练后评判者不比 base 更偏向可预测故事；训练反而强化了对更长故事的偏好和对某一答案位置的偏好，并破坏了"更有创意"这一问法（不再可靠区分故事与打乱文本）。后续尝试无法构造可预测性不同但质量相同的配对，因为降低可预测性的方法同时损害了故事质量。
AI.conclusion: 后训练确实使模型写作更可预测，但并未明显使评判者偏好可预测文本，因此"自动评估掩盖创造性进展"的担忧在本文设置中证据有限；然而训练引入的长度偏好、位置偏好及问题语义崩坏，提示 LLM 评判者在创造性评估上存在其他系统性偏差。

title: Generalization and Memorization along the Learning Trajectory of Neural Language Models: A Geometric Account of Categorization
comment: 5 figures in main text, 9 page main text
summary: We investigate how generalization and memorization develop along the learning trajectory of neural language models. Using controlled synthetic grammars, we examine both the geometry of representation space and model behaviour over training. We find that continuous regions of representation space not occupied by observed tokens become systematically structured from the earliest stages of learning, forming category-level geometric organization that supports generalization to unattested combinations. Generalization therefore emerges from the beginning of learning rather than only after extensive memorization. With prolonged training, larger models increasingly distinguish observed from unobserved grammatical combinations. At the same time, the continuous geometric structure supporting category-level generalization is gradually destructed. Together, these results suggest that neural language models initially learn through categorization-based generalization, followed by a gradual transition toward more exemplar-specific memorization.

AI.tldr: 神经语言模型的学习轨迹呈现"先范畴化泛化、后样例化记忆"的转变过程。
AI.motivation: 探究泛化与记忆在神经语言模型学习轨迹中如何发展，澄清二者是先后关系还是同时发生。
AI.method: 使用受控合成语法，考察训练过程中表征空间的几何结构以及模型行为的变化。
AI.result: 未被观测词元占据的连续表征区域从学习早期即被系统化组织，形成支持泛化的类别级几何结构；随训练延长，较大模型愈发区分已观测与未观测的语法组合，同时支持类别级泛化的连续几何结构被逐步破坏。
AI.conclusion: 神经语言模型初期依赖基于范畴化的泛化，随后逐渐转向更具样例特异性的记忆。

title: Kernel-Based Steering of CLIP with Vision-Language Model Preferences
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can judge visual similarity, but their judgments are not directly available as compact image embeddings for efficient comparison. We study how to transfer these preferences into CLIP while retaining its image--text capabilities. We introduce ASK, a kernel-based steering method that learns from elicited pairwise judgments without accessing teacher embeddings or collecting new human similarity annotations. ASK constructs positive semidefinite target kernels within small image groups and combines visual kernel matching with an image--text distributional anchor. Low-rank adapters jointly update the visual and text encoders while regularizing predictions toward frozen CLIP. After adaptation, retrieval uses CLIP image embeddings and cosine similarity, with no VLM calls. Experiments across five image domains, four CLIP backbones, and six judges evaluate teacher agreement, retrieval, and recognition retention. For ViT-B/16, mean retrieval mAP on classes excluded from adaptation increases from 53.8 to 75.0, compared with 71.7 for DINOv2 targets with KL anchoring. Mean zero-shot accuracy with jointly adapted encoders increases from 61.8\% to 62.4\%, averaged over 12 benchmarks and the five adaptation domains. Prompting provides an additional capability: selecting which visual distinctions the student learns. Human-annotated evaluations across four datasets support this criterion-specific control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ASK方法，通过对比判断数据将大型视觉语言模型的视觉相似性偏好迁移到CLIP中，在保持图文能力的同时显著提升检索性能与零样本识别能力。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）具备视觉相似性判断能力，但其判断无法直接作为紧凑的图像嵌入用于高效比较；而CLIP虽可提供图像嵌入，却缺乏对细微视觉区分的敏感度。因此需要将VLM的相似性偏好迁移到CLIP，同时保留其原有的图文能力。
AI.method: 提出ASK，一种基于核的引导（steering）方法。它从诱导出的成对判断中学习，无需访问教师嵌入或收集新的人类相似性标注。具体地：在小图像组内构建半正定目标核，结合视觉核匹配与图文分布锚定；使用低秩适配器联合更新视觉与文本编码器，并将预测正则化朝向冻结的CLIP。适配后检索仅使用CLIP图像嵌入与余弦相似度，无需调用VLM。此外，提示（prompting）可用于选择学生模型学习的视觉区分维度。
AI.result: 在五个图像领域、四种CLIP骨干网络和六个评判模型上进行实验，评估教师一致性、检索和识别保持能力。对ViT-B/16，适配中排除类别的平均检索mAP从53.8提升至75.0（对比使用DINOv2目标与KL锚定的71.7）；联合适配编码器的平均零样本准确率从61.8%升至62.4%（12个基准与五个适配领域平均）。四个数据集上的人工标注评估支持提示可实现对特定区分的控制。
AI.conclusion: ASK能有效将VLM的细粒度视觉相似性偏好迁移至CLIP，在提升检索性能（尤其对未见类别）的同时基本保持甚至略微提升零样本识别能力；提示机制进一步提供了对所学视觉区分的可控性。

title: When Forgetting Looks Like Improvement: Metric Masking in Streaming Diarizer Adaptation and the Price of Rehearsal
summary: Small-data adaptation can improve speech detection while degrading speaker attribution. We study this discrepancy in a released streaming diarizer adapted on 7.5 h of two-party conversation and evaluated across six corpora. Adaptation substantially improves in-domain diarization performance and transfers to an independent corpus. However, this improvement is not consistent across evaluation scenarios as the additional confusion is mainly associated with impaired temporal identity consistency rather than speaker-count errors. A local-remapping diagnostic reveals different patterns of identity degradation across corpora, indicating that adaptation may alter how streaming models maintain speaker assignments over time. Rehearsal reduces the observed degradation but reduces the cross-domain transfer performance. These results highlight the need to jointly evaluate detection accuracy, identity consistency, and retention behavior when adapting streaming diarization systems.

AI.tldr: 小数据自适应可提升语音检测，但会损害说话人归属；研究揭示该现象主要源于时间身份一致性受损，而非说话人数目错误，且排练可缓解但损失跨域迁移。
AI.motivation: 小数据自适应在提升语音检测的同时会降低说话人归属性能，这一矛盾现象尚缺乏系统解释，需要明确其成因、在不同评估场景下的表现以及对流式说话人日志系统自适应策略的启示。
AI.method: 在已发布的流式说话人日志系统上进行小数据自适应（7.5小时双人对话数据），并在六个语料库上评估；分析域内性能、跨域迁移、混淆来源（时间身份一致性 vs 说话人数目错误），并采用局部重映射诊断（local-remapping diagnostic）分析身份退化模式，同时考察排练（rehearsal）策略的影响。
AI.result: 自适应显著提升域内日志性能并可迁移到独立语料；但提升在不同评估场景下不一致，额外混淆主要与时间身份一致性受损相关，而非说话人数目错误；局部重映射诊断显示不同语料的身份退化模式存在差异，表明自适应可能改变流式模型维持说话人分配的方式；排练可减少退化，但会降低跨域迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: 在自适应流式说话人日志系统时，需联合评估检测准确率、身份一致性与保持行为（retention behavior），而非仅关注检测指标。

title: HM-ROUTER: Joint Model and Harness Routing for Agentic Systems
summary: Agent performance depends on both the underlying model and the harness that manages its tool use and execution. Selecting a suitable pair requires accounting for their compatibility, yet training samples may cover only a subset of the growing combination space. We introduce HM-Router, a routing method that jointly selects a model and harness for each query. It learns separate model and harness representations shared across routes, with an interaction term inspired by canonical polyadic (CP) tensor decomposition to capture how their compatibility varies with the query. This sharing allows training samples from observed pairs to inform predictions for unobserved combinations. We curate a benchmark from 12 public agent benchmarks, covering 293 routes, 73 models, and 25 harnesses. HM-Router exceeds the strongest evaluated learned baseline by 7.3 percentage points in mean routing accuracy and leads at all seven evaluated cost budgets on the six-benchmark subset. When 90% of routes have their training outcomes withheld, allowing unobserved combinations improves normalized accuracy by 15.8 points over restricting the same router to observed routes. HM-Router has also demonstrated training sample efficiency for new routes and components and generalization to unseen benchmarks. Our code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/hmarkc/HM-Router.

AI.tldr: HM-Router 通过共享的模型与执行框架（harness）表示及交互项，联合路由每个查询的模型-框架组合，从而泛化到未观测组合。
AI.motivation: 智能体性能由底层模型与管理工具使用与执行的 harness 共同决定。挑选合适组合需考虑二者兼容性，但训练样本往往只覆盖不断增长的组合空间中的一小部分，因此需要能泛化到未观测组合的路由方法。
AI.method: 提出 HM-Router：为每个查询联合选择模型与 harness。学习跨路由共享的独立模型表示与 harness 表示，并引入受 CP 张量分解启发的交互项，以刻画兼容性随查询变化的方式。表示共享使得来自已观测组合的训练样本可用于预测未观测组合。此外从 12 个公开智能体基准构建基准集，覆盖 293 条路由、73 个模型、25 个 harness。
AI.result: 在平均路由准确率上超出最强已评测学习基线 7.3 个百分点，并在六基准子集的全部七个成本预算下领先。当 90% 路由的训练结果被隐藏时，允许未观测组合相比将同一路由器限制于已观测路由，归一化准确率提升 15.8 点。还展示了对新路由与新组件的训练样本效率及对未见基准的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 共享表示与 CP 式交互建模可有效实现模型-框架联合路由并泛化到未观测组合，代码与数据已开源。

title: A model of rational interlocutors: Unification of comprehension and production
comment: A computational model of partner modeling in language comprehension and production. 62 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, including supplementary materials
summary: Who we communicate with influences both our interpretation of their utterances and the design of our own. Such adjustment to the conversational partner is studied as speaker modeling in comprehension and as audience design in production, with the two literatures having developed largely separately. We argue that both adjustments express one rational computation and propose the rational interlocutor (RI) model, a computational account unifying comprehension and production. An interlocutor maintains a model of their partner, defined by three parameters: an identity parameter Π sets the messages and forms expected from the partner; a fidelity parameter Φ sets how reliably messages and utterances map onto each other for them; a knowledge parameter Λ sets how knowledgeable the partner is believed to be. Comprehension and production are thus mirror-image modes of one computation over the partner model. Comprehension chooses the message the partner most likely intends to convey, weighing how well each candidate fits the utterance against how likely this partner is to mean it. Production chooses the utterance from which the partner will best recover the message, weighed against the effort of saying it. This explains why comprehenders appear to rely less on the forms produced by a linguistically less competent speaker, while producers tend to invest more effort in designing forms for them. We conjecture that perceived linguistic competence decomposes into two of these quantities: fidelity and knowledge. Their contrasting profiles across second-language (L2) adults, children, and artificial partners produce distinct and testable predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"理性对话者"(RI)模型，用统一的贝叶斯式计算框架将理解中的说话者建模与产出中的受众设计整合为同一推理过程，并通过身份、保真度、知识三个参数刻画对话伙伴模型，对二语成人、儿童及人工伙伴产生可检验的预测。
AI.motivation: 理解研究中的"说话者建模"与产出研究中的"受众设计"长期分立发展，但二者本质上都是说话人依据对话伙伴调整语言的行为。作者认为这两种调整实为同一理性计算的两面，因而需要一个统一的计算模型来解释为何理解者会减少依赖语言能力较弱者所产出的形式，而产出者却为其投入更多设计努力。
AI.method: 提出理性对话者(RI)模型：对话者维护一个由三参数定义的伙伴模型——身份参数Π设定预期来自伙伴的信息与形式，保真度参数Φ设定其信息与话语之间的映射可靠程度，知识参数Λ设定其被认为的知识水平。理解与产出是同一计算在伙伴模型上的镜像模式：理解选择伙伴最可能意图传达的信息，权衡候选信息与话语的契合度及该伙伴如此表达的可能性；产出选择能使伙伴最好地还原信息的表达形式，并权衡表达所需努力。
AI.result: 该模型统一解释了理解与产出中的非对称调整现象：理解者较少依赖语言能力较弱说话者的形式，而产出者对其投入更多设计努力。作者进一步推测，感知到的语言能力可分解为保真度与知识两个量，二者在二语成人、儿童和人工伙伴身上的不同组合剖面产生了各自区分明确且可检验的预测。
AI.conclusion: 理解与产出中的伙伴调整可由单一理性计算（RI模型）统一刻画，感知语言能力可还原为保真度与知识两参数的组合；不同对话伙伴类型在此二维空间中的差异化剖面为后续实证研究提供了可检验的预测。

title: Geometry-Preserving Blind Watermarking for Raw 3D Point Clouds
summary: Raw 3D point clouds are a core geometric representation. Establishing their ownership is challenging because point sets are irregular, unstructured, and frequently altered by resampling and geometric preprocessing. We present a blind watermarking framework that operates directly on xyz coordinates and supports both object-level shapes and scene-scale scans. At verification time, the embedded message is recovered from the observed point cloud alone, without access to the original point cloud, color, normals, or mesh connectivity. The method jointly learns watermark embedding and extraction through a feed-forward octree-based architecture, enabling efficient multi-scale geometric reasoning on large point sets. During training, a stochastic transformation layer exposes the decoder to common geometric perturbations, while progressive pose alignment improves robustness to pose changes. Experiments on object-level and scene-level benchmarks demonstrate reliable message recovery under common geometric processing while maintaining low geometric distortion. Qualitative comparisons further show that the learned perturbations are less visually conspicuous and less spatially structured than those of handcrafted alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出一种直接作用于xyz坐标的盲水印框架，可在对象级与场景级点云中从观测点云单独恢复信息，通过八叉树前馈架构联合学习嵌入与提取，兼顾鲁棒性与低几何失真。
AI.motivation: 原始3D点云是核心几何表示，但其点集不规则、无结构，且常经重采样与几何预处理而改变，导致所有权确权困难。现有方法多依赖颜色、法线或网格连通性等辅助信息，验证时往往需要原始点云。
AI.method: 直接基于xyz坐标的盲水印框架，适用于对象级形状与场景级扫描；采用前馈八叉树架构联合学习水印嵌入与提取，实现大点集上的高效多尺度几何推理；训练中引入随机变换层使解码器暴露于常见几何扰动，并用渐进式姿态对齐提升对位姿变化的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在对象级与场景级基准上，常见几何处理后仍能可靠恢复信息，同时保持较低几何失真。定性比较显示，学习到的扰动相比手工设计方法在视觉上更不显眼，空间结构也更弱。
AI.conclusion: 该盲水印框架无需原始点云及颜色、法线、网格连通性等辅助信息即可验证，验证了八叉树联合学习与扰动/姿态鲁棒性设计的有效性，适用于对象级与场景级点云的所有权保护。

title: OptiArena: Can LLMs Improve Executable Algorithms under Fixed Resource Budgets?
summary: Static QA and code-generation benchmarks only partially capture the role that large language models (LLMs) now play as coding agents and research tools. We introduce OptiArena, a budget-controlled testbed for studying whether LLMs can improve executable game-playing algorithms through five rounds of code edits within a fixed minimal scaffold and under bounded evaluator feedback and fixed resource budgets. The testbed uses two optimization regimes, surface obfuscation controls, calibrated references, held-out/stress splits, and diagnostics for degradation and exceptional failures, with LLM API cost reported separately from local evaluator wall-clock. The empirical study asks three questions: whether models can close the calibrated gap between a designated weak starter and an editable competent baseline, whether they can refine editable competent baselines without damaging them, and whether gains survive surface obfuscation controls. Across twelve frontier LLMs and five games, models improve designated weak starters more consistently than they refine editable competent baselines, with substantial variation across games and models. OptiArena provides a practical testbed for measuring bounded-resource algorithm optimization within the five-edit, fixed-scaffold setting studied here. Code is available at https://github.com/WJ-Peng/OptiArena.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OptiArena——一个预算受控的测试平台，用于研究 LLM 能否在固定最小脚手架下、通过五轮代码编辑、在受限评估反馈与固定资源预算内改进可执行博弈算法。在十二个前沿 LLM 与五个游戏上的实验表明：模型改进弱起始版本比精炼合格基线更稳定，且跨游戏与模型差异显著。
AI.motivation: 现有静态 QA 与代码生成基准只能部分反映 LLM 作为编码代理与研究工具的实际作用，缺乏对受限资源条件下算法优化能力的度量手段。
AI.method: 构建 OptiArena 测试平台：在固定最小脚手架内允许五轮代码编辑，评估反馈与资源预算均有界；采用两种优化范式、表层混淆控制、校准参考、留出/压力测试划分，并对退化与异常失败进行诊断；LLM API 成本与本地评估器墙钟时间分开报告。围绕三个问题展开实证研究。
AI.result: 在十二个前沿 LLM 与五个游戏上，模型对指定弱起始版本的改进更为一致，而对可编辑合格基线的精炼效果较差；改进幅度随游戏与模型变化显著。
AI.conclusion: OptiArena 为在五轮编辑、固定脚手架设定下测量有界资源算法优化提供了实用测试平台。

title: Skeletons in Flow: Graph Structured Flow Matching for Human Motion Prediction
summary: Human motion prediction requires diverse future trajectories that remain consistent with observed motion and the articulated physical structure of the body. Skeletal constraints restrict individual poses, while coordinated motion depends on spatial interactions (between connected joints) and temporal interactions (between time instants). To facilitate human motion prediction in light of these constraints and interactions, we introduce Graph Structured Flow Matching (GSFM), which transports the complete future skeletal trajectory through a single conditional velocity field. The trajectory produces a spatiotemporal skeleton graph, and spatial and temporal attention couple its evolution according to skeletal relations and physical time offsets. Bone directions lie on unit spheres relative to a root joint, and tangent evolution preserves input bone lengths throughout generation. We train a learned velocity field through conditional flow matching along geodesic paths connecting random trajectories centered on the last-observed pose to recorded future trajectories. Experiments on the Archive of Motion capture As Surface Shapes (AMASS) dataset evaluate prediction accuracy, diversity calibration, and motion statistics. We demonstrate the contributions of spatial and temporal message passing in the developed architecture through an ablation study. GSFM models trained on AMASS also perform competitively on the Human3.6M skeleton without parameter updates or retraining, demonstrating applicability to an unseen skeletal structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图结构流匹配(GSFM)，用一个条件速度场直接生成完整未来骨骼轨迹，通过时空图注意力保证关节与时间交互，并在单位球切空间上演化骨骼方向以保持骨长，在AMASS上实现准确、多样且物理合理的预测。
AI.motivation: 人体运动预测不仅需要准确，还需生成多样且符合骨骼物理结构的未来轨迹。现有方法难以同时满足：骨骼约束限制单帧姿态，协调运动又依赖连接关节间的空间交互与时间瞬刻间的时序交互。因此需要一个能联合建模骨骼约束与时空交互的生成框架。
AI.method: 提出Graph Structured Flow Matching (GSFM)。将完整未来骨骼轨迹作为一个整体，用单一条件速度场进行传输；该轨迹构成时空骨骼图，空间与时间注意力依据骨骼关系和时间偏移耦合其演化。骨骼方向以根关节为参照置于单位球上，通过切空间演化在生成过程中保持输入骨长。以最后观测姿态为中心，构造随机轨迹到真实未来轨迹的地道路径，用条件流匹配训练学习到的速度场。
AI.result: 在AMASS数据集上评估预测精度、多样性校准与运动统计指标；消融实验验证了空间与时间消息传递模块的贡献。在AMASS上训练的GSFM无需参数更新或再训练，迁移到Human3.6M骨骼上仍有竞争力，展现对未见骨架结构的适用性。
AI.conclusion: GSFM通过时空图注意力与单位球切空间演化，在单一条件速度场中统一建模骨骼约束与时空交互，实现了兼具准确性、多样性和物理合理性的人体运动预测，并具备跨骨架结构的泛化能力。

title: KinyaMed: Seeds, Not Rows -- What a Corpus Requirement Written in the Wrong Unit Fails to Constrain
comment: 34 pages, 10 tables, 1 figure. Negative-results and methodology paper; no model performance claims are made
summary: Triage decides who is seen first. Building an urgency classifier for patient-voice Kinyarwanda, we found our specification could be met without producing anything it was meant to secure. We report that, and the instruments that detect it, instead of a classifier. Designed for the four languages a Rwandan health centre receives, with every instrument per-language: sentences are authored in all four arms and rows generate in one, because the frame slots those three need do not exist. Our requirement asked for one million examples; generation produced them in 130 seconds. It fails four of the nine quality gates in that specification, six when rows are attributed to their source sentence. The binding gate counts distinct authored seed phrases, not rows: at our 165, no corpus passes at any row count. Two shortfalls follow and differ: 2,835 further sentences to pass the seed-count gate, 19,835 to reach the stated million rows, because a separate gate caps a seed at 50 rows. Rows come from a machine at 7,700 per second; seeds from clinicians. A row count constrains the cheap quantity, leaves the expensive one free, and so does not constrain quality at all. Two further negatives follow. An evaluation set of 17,942 rows built from nine distinct sentences supports no verdict: our gate, which counts distinct sentences, refuses 38 of its cells and reports nothing. A model trained on a corpus of uniform surface form changes its predicted urgency for 31.5% of inputs under capitalisation and 21.0% under a single typo, reported as measurement and not attribution. A model directory shipped without its tokenizer loads without error and answers its class prior on input it cannot read, with well-formed probabilities. No figure here is evidence of model quality; the contribution is the apparatus and the negative results it produced, reproducible from a clean clone except where marked NOT REPRODUCIBLE.

AI.tldr: 为卢旺达语（Kinyarwanda）患者语音构建分诊紧迫度分类器时，作者发现按规格可满足验收，却无法产出该规格本意要保障的东西；因此改为报告负面结果与检测这些问题的工具集，而非交付分类器。
AI.motivation: 分诊决定谁先被接诊，因此紧迫度分类器的质量直接关系临床排序。作者意在为卢旺达卫生中心接收的四种语言构建患者语音紧迫度分类器，但发现原规格（以一百万行为目标）可能被"形式上满足"而实质上不约束质量，故转向揭示规格缺陷与虚假达标。
AI.method: 面向四种语言、每种语言一套工具：句子在四个分支（arm）中撰写，行仅在其中一个分支生成，因为另外三种语言所需的框架槽位不存在。生成器以机器速度产生行（7,700 行/秒），种子句由临床医生撰写。用九项质量门控检验语料；门控以"不同作者种子短语数"为约束量，并对单一种子设 50 行上限。另构建含 17,942 行但仅来自 9 个不同句子的评测集，并用统一表层形式的语料训练模型以做鲁棒性测量。
AI.result: 生成 130 秒即产出百万级样本，但在九项门控中 4 项不合格；若把行归属到源句则 6 项不合格。当前 165 个种子短语下，任何行数都无法通过种子计数门控。缺口分化：还需 2,835 句才能过种子计数门控，需 19,835 句才能达到规格所称百万行。由 9 个不同句子构成的 17,942 行评测集无法支持任何结论：门控拒绝其中 38 个单元，不报告结果。统一表层形式训练的模型在大写化下改变 31.5% 输入的紧迫度预测，单个拼写错误下改变 21.0%（仅作测量、不作归因）。缺失分词器的模型目录可无报错加载，对无法读取的输入输出其类别先验，并给出形式良好的概率。
AI.conclusion: 行数约束的是廉价量（机器生成），却放任昂贵量（临床医生种子）不受约束，因而完全不约束质量。论文贡献是这套检测工具与它产生的负面结果，而非模型质量证据；除标注"不可复现"处外，可从干净克隆复现。

title: Solving Every Step Is Not Enough: Milestone Oracles Reveal a Composition Gap in LLM Math Reasoning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 47 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can solve every intermediate step of a multi-step math problem on its own and still fail the full problem, even when given a roadmap of the steps and all of their answers. We introduce OracleLadder, a diagnostic evaluation that locates where LLM math reasoning fails by giving the model increasing levels of oracle help. For each problem, a teacher model writes a fixed roadmap of intermediate sub-goals (milestones), and a deterministic symbolic verifier grades every answer. Testing the model with no help, with the roadmap, with the roadmap plus the milestone answers, and on each milestone alone sorts each failure into one of five reasoning gaps. On 354 NuminaMath problems and six models from 8B to 671B parameters (Qwen3, gpt-oss, Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-V3.1), the largest gap for every model is the composition gap, a stricter form of the compositionality gap. It covers 33-48% of problems, and 24-37% after removing problems that an LLM review flags as grading errors. Accuracy and milestone-help recovery rank the two strongest models differently, and two RLVR runs with similar accuracy gains move problems differently. The roadmap effect replicates on MATH500 and AIME 2024/25, per-problem recovery agrees for 83-87% of problems under an independent second teacher, and the help ladder carries over to code generation. We release the data, roadmaps, prompts, and code at https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OracleLadder 诊断评测，通过逐步提供 oracle 帮助定位 LLM 多步数学推理的失败环节，发现各模型最大缺口为"组合缺口"。
AI.motivation: LLM 能独立解出多步数学题的每个中间步骤，却在给定步骤路线图及全部答案时仍可能答错整题，说明失败并非源于单步能力不足，而是步骤组合环节出了问题，现有评测无法定位这一区别。
AI.method: 构建 OracleLadder 诊断评测：由教师模型为每题写出固定的中间子目标（里程碑）路线图，用确定性符号验证器对每个答案打分；分别测试模型在无帮助、给路线图、给路线图加里程碑答案、以及单独解每个里程碑四种条件下的表现，据此把失败归入五类推理缺口；在 354 道 NuminaMath 题目与 8B 至 671B 的六个模型（Qwen3、gpt-oss、Llama 3.3、DeepSeek-V3.1）上验证，并在 MATH500、AIME 2024/25 及代码生成任务上复现，且用独立第二教师验证逐题恢复一致性。
AI.result: 所有模型的最大缺口均为组合缺口（composition gap，组合性缺口的更严格形式），占 33-48% 的题目，剔除 LLM 审核标记的评分错误题目后为 24-37%；准确率与里程碑帮助恢复率对两个最强模型的排名不一致；两次 RLVR 训练在准确率增益相近时对题目的改善分布不同；路线图效应在 MATH500 与 AIME 2024/25 上可复现，独立第二教师下 83-87% 题目的逐题恢复结果一致，帮助阶梯也适用于代码生成。
AI.conclusion: 多步数学推理的主要瓶颈是步骤组合而非单步求解能力，OracleLadder 提供了可定位失败环节的诊断工具，并将数据、路线图、提示与代码开源。

title: Federated Subspace Guided Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation for Non-IID Multi-Robot Manipulation
summary: Federated learning offers a natural way for multiple robots to jointly improve manipulation policies without requiring centralized access to training demonstrations. However, non-IID task and environment distributions can induce representation drift and mutually incompatible robot-policy updates, making naive parameter aggregation destructive. We present FedDRMan, a federated subspace-guided distillation framework for heterogeneous robot manipulation. At each communication round, the server model provides a frozen teacher for local behavior cloning, while low-rank multimodal subspace and action-distribution distillation preserve globally useful representation geometry and policy behavior. To address heterogeneous aggregation, FedDRMan groups clients by update compatibility and maintains a persistent model for each cluster. The server then spectrally rebalances each compatible aggregate to mitigate attenuation of weaker task-relevant robot-policy update directions. Extensive experiments on LIBERO across diverse non-IID settings, heterogeneity levels, client participation variation, together with ablations and aggregation analyses, show that FedDRMan substantially improves knowledge transfer and consistently outperforms strong federated baselines achieving a peak mean success rate of 80.7%, 11.6 percentage points above the strongest evaluated federated baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出FedDRMan联邦子空间引导蒸馏框架，解决异构机器人操作中非IID导致的表征漂移与更新不兼容问题，在LIBERO上平均成功率峰值达80.7%。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可让多机器人协同改进操作策略而无需集中训练示范数据，但任务与环境的非独立同分布（non-IID）分布会导致表征漂移（representation drift）以及机器人策略更新之间互不兼容，使朴素参数聚合（如FedAvg）具有破坏性。
AI.method: FedDRMan：每轮通信中服务器模型作为冻结教师（frozen teacher）指导本地行为克隆（behavior cloning）；同时进行低秩多模态子空间蒸馏与动作分布蒸馏，以保留全局有用的表征几何与策略行为；针对异构聚合，按更新兼容性对客户端分组并维护各簇的持久模型（persistent model per cluster）；服务器再对每个兼容聚合进行谱重平衡（spectral rebalancing），缓解较弱任务相关策略更新方向的衰减。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上跨多种non-IID设置、异构程度、客户端参与度变化开展实验，并辅以消融与聚合分析，FedDRMan显著提升知识迁移，持续优于强联邦基线，峰值平均成功率达80.7%，比最强被评估联邦基线高11.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结教师蒸馏、多模态子空间与动作分布蒸馏、兼容性聚类聚合及谱重平衡，FedDRMan有效缓解异构联邦机器人操作中的表征漂移与更新不兼容，实现更优的知识迁移与操作成功率。

title: Residual Transferability in Neural Image Watermarking
summary: Neural image watermarks can be forged by extracting watermark-bearing residuals from released images and transferring them to unrelated content. While prior work has demonstrated this vulnerability, what makes these residuals transferable remains poorly understood. We formalize this vulnerability with \textbf{residual transferability (RT)}, a metric that quantifies how well watermark evidence remains decodable after transfer across unrelated images. Through comparative analyses and controlled interventions, we find that common training-side variations do not account for the large RT differences across watermarking systems; instead, architectural design plays a central role. By contrasting high- and low-RT systems and validating their architectural differences through controlled interventions, we identify two mechanisms that strengthen the dependence of watermark evidence on the cover image, thereby suppressing the residual transferability. These findings provide concrete design guidance for developing more forgery-resistant watermarking architectures. Complementarily, for existing watermarking systems where architectural redesign is impractical, we introduce \textbf{CoverLock}, a plug-and-play strategy for existing watermarking systems that strengthens such image dependence without architectural redesign. Across representative watermarking systems exhibiting high residual transferability, CoverLock achieves a more favorable security--robustness trade-off than both traditional handcrafted defenses and learned classifier-based defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"残差可迁移性"(RT)指标刻画神经图像水印可被伪造的漏洞,发现架构设计而非训练侧变化是RT差异的主因,揭示两种抑制RT的机制,并提出即插即用策略CoverLock。
AI.motivation: 神经图像水印可通过从已发布图像中提取含水印残差并迁移到无关内容来伪造。已有工作证明了该漏洞存在,但"为何这些残差可迁移"仍缺乏理解,因此需要形式化该漏洞并探究其成因。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"残差可迁移性(Residual Transferability, RT)"指标,量化水印证据在跨无关图像迁移后的可解码程度;2) 通过对比分析与受控干预实验,排除训练侧常见变化的影响,确认架构设计的主导作用;3) 对比高RT与低RT系统,并通过受控干预验证其架构差异,识别出两种增强水印证据对封面图像依赖、从而抑制RT的机制;4) 提出CoverLock——一种无需重新设计架构、可即插即用于现有水印系统的防御策略。
AI.result: 常见训练侧变化无法解释不同水印系统间较大的RT差异,架构设计起核心作用;所识别的两种机制可增强水印证据对封面图像的依赖并抑制残差可迁移性;在多个高RT代表性水印系统上,CoverLock取得比传统手工防御与基于学习分类器的防御更优的安全—鲁棒性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究为设计更抗伪造的水印架构提供了具体指导;对于难以重新设计架构的现有系统,CoverLock提供了即插即用的替代方案,在不改动架构的前提下提升抗伪造能力并改善安全—鲁棒性权衡。

title: Two-Stage Multi-View Gait Recognition with a Re-Embedding Network
summary: Gait recognition always remains challenging due to severe overfitting and the rigid view constraints common in single-stage approaches. We propose a two-stage framework, termed Translate-First-Then-Reason (TFTR), to address these issues. In the first stage, a shallow Siamese convolutional network with triplet loss maps Gait Energy Images (GEIs) into a 128-dimensional view-specific embedding space. In the second stage, these per-view embeddings are treated as tokens and processed by a 12-layer Transformer encoder, which re-projects them into a new space with improved cosine separability. This design enables flexible fusion of an arbitrary number of views at inference, overcoming the fixed-input limitations of prior methods. Trained on the OU-MVLP dataset (6,000 subjects) and evaluated on unseen CASIA-B across normal, bag-carrying, and coat-wearing conditions, our pipeline achieves 96.91\% single-view and 99.49\% three-view accuracy on OU-MVLP, and attains 100\% accuracy on CASIA-B with three views.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段步态识别框架TFTR：先以Siamese网络将GEI映射到视角相关嵌入空间，再用Transformer编码器重投影并融合任意数量视角，实现跨数据集高精度识别。
AI.motivation: 单阶段步态识别方法存在严重过拟合以及视角约束僵化的问题，限制了模型在跨视角、跨数据集场景下的泛化能力。
AI.method: TFTR分两阶段：第一阶段用带triplet loss的浅层Siamese卷积网络，将步态能量图（GEI）映射为128维视角相关嵌入；第二阶段将这些单视角嵌入视作token，输入12层Transformer编码器，重投影到余弦可分性更强的新空间，从而支持推理阶段灵活融合任意数量视角。
AI.result: 在OU-MVLP（6000人）上训练，并在未见过的CASIA-B（正常、背包、穿大衣三种条件）上评估：OU-MVLP单视角准确率96.91%、三视角99.49%；CASIA-B三视角准确率达100%。
AI.conclusion: TFTR通过"先翻译后推理"的两阶段设计，有效缓解过拟合与固定视角输入限制，具备任意视角数目的灵活融合能力，并在跨数据集评测中取得优异性能。

title: RoboSTAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Sign Language Translation for Humanoid Robots
summary: Sign-language interpretation in public communication relies on qualified professional interpreters and can be difficult to scale, motivating robotic signing as a complementary accessibility interface. We present RoBoSTAR, a text-conditioned sign language production (SLP) framework for generating human-centric sign motion that can be retargeted for robotic execution, with speech supported optionally through an external ASR front end. Conventional autoregressive approaches flatten motion into a single full-resolution token sequence, forcing long-range and local dependencies to be modeled at a uniform temporal granularity. RoBoSTAR instead combines part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization with next-scale autoregression, generating motion over progressively finer temporal resolutions while predicting synchronized body and hand tokens in parallel within each step. This coarse-to-fine formulation provides compact long-range context before progressively refining motion details, while self-conditioning and context corruption improve robustness to cross-scale prediction errors. The generated motion is subsequently retargeted for physical humanoid execution. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of RoBoSTAR.

AI.tldr: RoBoSTAR：面向机器人手语生成的文本条件手语生成框架，采用部件级有限标量量化与“下一尺度”自回归，实现由粗到细的时序生成与机器人重定向执行。
AI.motivation: 公共传播中的手语翻译依赖合格专业译员，难以规模化；机器人手语可作为补充性的无障碍交互界面，因此需要能生成以人为中心、并可重定向到机器人执行的手语动作。
AI.method: 提出RoBoSTAR，文本条件的手语生成框架：将部件级有限标量量化（part-wise FSQ）与下一尺度自回归（next-scale autoregression）结合，在逐步细化时间分辨率的同时，于每步并行预测同步的身体与手部token；引入自条件化与上下文扰动以增强跨尺度预测误差的鲁棒性；语音可经外部ASR前端可选支持；生成动作随后重定向至实体人形机器人执行。
AI.result: 通过大量定性与定量评估验证了RoBoSTAR的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
AI.conclusion: 以由粗到细的多尺度自回归替代单序列全分辨率自回归，可在统一框架下生成兼具长程一致性与局部细节的手语动作，并支持向机器人平台重定向，为可扩展的机器人手语界面提供了可行路径。

title: Clarify the User or Verify the World? Uncertainty Routing for Proactive Agents
summary: Tool-using LLM agents must decide not only whether additional information is needed, but also which source can resolve the uncertainty. Existing proactive approaches often specialize in either user clarification or environment verification, without explicitly determining the appropriate information source for each decision. We formulate this problem as uncertainty routing among ACT, CLARIFY, and VERIFY, and propose PROUR, a proactive uncertainty routing framework. PROUR decomposes action uncertainty into disagreement across plausible user-goal interpretations, which signals user-side ambiguity, and the entropy remaining within each interpretation, which signals missing world-side evidence. To acquire information from the routed source, a query generator is trained with a mode-conditioned information-gain reward, targeting user-goal identification under CLARIFY and next-action identification under VERIFY. On $τ$-bench, PROUR achieves 28.17% average success rate across retail and airline, outperforming the strongest prior method by 4.57% while using 2.17 fewer interaction steps. The learned policy further generalizes to stronger task agents and transactional domains of $τ^3$-bench without retraining, demonstrating the benefit of source-aligned uncertainty resolution for proactive agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PROUR，将工具型LLM智能体的主动信息获取建模为ACT、CLARIFY、VERIFY三选一的不确定性路由问题，并据此在τ-bench上取得更优成功率与更少交互步数。
AI.motivation: 现有主动式方法通常只专注于"向用户澄清"或"环境验证"其中一种信息来源，未能针对每次决策显式判断应当从哪一来源获取信息，导致信息获取方式与不确定性来源不匹配。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为在ACT、CLARIFY、VERIFY之间的不确定性路由；把动作不确定性分解为两部分：不同用户目标解释之间的分歧（指示用户侧歧义，路由至CLARIFY）与各解释内部残余熵（指示世界侧证据缺失，路由至VERIFY）。查询生成器以模式条件化的信息增益奖励进行训练：CLARIFY下目标为用户目标识别，VERIFY下目标为下一步动作识别。
AI.result: 在τ-bench上，PROUR在retail与airline两域平均成功率达28.17%，较最强基线提升4.57%，同时交互步数减少2.17步；所学策略无需再训练即可泛化到更强任务智能体及τ³-bench的事务型领域。
AI.conclusion: 按不确定性来源对齐的信息获取方式对主动式智能体有效，显式路由信息来源可同时提升任务成功率与交互效率，并具备跨智能体与跨领域的泛化能力。

title: LANTERN: Illuminating Hidden Mathematical Knowledge in Language Models
summary: Language models can now prove theorems, but people still decide which problems to pursue. We ask whether a model's internal representations can help identify promising mathematical connections. We develop LANTERN, a fast, cost-efficient pipeline that uses a classifier over pretrained-model activations to rank candidate relations, followed by staged filtering, hypothesis generation, executable verification, and analytical checking. Applied to the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS), LANTERN ranked 50 million pairs among 10,000 frequently referenced sequences and produced 62 verified relations between pairs without an existing OEIS cross-reference. A content screen retained 13 relations worth presenting; nine of these are informative or insightful, including four which are entirely novel to the best of our knowledge: none appears in the OEIS or in our targeted literature search. The entire end-to-end process including classifier training, candidate ranking, filtering and verification took under 8 hours.
