AI.tldr: LANTERN利用预训练模型激活的分类器对候选数学关系排序，经分阶段过滤、假设生成、可执行验证与分析检查，在OEIS中从50M配对中筛选出62条无现有交叉引用的已验证关系，其中9条具信息量或洞见性、4条为全新发现，全流程不足8小时。
AI.motivation: 语言模型已能证明定理，但研究选题仍由人决定。作者希望探索模型内部表征能否帮助识别有前景的数学联系，即用模型激活来辅助发现数学对象之间潜在的有价值关系。
AI.method: 提出LANTERN：一个快速、低成本的流水线。先在预训练模型激活上训练分类器，对候选关系进行排序；随后进行分阶段过滤、假设生成、可执行验证与分析检查。应用于OEIS，在1万个高频引用序列间对5000万对配对排序。
AI.result: 从5000万配对中产生62条无现有OEIS交叉引用的已验证关系；内容筛查保留13条值得展示的关系，其中9条具信息量或洞见性，4条据作者所知完全新颖，既未出现在OEIS也未见于针对性文献检索。端到端流程（含分类器训练、候选排序、过滤与验证）耗时不足8小时。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部表征可有效辅助识别有前景的数学连接，LANTERN以低成本、高效率实现大规模候选筛选与验证，并能在OEIS中发现此前未知的序列关系，显示该方法在数学发现中的实用价值。

title: Before Answering: Evidence Sufficiency under Size-Matched Memory Construction
summary: Agents that answer questions from compressed or retrieved memory must recognize when the evidence a query needs is no longer in memory. Benchmarks for this task usually create insufficient-evidence examples by deleting supporting passages. We show that this construction leaks the label through memory size: on MuSiQue, a classifier that only counts paragraphs reaches an area under the ROC curve (AUROC) of $0.979$ for detecting unsafe memory, higher than the lexical estimator we initially evaluated. We propose a size-matched construction that provably removes this shortcut, and use it to study MemSafe, an estimator that cross-encodes the query with each memory unit and aggregates the units with a set transformer. Across three multi-hop question answering datasets and five seeds, MemSafe reaches $0.968$ and $0.983$ AUROC on MuSiQue and HotpotQA, $0.26$ to $0.39$ above a lexical baseline, while the third dataset, 2WikiMultiHopQA, is saturated. A frozen pretrained cross-encoder with a logistic head already closes $41\%$ of the MuSiQue gap between the lexical baseline and MemSafe. At the same time, MemSafe degrades more than a weak baseline on the unanswerable questions released with MuSiQue, reaches only $0.639$ AUROC on SQuAD~2.0, and needs several thousand clinical training examples before it outperforms a feature-based estimator. Used as a gate for a 7B reader, it reduces the error rate on answered questions from $0.850$ to $0.631$ at $5\%$ coverage, outperforming both reader confidence and, on average, the ground-truth integrity label, although a 7B LLM judge is the better gate at $10\%$ coverage. These results indicate that the way insufficient evidence is constructed matters as much as the estimator that detects it.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有不充分证据基准通过删除支撑段落构造样本时，会因“记忆大小”泄漏标签，并提出规模匹配构造法消除该捷径，进而评估跨编码器估计器MemSafe。
AI.motivation: 面向压缩或检索记忆的问答智能体需识别记忆中已不存在所需证据。现有基准用删除支撑段落的方式构造“证据不足”样本，导致记忆规模本身即可指示标签，形成虚假捷径，使评估结果失真。作者希望修正这一构造偏差并可靠衡量证据不足检测器性能。
AI.method: 提出规模匹配（size-matched）构造法，可证明地移除记忆规模捷径；据此研究MemSafe：将查询与每个记忆单元进行交叉编码，并用set transformer聚合各单元。在三个多跳问答数据集和五个随机种子上评估，并与词法基线、冻结预训练交叉编码器加逻辑回归头、弱基线、特征估计器及7B读者门控/LLM裁判对比。
AI.result: 仅计段落数的分类器在MuSiQue上AUROC达0.979，超过初始词法估计器。规模匹配下，MemSafe在MuSiQue与HotpotQA上达0.968和0.983 AUROC，比词法基线高0.26至0.39；2WikiMultiHopQA已饱和。冻结交叉编码器+逻辑头已弥合MuSiQue上词法基线与MemSafe差距的41%。但MemSafe在MuSiQue不可回答问题上有害退化，SQuAD 2.0仅0.639 AUROC，临床数据需数千样本才超过特征估计器。作为7B读者门控，在5%覆盖率下把已回答问题错误率从0.850降至0.631，优于读者置信度及平均而言的真实完整性标签；10%覆盖率下7B LLM裁判更优。
AI.conclusion: 不充分证据的构造方式与检测估计器同等重要；规模匹配构造是消除标签泄漏的必要手段，MemSafe虽在多跳问答上有效，但在分布外、不可回答及小样本临床场景下泛化有限，门控收益随覆盖率变化，需谨慎部署。

title: Learning Through Game: Skewed Transfer of Tabular Knowledge to Strengthen Image Model
summary: Multimodal tabular-image learning is gaining growing attention, yet it faces challenges due to tabular data unavailable at test time. A practical solution involves transferring tabular knowledge to images during training to enhance the performance of image models at inference. However, the overlooked yet important challenges lie in the modality imbalance between images and tables, as well as their asymmetric modality relationship in cross-modal transfer, which limits the auxiliary role of tabular data. To address these issues, we propose Skewed Knowledge Transfer (SKT), which asymmetrically transfers tabular knowledge to improve the image model by adaptive integration of modality gradients in a shared parameter space. Specifically, we first introduce a multimodal shared head, which allows the model to benefit from cross-modal structure without adding additional parameters. We then design a two-step Nash Bargaining strategy to effectively leverage tabular gradients. In the first step, SKT seeks a point of modality balance and uses preference awareness in the second step to steer combined gradients toward image-beneficial directions. Furthermore, we theoretically analyze the Pareto improvement and convergence of SKT. To this end, tabular knowledge is explicitly transferred to enhance image models. Empirical experiments on widely used tabular-image datasets reveal that SKT consistently improves image unimodal performance by using tabular data as auxiliary information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Skewed Knowledge Transfer（SKT），通过非对称迁移表格知识来提升图像模型。它引入多模态共享头与两步 Nash Bargaining 策略，自适应整合模态梯度，在测试阶段无需表格数据。实验表明 SKT 能稳定提升图像单模态性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态表格-图像学习的核心痛点在于测试阶段表格数据不可用，因此需要训练时将表格知识迁移到图像模型。但现有方法忽视了图像与表格间的模态不平衡，以及跨模态迁移中的非对称模态关系，导致表格数据的辅助作用受限。
AI.method: 提出 SKT：（1）设计多模态共享头，使模型在不增加额外参数的情况下利用跨模态结构；（2）采用两步 Nash Bargaining 策略利用表格梯度——第一步寻找模态平衡点，第二步通过偏好感知将组合梯度导向对图像有利的方向，从而实现非对称知识迁移。文中还从理论上分析了 SKT 的 Pareto 改进与收敛性。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的表格-图像数据集上的实证实验表明，SKT 将表格数据作为辅助信息时，能够持续提升图像单模态模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: SKT 有效解决了表格-图像跨模态迁移中的模态不平衡与非对称关系问题，实现了测试阶段不依赖表格数据、仅凭图像模型即可受益于表格知识的实用方案。

title: FSS-UBrain: Multi-region Few-Shot Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation
comment: This work has been submitted to the Elsevier for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Accurate delineation of whole tumor (WT), tumor core (TC), and enhancing tumor (ET) from multimodal magnetic resonance imaging remains challenging under limited annotation, cross-cohort variation, and severe target sparsity. We propose FSS-UBrain, a region-wise one-shot segmentation framework that uses a labeled positive support slice to condition binary query segmentation separately for WT, TC, and ET. Support-derived foreground and background descriptors guide query-feature adaptation, bottleneck interaction, decoder-side reconstruction, and boundary refinement. Episodic training additionally incorporates hard-negative and fully negative queries with empty-query regularization to suppress spurious foreground activation when the selected region is absent. Although inference operates on two-dimensional support--query slice pairs, checkpoint selection, threshold calibration, and final evaluation are performed after volumetric reconstruction. FSS-UBrain is evaluated on a held-out BraTS 2020 split and under target-supported cross-cohort protocols on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa. Cases used as target support are excluded from the query cohorts, and no target-domain fine-tuning or test-time parameter updates are performed. On BraTS 2020, FSS-UBrain achieves volumetric Dice scores of 89.82%, 82.14%, and 77.42% for WT, TC, and ET, respectively, with corresponding 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) values of 11.12, 9.01, and 4.46 mm. It also achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest finite-pair mean HD95 point estimates on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa among the compared few-shot methods. These findings support target-conditioned few-shot segmentation while highlighting sensitivity to support selection and cohort-specific variation.

AI.tldr: FSS-UBrain：区域式单样本分割框架，用一张有标注正支持切片分别条件化WT/TC/ET二值查询分割，结合支持描述子引导的特征自适应与空查询正则化；虽为2D切片推理，但在体数据重建后做检查点选择、阈值校准与评估。BraTS 2020上WT/TC/ET体Dice为89.82%/82.14%/77.42%，HD95为11.12/9.01/4.46 mm，并在BraTS 2023与BraTS-Africa跨队列协议下取得最优的平均Dice与最低有限配对平均HD95点估计。
AI.motivation: 多模态MRI中全肿瘤、肿瘤核心与增强肿瘤的精确勾画在标注受限、跨队列差异以及目标严重稀疏的条件下仍具挑战性，需要一种能在极少标注下保持区域特异性与稳健性的分割方案。
AI.method: 提出FSS-UBrain区域式单样本分割框架：以一张有标注正支持切片分别条件化WT、TC、ET的三类二值查询分割；由支持集导出的前景与背景描述子引导查询特征自适应、瓶颈层交互、解码器侧重构与边界细化。训练采用情景式（episodic）策略，引入困难负样本查询与全负样本查询，并以空查询正则化抑制目标缺失时的虚假前景激活。推理在2D支持-查询切片对上进行，但检查点选择、阈值校准与最终评估均在体数据重建后完成。评估包括BraTS 2020留出划分，以及在BraTS 2023与BraTS-Africa上的目标支持跨队列协议；作为目标支持的病例从查询队列中排除，且不做目标域微调或测试时参数更新。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2020上，WT、TC、ET的体Dice分别为89.82%、82.14%、77.42%，对应HD95为11.12、9.01、4.46 mm。在BraTS 2023与BraTS-Africa上，与所比较的少样本方法相比，其平均Dice点估计最高、有限配对平均HD95点估计最低。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持目标条件化的少样本分割在小样本条件下对多区域脑肿瘤分割的有效性；同时表明该框架对支持切片选择与队列间差异较为敏感，这是实际应用中需重点关注的不确定性来源。

title: HeroFrame-Bench: Reference-Anchored Evaluation via Rubric--Ranking Co-Evolution for Movie Hero Frame Selection
summary: Hero frames are in-film stills used as source imagery for theatrical posters, streaming cover art, film database listings, and other promotional placements. As the first visual entry point, they shape audiences' initial impressions of the movie and their subsequent willingness to watch it. Selecting these frames, a task we term hero frame selection, requires balancing content relevance with aesthetic appeal. A related task is keyframe selection, yet its benchmarks prioritize relevance over aesthetics, using either finite annotations that exclude valid alternatives or VideoQA that entangles selection quality with downstream model capability. We therefore introduce HeroFrame-Bench, built through a scalable VLM-as-a-Judge framework. We construct multimodal contexts from diverse metadata to ground a VLM judge that scores selected frames using our Reference-anchored Percentile. The percentile is obtained by inserting each frame into reusable, pre-ranked reference chains, enabling direct, extensible, and reliable evaluation. To reduce ambiguity and improve consistency in these subjective judgements, we further propose Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution, which generates movie-specific rubrics to condition the VLM judge and refines rubrics jointly with the resulting rankings. Within this process, we introduce several verifiable signals, most notably the Inverted Rubric Attack, to select robust rubrics. Finally, HeroFrame-Bench is instantiated over 204 movies with 2,031 reference chains and 1,970 learned rubrics. We build an annotation interface for human-alignment studies which show that our construction design improves VLM agreement with human from 77.56% to 83.78%. Evaluation on multiple methods show that hero frame selection remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HeroFrame-Bench，首个面向"主角帧选择"（hero frame selection）的评测基准，通过 VLM-as-a-Judge 框架、Reference-anchored Percentile 与 Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution 实现可扩展、可靠的评估，并在 204 部电影上实例化。
AI.motivation: 英雄帧是电影海报、流媒体封面、影库条目等宣传素材的源图像，作为观众的第一视觉入口，直接影响其对影片的初始印象与观看意愿。选取这类帧（英雄帧选择）需在内容相关性与美学吸引力之间取得平衡。然而现有的关键帧选择任务基准偏重相关性而忽视美学：要么使用排除有效候选的有限标注，要么依赖 VideoQA，将选择质量与下游模型能力纠缠在一起，无法直接、可靠地评测英雄帧选择。
AI.method: 1) 构建 HeroFrame-Bench：采用可扩展的 VLM-as-a-Judge 框架，利用多样化元数据构造多模态上下文以对 VLM 评判者进行 grounding。2) 提出 Reference-anchored Percentile：将每帧插入可复用、预排序的参考链中，得到百分位分数，实现直接、可扩展、可靠的评估。3) 提出 Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution：生成影片专属评分细则（rubric）以约束 VLM 评判者，并与排序结果联合迭代优化，降低主观判断的歧义、提升一致性。4) 引入若干可验证信号，尤其是 Inverted Rubric Attack（反向细则攻击），用于筛选鲁棒的 rubric。5) 构建人工标注界面进行人机一致性研究。
AI.result: HeroFrame-Bench 在 204 部电影上实例化，包含 2,031 条参考链与 1,970 个学习得到的 rubric。人机一致性研究表明，该构建设计将 VLM 与人类判断的一致率从 77.56% 提升至 83.78%。对多种方法的评测显示，英雄帧选择仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 本文定义了"英雄帧选择"这一新任务，并提出可扩展、可扩展评测的 HeroFrame-Bench 基准，配合 Reference-anchored Percentile 与 Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution 方法显著提升 VLM 与人类判断的一致性；实验表明当前方法在该任务上表现仍不理想，凸显其挑战性。

title: Supporting and Performing Culture from the Inside
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, To appear in Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026), Budapest, October 2026
summary: Anthropology and related disciplines which study culture have often found it useful to consider their epistemological and methodological approaches in terms of emic versus etic. This is the distinction between the insider perspective, how the world is viewed by a member of the culture, versus the outsider perspective, the scientific cataloguing of cultural knowledge and practice. We adopt this framework to systematically analyse assumptions in recent research on culture in NLP along the full pipeline of task selection, data collection, system design and evaluation. We draw attention to the `culture of NLP' which shapes the research focus and approaches of our field, and suggest pathways towards a more culturally attuned AI.

AI.tldr: 本文借用人类学的"主位/客位(emic/etic)"框架，系统梳理近期NLP文化研究在任务选择、数据收集、系统设计与评估全流程中的隐含假设，指出"NLP文化"对研究取向的塑造作用，并提出走向更具文化贴合性的AI的路径。
AI.motivation: 文化研究类学科常用emic(内部人视角)与etic(外部人视角)这一认识论与方法论区分。作者认为NLP中的文化研究同样受隐含假设影响，需要一个统一框架加以系统审视，以推动AI更好地适配不同文化。
AI.method: 采用概念性/立场性研究(commentary)方法，将emic-etic框架作为分析工具，沿NLP研究全流程(任务选择、数据收集、系统设计、评估)系统分析近期文化相关研究的假设，并提出方法学建议。
AI.result: 识别出NLP文化研究在流程各环节中普遍存在偏向etic视角的假设，并揭示存在一种塑造研究重点与方法的"NLP文化"。
AI.conclusion: NLP研究需要更有意识地平衡emic与etic视角，反思自身领域的"文化"，并提出若干通向更具文化贴合性AI的研究方向。

title: TRAP: Understanding and Mitigating Privacy Memorization in Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on sensitive records can leave it able to reproduce them. We ask when this memorization arises and how to prevent it without knowing in advance which spans are sensitive. Our starting point is that most memorization scores and attacks share one statistical core: whether the model assigns a token more probability than some reference would. Taking as the reference a model trained on the complementary half of the same corpus gives the Target Reference Advantage (TRA), a per-token signal that separates what a model fit to a particular record from what it learned across records, and is cheap and differentiable. We then study what drives memorization during fine-tuning: it keeps growing well past the validation minimum, is larger on small datasets and at higher learning rates, and higher when the underlying task is harder. Early stopping removes much of it, but because it is chosen by aggregate validation loss it helps least for rare, hard-to-predict spans embedded in otherwise learnable text, which is exactly what sensitive information tends to be. We therefore introduce TRAP, a one-sided penalty on tokenwise TRA that acts only where the target model pulls ahead of its reference. On student essays with annotated personal information and clinical cases with patient identifiers, TRAP brings memorization near the level of an untrained model at little utility cost, where generic regularizers barely move and differential privacy gives up most of what fine-tuning bought.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRA统计量与TRAP正则化方法，在不知道哪些片段敏感的前提下，有效抑制微调过程中敏感信息的记忆。
AI.motivation: 微调语言模型可能使其复现敏感记录（如个人信息、患者标识符），而现有方法要么效果有限，要么在训练前无法预知哪些文本片段属于敏感内容。因此需要一种无需预先标注敏感范围即可识别并抑制记忆的机制。
AI.method: 作者观察到多数记忆度量与攻击共享一个统计核心：模型是否给某token分配了高于某个参考模型的概率。以在同一语料另一半上训练的模型作为参考，定义逐token的Target Reference Advantage (TRA)，用以区分模型对特定记录的拟合与跨记录习得的通用知识，该信号廉价且可微。基于TRA提出TRAP：仅当目标模型概率领先参考模型时施加单侧惩罚的正则项。
AI.result: 实验表明记忆在验证损失最低点之后仍持续增长，在小数据集、高学习率、任务更难时更严重；早停虽能消除部分记忆，但对稀有、难预测的片段帮助最小。在含个人信息的作文与含患者标识符的临床病例数据上，TRAP将记忆降至接近未训练模型的水平，且效用损失很小；而通用正则化器几乎无效，差分隐私则牺牲了微调带来的大部分收益。
AI.conclusion: TRAP通过单侧惩罚逐token TRA，在无需预先知道敏感片段的情况下，实现了低效用代价下接近未训练模型的记忆抑制效果，优于常规正则化与差分隐私方案。

title: Agentsensus: Consensus-Compressed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent Story Worlds
summary: A agentic story world is a dynamic system simulating who learned what, when, and from whom -- yet the standard design gives each character a private memory stream. A shared event is therefore stored once per witness, large duplication will be incurred in terms of storage. We present Agentsensus, a story-world simulation framework in which there is an unified long-term memory. Records of the same event merge into one owned by all its witnesses, and semantically relevant memory records are linked. We evaluate on four worlds -- two classical Chinese novels, Hamlet, and a real-world conflict timeline -- run for 40 to 80 rounds against three per-character memory designs under an equal-granularity protocol. Agentsensus writes 22-44% fewer entries than the closest baseline and is the only design whose memory becomes shared (14-28% of records held by more than one character, some by 10) and linked (94-99%), at judged simulation quality indistinguishable or even better than the baselines. An ablation attributes this to the merge itself: disabling it multiplies the store by 3.1x and takes sharing to exactly zero. Sharing also compounds with the horizon rather than saturating early, rising 6% to 9% to 14% as one world is re-run at 10, 20 and 40 rounds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出故事世界模拟框架 Agentsensus，用统一长期记忆替代各角色的私有记忆流：同一事件的记录合并为由全体见证者共有的单条记录，并对语义相关记录建立链接。在四个世界（两部中文古典小说、《哈姆雷特》和一条真实冲突时间线）上运行 40–80 轮，与三种逐角色记忆设计对比，Agentsensus 写入条目减少 22–44%，是唯一实现记忆共享（14–28% 记录被多个角色共有，部分达 10 人）与链接（94–99%）的设计，模拟质量不劣于甚至优于基线；消融显示关闭合并会使存储膨胀 3.1 倍且共享率归零，且共享随模拟轮数累积增长（10/20/40 轮时为 6%/9%/14%）。
AI.motivation: 标准智能体故事世界为每个角色配置私有记忆流，导致同一共享事件按见证者数量重复存储，产生大量冗余。作者希望在不牺牲模拟质量的前提下，用统一长期记忆消除重复，并让记忆在角色间真正共享与关联。
AI.method: 提出 Agentsensus 框架：维护统一长期记忆，同一事件的多份记录合并为一条由所有见证者共有的记录，并将语义相关的记忆记录相互链接。在四个世界（两部中文古典小说、《哈姆雷特》、一条真实冲突时间线）上，以等粒度协议运行 40–80 轮，与三种逐角色记忆设计对比，并做关闭合并的消融实验及不同轮数（10/20/40）的重跑。
AI.result: 相比最接近的基线，Agentsensus 写入条目少 22–44%；是唯一使记忆共享化的设计（14–28% 的记录被多个角色共有，部分被 10 个角色共有）且高度链接化（94–99%），模拟质量经评判与基线无显著差异甚至更优。消融表明收益源于合并本身：禁用合并使存储扩大 3.1 倍、共享率精确降为零。共享效应随模拟时长累积而非早期饱和，同一世界在 10、20、40 轮时共享率由 6% 升至 9%、14%。
AI.conclusion: 统一长期记忆与事件合并、语义链接相结合，可在保持甚至提升模拟质量的同时显著降低记忆冗余，并赋予故事世界记忆以跨角色的共享性与关联性；这些优势随模拟轮数增长而持续放大。

title: Learning Social Navigation from Internet Videos in the Policy State Space
summary: Training robust social-navigation policies requires simulators with diverse scene layouts, terrain, and human motion, but constructing such environments and specifying pedestrian behavior is costly. We propose an efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos directly into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy's state space. Our key observation is that local social navigation primarily depends on two types of information: where the robot can traverse and how nearby pedestrians move. We therefore represent the static scene as a metric traversability map, which can be rigidly transformed under counterfactual robot motion, while directly replaying the pedestrian trajectories recovered from the video over time. This abstraction allows us to define the forward dynamics directly in the policy's state space and efficiently simulate counterfactual robot states without reconstructing or rendering photorealistic observations. The resulting policy achieves 81.2% success in the independent Arena benchmark, compared with 75.0% for the strongest baseline, and succeeds in 19/20 real-robot trials without policy fine-tuning. Project page: https://jiaming.im/VideoSocNav

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效流水线，将普通单目行人行走视频直接转换为闭环社交导航训练环境，在策略状态空间中表示场景与行人，无需重建或渲染逼真观测。
AI.motivation: 训练鲁棒的社交导航策略需要具备多样场景布局、地形与行人运动的仿真器，但构建此类环境并指定行人行为代价高昂。
AI.method: 利用本地社交导航主要依赖两类信息（机器人可通行区域、附近行人运动）的观察：将静态场景表示为度量可通行图，可在反事实机器人运动下进行刚性变换；同时随时间直接回放从视频中恢复的行人轨迹。该抽象使前向动力学可直接定义在策略状态空间中，从而高效模拟反事实机器人状态，无需重建或渲染逼真观测。
AI.result: 所得策略在独立 Arena 基准上取得 81.2% 成功率，最强基线为 75.0%；在 20 次真实机器人试验中成功 19 次，且无需策略微调。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以低成本将单目行走视频转化为闭环社交导航训练环境，在仿真基准与真实机器人上均表现优异，验证了基于可通行图与轨迹回放的状态空间抽象的有效性。

title: One Perception, All Maneuvers: Directional Traffic Signal Understanding for Maneuver-Level Signal Intent Prediction
summary: Traffic lights are a key regulatory signal for autonomous driving at urban intersections, yet existing traffic signal perception is still predominantly formulated as instance-level detection or color recognition. Such formulations identify where traffic lights are and what colors they display, but leave a critical semantic gap before downstream planning: which ego maneuver is controlled by each visible signal and what dynamic permission the signal expresses for that maneuver. In this paper, we formulate Directional Traffic Signal Understanding, a decision-oriented task that predicts structured signal states for straight, left-turn, right-turn, and U-turn maneuvers from a front-view image. Each state contains the associated signal color and signal-implied passability. Based on OpenLane-V2, we provide a direction-level benchmark with maneuver-level supervision and metrics for color recognition, passability, full-frame consistency, and safety-critical errors. A direction-aware baseline combines global context, localized traffic-light evidence, and maneuver-specific representations. Experiments show that direction-level modeling improves passability prediction over image-level classifiers and detection-oriented pipelines, particularly at complex multi-signal intersections. The resulting representation provides a direct and interpretable traffic-signal interface for downstream planning together with topology, route, and surrounding-agent information.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"方向性交通信号理解"任务，从单张前视图像为直行、左转、右转、掉头四种驾驶动作预测结构化信号状态（颜色+可通行性），并基于OpenLane-V2构建方向级基准与基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有交通信号感知多被建模为实例级检测或颜色识别，只能回答"信号在哪里、显示什么颜色"，却无法回答下游规划真正关心的"哪个信号控制哪个自车动作、该信号表达何种动态通行许可"，存在关键语义鸿沟。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为"方向性交通信号理解"，按驾驶动作（直行/左转/右转/掉头）预测结构化状态，每个状态包含信号颜色与信号隐含的可通行性；基于OpenLane-V2构建带动作级监督的方向级基准，并设计颜色识别、可通行性、全帧一致性及安全关键错误等指标；提出方向感知基线，融合全局上下文、局部交通灯证据与动作特定表示。
AI.result: 实验表明，方向级建模在可通行性预测上优于图像级分类器和以检测为导向的流水线，在复杂多信号交叉口尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 该表示可为下游规划提供直接、可解释的交通信号接口，并与拓扑、路线及周围智能体信息协同使用。

title: What Can a Leaderboard Certify? Compositional Controllability for Fair Evaluation and Training of Biomedical Literature-Review Agents
comment: 33 pages, 1 figure, 18 tables. Zhaowei Han, Xiang Zhang, and Lingxiao Guan contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/shawnzhg/LitReview-SCRIBE
summary: Leaderboards rank long-horizon agents by their final outputs. Yet a higher score alone does not establish whether two systems are comparable or which stage accounts for the difference. Unequal evidence, inputs, or budgets can affect scores, and statistical corrections do not remove this mismatch. We introduce compositional controllability to address these questions. A comparison window covers one stage, several stages, or the whole agent. Our central result bounds the gap between observed and controlled score differences using only nuisance outside the window. This yields an admissibility test applied before scores are inspected. Inadmissible comparisons are refused. For admissible pairs, an ordering is certified only when the score gap exceeds the combined sampling and nuisance radii; otherwise, it remains undecided. These decisions give each system a rank interval. We introduce BioLitBench, a benchmark of 2,042 biomedical articles represented as structured claim graphs. Among seven published pipelines, a conventional statistical analysis declares a winner in 14 of 21 pairwise comparisons. Yet the top-ranked system alone received the target review's bibliography. To isolate pipeline performance, our test requires matched inputs and a fixed backbone model. It refuses 11 of the 21 comparisons, including every comparison involving the top-ranked system. Seven of the 14 conventional conclusions fall within these refused pairs. The same comparison windows support stage-level training. We train SCRIBE on Qwen3.8-27B using rewards measured at each stage's exit. Under matched evidence, SCRIBE achieves a certified rank interval of [1,2], with certified advantages over all evaluated published pipelines and the evaluated Claude and OpenAI agents. Under same pool, SCRIBE matches the strongest published retriever and is certified above three published pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出"组合可控性"框架，用比较窗口与不匹配量界定得分差的可认证性，并构建BioLitBench验证：21组比较中11组被拒，SCRIIBE在受控条件下获认证排名区间[1,2]。
AI.motivation: 现有榜单仅依据最终输出对长程智能体排序，高分本身无法说明两个系统是否可比、差异源于哪个阶段。证据、输入或预算的不对等会污染得分，而统计校正无法消除这种不匹配，因此需要一个在查看得分前即可判定比较是否合法的机制。
AI.method: 引入"组合可控性"，定义覆盖单阶段、多阶段或整体智能体的比较窗口；核心结论用窗口外的干扰量给出观测得分差与受控得分差之差的界，从而形成预先执行的"可采纳性检验"。对可采纳对，仅当得分差超过采样半径与干扰半径之和时才认证排序，否则判为未定，并据此为每个系统给出排名区间。同时构建BioLitBench——2,042篇生物医学文献的结构化主张图基准，要求匹配输入与固定骨干模型以隔离流水线性能，并将比较窗口用于阶段级训练（SCRBE，基于Qwen3.8-27B，按各阶段出口奖励训练）。
AI.result: 在七个已发表流水线中，传统统计分析在21组两两比较中有14组宣布胜者；但排名第一的系统独享了目标综述的参考文献。可控性检验拒绝21组中的11组，包括涉及该系统全部比较；14个传统结论中有7个落在被拒对内。受控条件下，SCRBE取得认证排名区间[1,2]，对全部已评估的已发表流水线以及Claude、OpenAI智能体均有认证优势；在同池条件下，匹配最强已发表检索器，并认证优于三个已发表流水线。
AI.conclusion: 得分高低不足以支撑系统可比性与排序宣称；应先在窗口内检验可采纳性再解读分数，并将不可认证的比较明确拒绝或标为未定，输出排名区间而非单一序位。该框架还能将比较窗口复用于阶段级训练，从而同时提升评价严谨性与系统性能。

title: FoundDSR: A Generalizable Foundation Model with Guided 2D Gaussian Splatting for Depth Super-Resolution
summary: We introduce FoundDSR, a generalizable foundation model for robust depth reconstruction across unseen data distributions using RGB-D pairs. FoundDSR begins with a guided 2D Gaussian Splatting strategy to model depth representations with Gaussian primitives. This strategy employs high-resolution RGB as prompts to optimize the Gaussian parameters, thereby encouraging each Gaussian primitive to anisotropically deform along high-frequency structural directions. The resulting Gaussian-upsampled representations are then mapped to high-resolution depth through an effective depth reconstruction branch. Furthermore, to mitigate training instability and bias toward dominant sources caused by distribution gaps in large-scale heterogeneous data, we introduce heterogeneous federated learning that allocates each data source to an independent client for local optimization and global aggregation. This design effectively endows FoundDSR with stable scalability to diverse and large-scale training data. Extensive zero-shot evaluations on synthetic, real-world, arbitrary-scale, and noisy conditions demonstrate that FoundDSR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, confirming its strong robustness and generalization to unknown scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出通用深度重建基础模型FoundDSR，结合2D高斯泼溅与异构联邦学习，实现跨未见数据分布的鲁棒深度重建。
AI.motivation: 现有深度重建模型在未见数据分布上泛化能力不足；同时大规模异构训练数据存在分布差异，导致训练不稳定及对主导数据源的偏置。
AI.method: 1）引导式2D高斯泼溅：以高分辨率RGB为提示优化高斯参数，使每个高斯基元沿高频结构方向各向异性变形，得到高斯上采样表示；2）高效深度重建分支将表示映射为高分辨率深度；3）异构联邦学习：将各数据源分配至独立客户端进行本地优化与全局聚合。
AI.result: 在合成、真实、任意尺度及噪声条件下的广泛零样本评测中，FoundDSR持续优于现有最先进方法，验证了其对未知场景的强鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FoundDSR通过高斯泼溅表示与异构联邦学习的结合，具备对多样大规模训练数据的稳定可扩展性，可作为跨分布鲁棒深度重建的通用基础模型。

title: Language Distances are Practical for Equitable Cross-Lingual Transfer
summary: Cross-lingual transfer is strongly conditional on how the source language is chosen, but it is impractical to determine the best candidate source for every target language, especially for low-resource target languages. Language distances are widely used to rank candidate sources due to their correlation with transfer efficacy and applicability in resource-sparse settings. However, the reliability of distance-based rankers across tasks and resource levels remains underexplored. We therefore present the first equity-focused evaluation of paradigms for ranking source languages, studying resource-level inequality and task inequality across ten cross-lingual tasks and two multilingual models. While both inequalities are most pronounced for individual language distances and an English-always baseline, they are substantially reduced by training-free composite distances, and nearly eliminated by trained rankers. We further demonstrate the reliability of rankers using language distances compared to rankers using language model internals. Overall, we find that language distances provide a practical basis for equitable and performant transfer language selection. We recommend using trained rankers when task-specific transfer evaluations are available, and composite distances otherwise.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从公平性视角评估跨语言迁移中源语言排序范式，发现单一语言距离与English-always基线在资源与任务层面不平等最严重，免训练复合距离显著缓解，训练式排序器几乎消除不平等；语言距离排序器比基于模型内部表征的排序器更可靠。
AI.motivation: 跨语言迁移效果高度依赖源语言选择，但为每个目标语言（尤其是低资源语言）逐一确定最佳源语言不切实际。语言距离因与迁移效果相关且适用于资源稀缺场景而被广泛用于源语言排序，然而其在不同任务和资源水平下的可靠性尚缺乏系统研究，尤其缺乏对资源层面与任务层面不平等的公平性考察。
AI.method: 对源语言排序范式进行首次以公平性为核心的评估：在十项跨语言任务和两种多语言模型上，比较个体语言距离、English-always基线、免训练复合距离与训练式排序器，考察资源层面不平等与任务层面不平等；并将基于语言距离的排序器与基于语言模型内部表征的排序器进行可靠性对比。
AI.result: 资源不平等与任务不平等在个体语言距离和English-always基线上最为显著；免训练复合距离能大幅降低这两类不平等；训练式排序器几乎消除不平等。语言距离排序器相较语言模型内部表征排序器表现出更好的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 语言距离为公平且高性能的迁移语言选择提供了切实可行的依据。建议在可获取任务特定迁移评估时使用训练式排序器，否则使用复合距离。

title: Progressive-View On-Policy Distillation for Regional-to-Global Transfer in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Regional-to-global distillation uses crop-conditioned guidance to improve full-image understanding. The challenge is to effectively transfer the teacher's crop-based advantage to the student's full-image inference. We propose progressive-view on-policy distillation (PVD), which shifts the student's view distribution from the crop toward the full image through an intermediate aspect-preserving padded crop. The padded crop preserves regional content while matching the full image's visual-token grid. Across stages, the view mixture assigns increasing probability to the full image. A lightweight regional-advantage weighting reallocates token-level supervision using the crop-conditioned teacher-student log-probability gap. Evaluated under each sampled input, it applies mild reweighting when the gap is small and emphasizes higher-gap tokens when the gap widens. A Jensen-Shannon metric decomposition interprets this schedule as a shift from matched-input imitation toward the deployment objective. Across benchmarks spanning perception, visual mathematics and general multimodal question answering, PVD-full reaches an average accuracy of 77.51 over three seeds, improving on the reward-free distillation baseline by 2.01 points and on its reward-matched variant by 1.00 point. In the reward-free setting, PVD-distill still gains 1.16 points.

AI.tldr: 提出渐进视图在线策略蒸馏（PVD），通过从裁剪图经保持长宽比的填充裁剪过渡到全图，将教师的区域优势迁移到学生的全图推理中。
AI.motivation: 区域到全局蒸馏利用裁剪条件引导提升全图理解，难点在于如何把教师基于裁剪的优势有效传递到学生的全图推理上。
AI.method: PVD 将学生视图分布从裁剪逐步移向全图：中间视图为保持内容、匹配全图视觉token网格的填充裁剪；各阶段视图混合中全图概率递增。用轻量区域优势加权，依据裁剪条件教师-学生对数概率差重分配token级监督：差小时温和重加权，差变大时强调高差token。并用Jensen-Shannon度量分解解释该调度从匹配输入模仿转向部署目标。
AI.result: 在感知、视觉数学与通用多模态问答基准上，PVD-full三个种子平均准确率77.51，较无奖励蒸馏基线提升2.01分，较奖励匹配变体提升1.00分；无奖励设置下PVD-distill仍提升1.16分。
AI.conclusion: 渐进视图在线策略蒸馏通过视图分布渐进迁移与区域优势加权，有效实现区域到全局的知识迁移，在多个多模态基准上取得一致提升。

title: SGA-Flow-GRPO: Spatial Gradient-Guided Credit Assignment for Flow-GRPO
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has proven effective in aligning flow-based generative models with human preferences. Recently, Flow-GRPO has emerged as an efficient critic-free paradigm by calculating advantages over sampled candidate trajectories. However, standard Flow-GRPO applies a uniform scalar advantage across both temporal denoising steps and spatial latent dimensions, without explicitly accounting for the spatial structure of generated images, which may lead to sub-optimal policy updates. To address this, we propose a novel gradient-guided spatial credit assignment framework tailored for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). We first reformulate the transition-level log-likelihood in Flow-GRPO into a token-wise representation natively aligned with DiT patch architectures, constructing spatially fine-grained importance sampling ratios. To allocate localized credit without rigid, boundary-sensitive segmentation heuristics, we introduce a continuous spatial credit map derived from reward gradients. Crucially, we employ an outlier-robust normalization scheme based on Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) coupled with temperature scaling, effectively eliminating gradient noise while highlighting functional prompt-aligned regions. Extensive evaluations on GenEval show that our approach delivers SOTA alignment quality, achieving a convergence rate comparable to top-tier methods like DiffusionNFT while substantially improving upon Flow-GRPO-based methods in alignment performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向DiT的梯度引导空间信用分配框架，将Flow-GRPO的转移级对数似然转为与patch对齐的token级表示，并用基于奖励梯度的连续空间信用图（MAD归一化+温度缩放）实现细粒度信用分配，在GenEval上取得SOTA对齐质量与更快的收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 标准Flow-GRPO在每个采样轨迹上计算优势，并将统一的标量优势应用于所有时间去噪步和空间隐变量维度，未显式考虑生成图像的空间结构，导致策略更新次优，即空间信用分配过于粗糙。
AI.method: 首先将Flow-GRPO中的转移级对数似然重构为与DiT patch架构原生对齐的token级表示，构造空间细粒度的重要性采样比；其次引入由奖励梯度导出的连续空间信用图，避免依赖边界敏感的刚性分割启发式；最后采用基于中位绝对偏差（MAD）的离群值鲁棒归一化并结合温度缩放，抑制梯度噪声并突出与提示对齐的功能性区域。
AI.result: 在GenEval上的大量评测表明，该方法达到SOTA对齐质量，收敛速度与DiffusionNFT等顶级方法相当，并在对齐性能上显著优于基于Flow-GRPO的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过token级重要性采样比与奖励梯度驱动的连续空间信用图，可在无critic的Flow-GRPO范式下实现DiT的空间细粒度信用分配，提升对齐质量与收敛效率。

title: OpenMASC: An Open-Source Pipeline for Cross-Trajectory Metal-Aware Sampling and Correction in Accelerated MRI
summary: Metal implants corrupt MRI measurements throughout $k$-space, yet existing accelerated MRI methods assume clean data and most metal artifact reduction approaches assume fully sampled acquisitions. No public dataset provides paired $k$-space and images with and without metal for the same anatomy, and no framework jointly addresses artifact-aware acquisition and reconstruction across sampling trajectories. We present OpenMASC, an open-source pipeline covering the full workflow from data generation to deployment. A physics-based data generation module converts public CT volumes into paired clean and metal-corrupted MRI data in both Cartesian and radial formats. MA-VarNet, an unrolled reconstruction network with a per-cascade DC Rectifier, corrects artifacts that data-consistency steps reintroduce from corrupted measurements. A reinforcement learning agent actively selects $k$-space readouts and co-trains with the reconstruction network through a decoupled three-stage procedure. The framework is trajectory-agnostic except for the data-consistency operator, supporting both Cartesian and radial acquisition without architectural changes. Experiments on two datasets at $4\times$ and $8\times$ acceleration demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional and learned baselines on both trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenMASC开源流程，联合解决金属伪影下的MRI采集与重建，包含物理数据生成、MA-VarNet重建网络和强化学习采样代理，在笛卡尔与径向轨迹上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 金属植入物会污染整个k空间的MRI测量，但现有加速MRI方法假设数据干净，多数金属伪影抑制方法假设全采样；缺乏同一解剖结构含/不含金属的配对k空间与图像公开数据集，也没有框架能跨采样轨迹联合处理伪影感知的采集与重建。
AI.method: 构建OpenMASC开源流程，覆盖从数据生成到部署的全流程：1）基于物理的数据生成模块，将公开CT体数据转换为笛卡尔与径向两种格式的配对干净/金属污染MRI数据；2）MA-VarNet，一种展开式重建网络，含逐级联DC Rectifier，用于修正数据一致性步骤从污染测量中重新引入的伪影；3）强化学习代理主动选择k空间读出轨迹，并通过解耦的三阶段流程与重建网络协同训练；除数据一致性算子外，框架与轨迹无关，无需架构改动即可支持两种采集轨迹。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上，于4倍与8倍加速条件下，在笛卡尔和径向两种轨迹上均相较传统与学习方法基线取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: OpenMASC首次提供配对含金属MRI数据生成与轨迹无关的伪影感知采集-重建联合框架，验证了采样与重建协同优化在金属伪影场景下的有效性。

title: EyeVQA: Benchmarking Ophthalmic Vision-Language Models from Recognition to Spatial Grounding
comment: Accepted to MICCAI 2027 CREATE Workshop. 19 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for medical image understanding, yet their capabilities in ophthalmic imaging remain insufficiently characterized. Existing ophthalmic datasets are typically designed for individual diseases or specialized tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate whether VLMs can move beyond disease recognition toward comparative reasoning and fine-grained spatial grounding. We introduce EyeVQA, a unified visual question answering benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of ophthalmic VLMs. EyeVQA is constructed from 21 available ophthalmic datasets and contains 20,000 question-answer pairs spanning six disease groups and seven question types: Single-Choice, Multi-Select, Variable-Select, True-False, Ranking, Point Location, and Bounding Box. Gold answers are deterministically derived from source-provided diagnoses, severity grades, clinical findings, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and anatomical landmarks, enabling reproducible evaluation without relying on model-generated annotations. Notably, 44.5% of the questions require reasoning across multiple images, extending evaluation beyond conventional single-image medical VQA. We benchmark fourteen representative general-purpose, scientific, and medically specialized VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The best-performing model only achieves an overall score of 62.8, while substantial gaps remain in spatial grounding and cross-task generalization. These results highlight the limitations of current VLMs in comprehensive ophthalmic visual understanding and establish EyeVQA as a diagnostic benchmark for developing more reliable and spatially grounded ophthalmic multimodal models. The project page is available at https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EyeVQA——一个面向眼科视觉语言模型的统一VQA基准，含2万问答对、6类疾病、7种题型，44.5%为多图推理，评测14个模型显示最优仅62.8分。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在医学图像理解上潜力渐显，但在眼科影像上的能力仍缺乏系统刻画；现有眼科数据集多针对单一疾病或特定任务，难以评估模型能否从疾病识别迈向跨图比较推理与细粒度空间定位。
AI.method: 整合21个现有眼科数据集构建EyeVQA，包含20,000问答对，覆盖6个疾病组与7种题型（单选、多选、可变选择、判断、排序、点定位、边界框）。标准答案由源数据提供的诊断、严重度分级、临床发现、分割掩码、边界框和解剖标志确定性地推导，不依赖模型生成标注。在统一零样本协议下评测14个代表性通用、科学与医学专用VLM。
AI.result: 最优模型整体得分仅62.8，在空间定位与跨任务泛化上仍存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了当前VLM在综合眼科视觉理解上的局限，EyeVQA可作为诊断性基准，推动更可靠、具空间定位能力的眼科多模态模型发展。

title: Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction
summary: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. To stabilize on-policy learning when visual evidence is severely limited, we further introduce a budget-level curriculum that progressively decreases the token budget during training. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B, LT-OPD raises average retained performance under 5% visual-token retention from 68.6% to 82.3%, outperforming training-free, training-based, and reinforcement-learning baselines at the same budget. The gains transfer consistently to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B, and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B. LT-OPD also reduces KV-cache usage by 85.2% and prefill FLOPs by 85.4% without additional inference overhead, demonstrating that on-policy learning can substantially recover capabilities lost to extreme visual-token reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出 LT-OPD 训练框架，通过同策略自蒸馏与预算级课程学习，在极端视觉 token 压缩（5% 保留率）下将 MLLM 平均保留性能从 68.6% 提升至 82.3%。
AI.motivation: 视觉 token 削减可加速多模态大模型，但在极低 token 预算下性能急剧下降。已有工作主要依赖 token 选择或基于训练的适配，本文进一步追问：重度压缩的模型应如何从自身生成所诱导的状态中学习，从而弥补视觉证据严重不足带来的能力损失。
AI.method: LT-OPD 采用同策略自蒸馏：学生模型仅使用小比例视觉 token 自行 rollout 生成响应，冻结的全 token 同源模型在这些学生生成轨迹上提供分布级监督；为稳定视觉证据受限下的同策略学习，引入预算级课程，训练过程中逐步降低 token 预算。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 的九个基准上，5% 视觉 token 保留率下平均保留性能由 68.6% 提升至 82.3%，优于同预算下的免训练、基于训练及强化学习基线；增益可迁移至 Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B 和 LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B。KV-cache 用量降低 85.2%，prefill FLOPs 降低 85.4%，且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 同策略学习能够显著恢复因极端视觉 token 削减而丢失的能力，LT-OPD 在极低预算下兼顾了效率与性能，并具备跨模型的可迁移性。

title: Gradients for Interventions and Activations for Detection: Targeted Feature Learning in Language Models
summary: Model-internal features can be studied through both their ability to identify a specified concept and their causal effect when manipulated, e.g., through steering or weight editing. A prominent approach to feature learning is Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), which learn broad feature dictionaries whose relation to particular concepts is typically identified post hoc. However, many interpretability questions are instead hypothesis-driven and concern a concept specified in advance. We study this setting as targeted feature learning, where a single feature is constructed for such a predefined concept. We present a controlled comparison across three model signals (activation values, activation gradients, and parameter gradients) and two estimators (contrastive mean and a learned one-dimensional encoder-decoder), yielding six targeted methods, with CAA and GRADIEND as existing instances and four new methods covering the remaining combinations. We compare these methods against pretrained SAEs across 15 tasks and three language models, evaluating both detection and causal intervention. Across models, the strongest detection performance is achieved by contrastive activation value methods, whereas the strongest intervention performance is achieved by gradient-based methods. Overall, our results show that targeted feature quality depends jointly on the model signal and estimator, with detection and intervention capturing complementary properties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"定向特征学习"：为预先指定的概念构造单个特征，并在三种模型信号与两种估计器的组合下系统比较六种方法，评估其检测与因果干预能力。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法（如SAE）学习的是宽泛特征字典，概念关联通常是事后识别的，难以回答假设驱动的、预先指定概念的问题，因此需要研究定向特征学习这一设定。
AI.method: 沿两个维度构建受控比较：三种模型信号（激活值、激活梯度、参数梯度）与两种估计器（对比均值、学习式一维编解码器），共六种定向方法，其中CAA与GRADIEND为已有实例，其余四种为新方法；在15个任务和3个语言模型上与预训练SAE对比，评估检测与因果干预。
AI.result: 在多个模型上，检测性能最强的是对比式激活值方法；干预性能最强的是基于梯度的方法。
AI.conclusion: 定向特征质量由模型信号与估计器共同决定，检测与干预反映互补的特性。

title: Black-Box Auditing of Epistemic Reliability in Multi-Agent Debate Distillation
comment: Code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/CSIRO-CQS-AI-alignment-Team/Epistemic-Reliability-Auditor
summary: Debate distillation adapts weaker verifiers using multi-agent debate transcripts to improve their judgement in subsequent debates, but gains on monitored tasks do not establish reliability on related unmonitored tasks. We study epistemic reliability degradation, in which adaptation preserves monitored performance while reducing support for correct responses on hidden tasks. We consider an adversarial debater that manipulates debate arguments while defending the correct monitored response, and ask whether the resulting degradation merely reflects catastrophic forgetting and whether standard evaluation can detect it. To address these questions, we propose ER-Audit, a two-stage black-box auditing framework that compares frozen verifier checkpoints before and after adaptation, and introduce two evaluation benchmarks pairing monitored and hidden task prompts grounded in shared contexts. ER-Audit searches for counterexamples to non-degradation by evaluating semantically valid paraphrases and, if none is found, uses independent paraphrases for sequential hypothesis testing. We derive anytime-valid lower confidence bounds on the non-degradation probability, allowing data-dependent stopping within a finite budget. We further establish a common lower bound across fixed paraphrase distributions and extend it to distributions within a bounded total variation distance of their mixtures. Our experiments show that higher hidden-task accuracy can coexist with more counterexamples to non-degradation and lower non-degradation bounds. This divergence challenges explanations based solely on broad catastrophic forgetting and shows that auditing can uncover selective hidden-task degradation concealed by aggregate performance gains. Our code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/CSIRO-CQS-AI-alignment-Team/Epistemic-Reliability-Auditor.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"辩论蒸馏"适配弱验证器后出现的认识可靠性退化问题，提出两阶段黑盒审计框架 ER-Audit 及相关基准，揭示聚合性能提升可掩盖隐藏任务上的选择性退化。
AI.motivation: 辩论蒸馏通过多智能体辩论记录适配较弱验证器以提升其判断力，但在被监控任务上的增益无法保证其在相关但未被监控任务上的可靠性。作者关注"认识可靠性退化"现象：适配在保持被监控性能的同时，降低了隐藏任务上正确回答的支持度。作者进一步追问：这种退化是否仅源于灾难性遗忘？标准评估能否检测到它？
AI.method: 提出 ER-Audit 两阶段黑盒审计框架，对比适配前后的冻结验证器检查点；构建两个评测基准，将受监控与隐藏任务提示基于共享语境配对。该框架通过评估语义有效的改述来搜索"非退化"的反例；若未找到，则使用独立改述进行序贯假设检验。作者推导了非退化概率的 anytime-valid 置信下界，支持在有限预算内进行数据依赖的停止；并建立跨固定改述分布的共同下界，将其扩展到与混合分布总变差距离有界的分布族。
AI.result: 实验显示，更高的隐藏任务准确率可以与更多非退化反例以及更低的非退化下界共存。这种背离挑战了仅用广泛灾难性遗忘来解释退化的观点，表明审计能够揭示被聚合性能增益所掩盖的选择性隐藏任务退化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，被监控任务上的适配增益不足以证明隐藏任务上的可靠性；ER-Audit 提供了可检测选择性退化的黑盒审计手段，并附有开源代码与基准。

title: StegGNN: Learning Graphical Representation for Image Steganography
summary: Image steganography refers to embedding secret messages within cover images while maintaining imperceptibility. Recent advances in deep learning - primarily driven by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and architectures such as inverse neural networks, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks - have led to notable progress. However, these frameworks are primarily built on CNN architectures, which treat images as regular grids and are limited by their receptive field size and a bias toward spatial locality. In parallel, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently demonstrated strong adaptability in several computer vision tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance with architectures such as Vision GNN (ViG). This work moves in that direction and introduces StegGNN - a novel autoencoder-based, cover-agnostic image steganography framework based on GNNs. By modeling images as graph structures, our approach leverages the representational flexibility of GNNs over the grid-based rigidity of conventional CNNs. We conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets to evaluate visual quality and imperceptibility. Our results show that our GNN-based method performs comparably to existing CNN benchmarks. These findings suggest that GNNs provide a promising alternative representation for steganographic embedding and open the field of deep learning-based steganography to further exploration of GNN-based architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StegGNN，一个基于图神经网络(GNN)的无载体图像隐写自编码器框架，将图像建模为图结构以突破CNN网格化架构的局限，实验表明其性能与CNN基准方法相当，为深度学习隐写开辟了GNN方向。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习图像隐写方法主要依赖CNN及其变体（逆神经网络、自编码器、GAN等），但CNN将图像视为规则网格，受限于感受野大小并存在空间局部性偏置。与此同时，GNN在Vision GNN等计算机视觉任务中已展现强大适应性和SOTA性能，但尚未被引入隐写领域，因此作者希望探索GNN作为隐写嵌入表示的可行性。
AI.method: 提出StegGNN——一种基于GNN的、无载体(cover-agnostic)、自编码器架构的图像隐写框架。核心思想是将图像建模为图结构，利用GNN对非规则图数据的表示灵活性替代CNN的网格刚性约束，从而在隐写嵌入中更充分地建模全局与结构关系。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上进行大量实验，从视觉质量和不可感知性两方面评估。结果显示，基于GNN的方法在性能上与现有CNN基准方法相当(comparable)。
AI.conclusion: GNN为隐写嵌入提供了一种有前景的替代表示，证明图结构建模可用于图像隐写；该工作将基于深度学习的隐写领域开放给进一步的GNN架构探索。

title: An End-to-End Latent-Rollout Approach for Pushing Few-Step ImageNet-$256$ Generation to FID $1.11$ without Fréchet Losses
summary: Iterative generation poses a joint optimization problem across steps, as intermediate predictions shape subsequent computations and ultimately determine the final output distribution. Few-step generators distilled from pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models make such optimization computationally practical end to end. We build on this opportunity with a distill-then-refine approach that uses teacher imitation to establish a strong initialization for a few-step rollout in latent space, then shifts to end-to-end refinement of the complete latent rollout against real data. We introduce FiST (Flow-in-Stage Transformer), an architecture that composes learned latent-state transitions in a few stages using a shared Transformer, with optional cross-stage hidden communication. Distillation applies teacher-forced regression to selected states along teacher trajectories; refinement replaces this supervision with adversarial and auxiliary classification objectives on the final latent output. A trainable discriminator module operates on semantically rich features extracted from clean real and generated latents by a frozen SiT backbone pretrained with REPA. All training takes place in latent space, without image decoding. During refinement, FiST consumes its own intermediate predictions, and endpoint gradients pass through every generation stage. For class-conditional generation on ImageNet at $256\times256$, our approach achieves FID 1.11 (IS 282) with three stages and FID 1.15 (IS 280) with two. These results demonstrate competitive few-step generation through learned distribution-level supervision, without explicit Fréchet-distance minimization. Ablations characterize how distillation, pretrained checkpoint choices, refinement supervision, and cross-stage hidden communication affect generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 FiST（Flow-in-Stage Transformer），通过"先蒸馏后精炼"两阶段方法实现少步生成：先用教师模仿为潜在空间少步采样建立良好初始化，再针对真实数据端到端精炼完整潜在轨迹。在 ImageNet 256×256 类条件生成上，三阶段达 FID 1.11、两阶段达 FID 1.15。
AI.motivation: 迭代式生成本质上是一个跨步骤的联合优化问题：中间预测会影响后续计算并最终决定输出分布。从预训练扩散与流匹配模型蒸馏得到的少步生成器，使这种端到端优化在计算上变得可行，但如何同时兼顾稳定初始化与分布级端到端优化仍未解决。
AI.method: 1) 蒸馏-精炼范式：先用教师模仿（teacher imitation）建立潜在空间少步 rollout 的强初始化，再切换到针对真实数据的端到端精炼。2) 架构 FiST：用共享 Transformer 在少数 stage 中组合学习到的潜在状态转移，并可选跨 stage 隐状态通信。3) 蒸馏阶段对教师轨迹上的选定状态做 teacher-forced 回归；精炼阶段以对抗目标与辅助分类目标替代该监督，作用于最终潜在输出。4) 可训练判别器在冻结的、经 REPA 预训练的 SiT 骨干提取的语义丰富特征上运行。5) 全部训练在潜在空间完成，不做图像解码；精炼时 FiST 消费自身中间预测，端点梯度穿过每个生成 stage。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256 类条件生成：三阶段 FID 1.11 / IS 282，两阶段 FID 1.15 / IS 280。结果表明，通过学到的分布级监督、无需显式最小化 Fréchet 距离，也能实现有竞争力的少步生成。消融实验刻画了蒸馏、预训练检查点选择、精炼监督以及跨 stage 隐状态通信对生成质量的影响。
AI.conclusion: FiST 验证了"蒸馏初始化 + 端到端分布级精炼"这一思路在少步生成中的有效性：不必显式优化 FID，仅靠对抗与辅助分类监督即可达到有竞争力的 FID/IS，且全部在潜在空间完成训练。

title: PlurVA-LLM-2026 Shared Task Track-1: Pluralistic Value Alignment in LLMs via Multilingual Fine-Tuning and Threshold Calibration
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables, Accepted paper at the first workshop on Pluralistic Value Alignment of LLMs @ AACL-IJCNLP 2026
summary: We present our system for the PlurVA-LLM 2026 Shared Task Track-1, which focuses on pluralistic value alignment in the contexts of China, Indonesia, and Sri Lanka. For this resource-constrained track, we fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B Instruct using 4-bit QLoRA. Our approach combines option-permutation augmentation for Chinese data, annotator vote expansion for Indonesian data, and binary reformulation with SinhalaMMLU augmentation for Sri Lankan data. We further applied conditional threshold calibration to the predictions for the Sri Lankan data. The final system achieved accuracies of 0.785 for Chinese, 0.715 for Indonesian, and 0.916 for Sri Lankan, resulting in an overall macro-average accuracy of 0.805.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PlurVA-LLM 2026共享任务Track-1的系统方案，针对中国、印度尼西亚和斯里兰卡三种文化语境下的多元价值对齐，采用4-bit QLoRA微调Llama 3.1 8B Instruct，并结合数据增强与阈值校准策略，取得0.805的宏平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 该任务聚焦于多元文化语境（中国、印度尼西亚、斯里兰卡）下的价值对齐，且属资源受限赛道，现有通用大模型难以直接适配不同地区的价值取向，因此需要针对性地开展高效微调与数据增强。
AI.method: 基于Llama 3.1 8B Instruct进行4-bit QLoRA微调；针对不同语种数据采用差异化增强：中文数据用选项排列增强（option-permutation augmentation），印尼数据用标注者投票扩展（annotator vote expansion），斯里兰卡数据用二分类重构结合SinhalaMMLU增强；并对斯里兰卡预测结果施加条件阈值校准。
AI.result: 最终系统准确率为：中国0.785、印度尼西亚0.715、斯里兰卡0.916，整体宏平均准确率为0.805。
AI.conclusion: 在资源受限条件下，通过参数高效微调（QLoRA）与面向各文化语境的数据增强及校准策略相结合，可有效提升多元价值对齐任务的性能。

title: RefCompose: Multi-Reference Image Generation via LoRA-Conditioned Diffusion
comment: Accepted in ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI for Visual Arts
summary: Filmmakers and visual artists routinely need to compose multiple references, actors, locations, props, cultural elements, into a single coherent shot, but existing tools either fail to scale past a handful of references or destroy fine grained subject identity in the process, since per reference tokenization scales memory linearly with reference count $N$ and generated content often departs from the given references rather than reproducing them. We propose \textbf{RefCompose}, a pixel space compositional conditioning framework that decouples \emph{where} things go from \emph{what} they look like, via a single fixed resolution reference canvas that keeps conditioning size constant regardless of reference count. Spatial layout is induced at inference time from a frozen diffusion transformer and extracted via Grounding DINO, requiring no LLM or dedicated layout model, while dual stream LoRA adapters inject a layout derived depth map and the encoded canvas through separate low rank streams, disentangling geometric scaffolding from localized appearance. On the Dense Layout protocol, RefCompose consistently outperforms layout based and state of the art multi reference baselines on color, texture, shape, spatial accuracy, and identity/content preservation at higher reference counts, all with constant inference memory, making it a practical building block for multi subject cinematic composition at production scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RefCompose，一种像素空间组合条件框架，将"物体放在哪里"与"物体外观"解耦，通过固定分辨率参考画布实现条件尺寸不随参考数量增长，并利用双流 LoRA 注入布局深度图与编码画布，在高参考数量下保持身份与内容还原且推理内存恒定。
AI.motivation: 影视与视觉艺术创作常需将多个参考、演员、场景、道具与文化元素合成为单一连贯镜头，但现有工具要么无法扩展到较多参考数量，要么在过程中破坏细粒度主体身份。其根源在于：逐参考的 tokenization 使内存随参考数 N 线性增长，且生成内容常常偏离而非忠实复现给定参考。
AI.method: RefCompose 在像素空间进行组合条件建模，核心是解耦空间布局与外观。它采用单一固定分辨率的参考画布，使条件尺寸与参考数量无关；推理时从冻结的扩散 transformer 中诱导空间布局，并用 Grounding DINO 提取，无需 LLM 或专用布局模型；再通过双流 LoRA 适配器，将布局导出的深度图与编码后的画布分别经独立的低秩流注入，从而解耦几何骨架与局部外观。
AI.result: 在 Dense Layout 协议上，RefCompose 在颜色、纹理、形状、空间准确度以及身份/内容保持等方面，于更高参考数量下持续优于基于布局的方法和当前最先进的多参考基线，同时推理内存保持恒定。
AI.conclusion: RefCompose 以恒定推理内存实现了高参考数量下的高质量多主体组合，可作为生产级多主体电影化构图的实用构建模块。

title: FA-Bench: A Benchmark for Phone- and Word-Level Timestamp Accuracy in Forced Alignment and ASR on Clean and Noisy Speech
summary: Forced alignment estimates the timestamps of each word, phone or character in speech given its transcript. Published comparisons normalize transcripts, split the data and match boundaries differently, so their numbers cannot be read together. We present FA-Bench, an open framework that fixes those choices once and releases the code, splits, phone mapping, text normalization and scoring script, with results published periodically. Track 1 gives every aligner the reference transcript and Track 2 gives it a recognizer's output, on the same audio, clean and degraded four ways, with 21 open models and 9 commercial APIs under a unified protocol. We score every boundary of an utterance and check the two labels beside it, so a word the recognizer missed or invented is charged. Using a tolerance-based F1 as our primary metric eliminates the 9% to 14% score inflation that standard MAE causes on recognition-dependent systems in conversational speech. We then group boundaries by position and how many adjacent words were recognized correctly, which shows where a system lost the score. We discovered systematic bias in how current systems time words, with Whisper about 150 ms early and several commercial ASR APIs over 50 ms late. Code and results are at https://github.com/olewave/fa-bench

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FA-Bench，一个统一协议下的强制对齐评测框架，固定语料归一化、数据划分、边界匹配等易变选择，公开代码、划分、音素映射与评分脚本，并在周期性发布的榜单上比较21个开源模型与9个商业API。
AI.motivation: 已有强制对齐比较因语料归一化、数据划分和边界匹配方式各不相同，导致结果数值不可直接横向比较，评测结论缺乏可比性与可复现性。
AI.method: FA-Bench将上述选择一次性固定并开源代码、数据划分、音素映射、文本归一化和评分脚本，结果定期发布。设置两条赛道：Track 1提供参考转写，Track 2提供识别器输出，音频相同，包含干净与四种退化条件；统一协议下评测21个开源模型和9个商业API。评分覆盖每句话的每个边界并检查相邻两个标签，从而对识别器漏识或虚增的词进行计分；主指标采用基于容差的F1。此外按边界位置及相邻词识别正确数分组进行分析。
AI.result: 主要指标采用容差F1可消除标准MAE在会话语音中对依赖识别结果系统造成的9%—14%分数虚高；分组分析定位了系统失分环节；发现现有系统在词时间标注上存在系统性偏差，Whisper约提前150 ms，若干商业ASR API则滞后超过50 ms。
AI.conclusion: 统一协议与容差F1指标使强制对齐评测具备可比性和可诊断性，并揭示了现有系统的系统性时间偏差，代码与结果已开源发布。

title: SinBrief: A Hybrid Framework for Abstractive Text Summarisation of Sinhala Legal Documents
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, Accepted paper at the 13th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing (ROCLING) 2026
summary: Legal document summarisation in low-resource languages presents significant challenges due to the scarcity of annotated data and the complexity of domain-specific terminology. This paper presents SinBrief, a hybrid abstractive summarisation framework for Sinhala legal documents that does not require human-annotated training data. The proposed framework combines domain-aware word graph construction with neural sentence scoring to generate abstractive summaries from Sinhala legal text. Five sentence scoring models are evaluated within the framework: mBert, Llama 3.1, Falcon 7B, Laser, and a continually pre-trained Llama model domain-adapted to Sinhala legal text. The framework is evaluated on a Sinhala legal corpus using reference-free metrics, including Coverage, Density, Compression Ratio, SummaC, and Self-BertScore. Experimental results demonstrate that SinBrief produces summaries with lower lexical overlap than extractive baselines while maintaining factual consistency, demonstrating the viability of hybrid, largely annotation-free abstractive summarisation for low-resource legal NLP tasks.

AI.tldr: SinBrief：面向僧伽罗语法律文档的免人工标注混合式生成摘要框架，结合领域词图与神经句子打分，在无参考指标下实现较低词汇重叠且保持事实一致性。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的法律文档摘要面临两大难题：标注数据稀缺，以及领域术语复杂。现有方法多依赖人工标注的训练数据，难以适用于僧伽罗语等低资源法律场景。
AI.method: 提出SinBrief混合式生成摘要框架，无需人工标注训练数据。框架将领域感知词图构建与神经句子打分相结合，从僧伽罗语法律文本生成摘要。评估了五种句子打分模型：mBert、Llama 3.1、Falcon 7B、Laser，以及在僧伽罗语法律文本上持续预训练的领域自适应Llama模型。
AI.result: 在僧伽罗语法律语料上使用无参考指标评估，包括Coverage、Density、Compression Ratio、SummaC和Self-BertScore。实验结果表明，SinBrief生成的摘要相比抽取式基线具有更低的词汇重叠，同时保持事实一致性。
AI.conclusion: 验证了混合式、基本无需标注的生成摘要方法在低资源法律NLP任务中的可行性。

title: Endo-TSR: Temporal Spectral Modeling of Appearance and Motion for Endoscopic Reconstruction
summary: Endoscopic scene reconstruction requires modeling tissue motion and temporal appearance while recovering fine surface detail. Deformable Gaussian models provide explicit trajectories, but their fixed colour coefficients lack a dedicated temporal representation for photometric changes. We propose Endo-TSR, which augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier colour residuals and independent translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies. The colour residuals capture local appearance changes, while a Matérn spectral prior regularises motion corrections. Multi-scale Laplacian supervision guides tissue-detail recovery during joint image fitting. Extensive experiments on the EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art rendering quality, with the highest PSNR across all evaluated sequences. Ablation studies show that temporal appearance yields the largest PSNR gain among the tested component additions, while appearance and detail supervision jointly improve rendering with fixed Gaussian counts.

AI.tldr: 提出 Endo-TSR，将可变形高斯泼溅与有界傅里叶颜色残差和独立平移残差结合，在内窥镜场景重建中实现最优渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜场景重建需同时建模组织运动、外观随时间变化以及精细表面细节。可变形高斯模型虽能提供显式轨迹，但其固定的颜色系数缺乏专门的时间表示，无法刻画光度变化，限制了动态外观建模能力。
AI.method: 在可变形高斯泼溅基础上引入共享时间频率下的有界傅里叶颜色残差与独立平移残差。颜色残差刻画局部外观变化；用 Matérn 谱先验对运动修正进行正则化；并采用多尺度拉普拉斯监督在联合图像拟合中引导组织细节恢复。
AI.result: 在 EndoNeRF 与 StereoMIS 数据集上取得最优渲染质量，在所有评测序列上获得最高 PSNR。消融实验显示，在测试的各组件中时间外观带来的 PSNR 提升最大；在固定高斯数量下，外观监督与细节监督共同改善渲染效果。
AI.conclusion: 引入专门的时间外观表示与细节监督，可有效提升可变形高斯模型在内窥镜动态场景中的重建与渲染性能，验证了外观建模对整体质量贡献最大。

title: Shared Worlds, Private Minds: Structured Memory for Long-Form Writing as World Creation
summary: LLM agents that write long-form fiction need an explicit memory of the evolving storyworld to keep new events consistent with established facts. Such memory must keep heterogeneous narrative information distinct, integrate story developments across granularities, and recover dependencies that a writing request leaves implicit. We present NarraWorld, a structured memory system for long-form writing that treats memory construction as world creation. From a shared evidence-grounded graph, NarraWorld derives four connected views: world facts, per-character beliefs, open developments, and hypothetical branches (possible-world continuations). Hierarchical aggregation with atomic closure consolidates events into scenes, plotlines, and plots, keeping each higher-level node traceable to its constituent source spans. For retrieval, planned reconstruction infers a query's dependencies from the current narrative situation and a preview of memory, then assembles the relevant records within a token budget. Across three writing benchmarks, NarraWorld achieves the strongest aggregate results. Its memory also transfers to situated role-playing and largely preserves recall on a general-purpose long-term memory benchmark, paving the way for agents that sustain coherent storyworlds across diverse narrative tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 NarraWorld——面向长篇小说的结构化记忆系统，将记忆构建视为"世界创造"，从同一证据图派生四类关联视图，并用计划式重建检索，提升写作一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体撰写长篇小说时，需要显式记忆不断演化的故事世界，以保证新事件与既有事实一致。这种记忆需满足三点：区分异质叙事信息、跨粒度整合故事进展、恢复写作请求中隐含的依赖关系。
AI.method: NarraWorld 将记忆构建视为世界创造。从共享的证据落地图（evidence-grounded graph）派生四个相互连接的视图：世界事实、逐角色信念、开放进展、假设分支（可能世界延续）。采用层级聚合与原子闭合，把事件整合为场景、情节线和情节，并保持高层节点可追溯到组成它的源文本片段。检索阶段使用计划式重建：依据当前叙事情境与记忆预览推断查询依赖，再在 token 预算内装配相关记录。
AI.result: 在三个写作基准上取得最强的综合结果；其记忆可迁移到情境化角色扮演，并在通用长期记忆基准上基本保持召回能力。
AI.conclusion: NarraWorld 为智能体在多样化叙事任务中维持连贯故事世界提供了可行路径。

title: Toward On-Chip Training of Spiking Neural Networks for Dense Event-Based Vision
summary: Event cameras provide low-latency, asynchronous visual sensing for resource-constrained robotics. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) process event streams naturally, but training deep SNNs with backpropagation through time (BPTT) requires substantial memory and remains difficult on neuromorphic hardware. Local learning avoids this by restricting error propagation to local blocks, but existing methods mainly target classification rather than dense prediction. We introduce DELL (Dense Event-driven Local Learning), a block wise scheme for dense event-based vision that replaces global gradient propagation with local dense supervision. Learnable, spatially structured local heads supervise each block at its appropriate resolution while preserving temporal dynamics within blocks. We evaluate DELL on optical-flow regression and semantic segmentation with a fully spiking U-shaped architecture. On DSEC optical flow, DELL reduces peak training memory by 39.6% relative to end-to-end BPTT while improving accuracy, reaching 1.670 px endpoint error on the official test benchmark versus 1.941 px for the same backbone trained end-to-end. Block detachment behaves more like a regularizer than a constraint. DECOLLE, the existing local-learning baseline, relies on fixed random local read-outs poorly suited to dense regression, resulting in a 3.9x higher endpoint error; learnable local heads recover this loss and outperform end-to-end training across all optical-flow metrics. On segmentation, they recover most of the performance gap, although DELL remains a few mIoU points behind end-to-end training. With 2.3M parameters, 24x fewer than the strongest SNN baseline, the backbone remains competitive with the SNN state of the art on DSEC. These results extend local learning to dense event-based prediction while substantially reducing training memory.

AI.tldr: DELL提出一种分块局部学习方案，用可学习的空间结构化局部头替代全局梯度传播，实现事件相机上的稠密预测（光流与分割），在降低训练内存的同时提升光流精度。
AI.motivation: 事件相机适合资源受限机器人，SNN可自然处理事件流，但BPTT训练深层SNN内存开销大且难以在神经形态硬件上实现；现有局部学习多针对分类任务，缺乏面向稠密预测的方案。
AI.method: DELL采用块级局部稠密监督：用可学习、空间结构化的局部头在各块对应分辨率上进行监督，并在块内保留时间动态，以替代全局梯度传播；基于全脉冲U形架构，在光流回归与语义分割任务上验证。
AI.result: DSEC光流上，DELL相对端到端BPTT降低峰值训练内存39.6%且精度更优，官方测试集端点误差1.670 px vs 端到端1.941 px；DECOLLE因固定随机读出误差高3.9倍；分割任务中DELL追回大部分差距但仍落后端到端数mIoU；参数量2.3M，比最强SNN基线少24倍，仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将局部学习拓展至稠密事件视觉预测，块解耦更似正则化而非约束，可显著降低训练内存并提升光流性能。

title: Automatic Speech Recognition for the Basaà Language: A Low-Resource Approach
summary: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) has revolutionized the way humans interact with machines. Among the most impactful developments is Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), which enables computers to convert spoken language into text. Systems such as those built on deep neural networks, transformer architectures, and self-supervised learning have achieved near-human performance for well-resourced languages such as English and French. Yet, these advances have disproportionately benefited a small fraction of the world's languages.

AI.tldr: AI与NLP推动自动语音识别（ASR）快速发展，英语、法语等资源丰富语言已接近人类水平，但技术进步仅惠及全球少数语言，语言资源不平等问题突出。
AI.motivation: 揭示当前ASR技术进步与语言覆盖范围之间的严重失衡：主流语言性能已近乎人类水平，而全球绝大多数语言被边缘化，凸显低资源语言语音识别的迫切研究需求。
AI.method: （摘要未涉及具体方法。文中仅提及当前主流技术路线为深度神经网络、Transformer架构与自监督学习，但未提出本文自身的模型或实验方案。）
AI.result: （摘要未报告实验数据或性能指标。仅指出基于上述技术的系统在英语、法语等资源充足语言上达到接近人类的表现，未给出具体数值。）
AI.conclusion: ASR领域存在明显的语言资源偏差：技术红利集中于少数高资源语言，全球大部分语言尚未受益。这暗示后续研究应聚焦低资源语言的语音识别问题。

title: RefAdapt-DiT: Adaptive Joint Attention for Reference-Conditioned Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the standard backbone for high-quality generative modeling, yet deploying them in conditional generation tasks remains computationally prohibitive because bidirectional joint attention repeatedly processes large reference streams. While existing optimization schemes mitigate generic temporal redundancy, they typically rely on coarse-grained static reuse and overlook the distinct dynamics of references and targets. Specifically, we observe that reference representations often evolve slowly along the generation trajectory, while the target often assigns little attention mass to them; reference drift and this target-to-reference exposure jointly shape how strongly stale reference states affect the target. To exploit these patterns, we introduce \RefAdapt, a training-free framework for adaptive control of joint attention between references and targets. Instead of rigid static strategies, \RefAdapt combines consecutive target-Q change with previously observed target-to-reference attention mass to control reference computation adaptively at block granularity. Under ultra-few-step settings, \RefAdapt enables speedups of up to $2.097\times$ on 4-step MiniMax H3 and $3.54\times$ on 8-step Qwen Image Edit, while maintaining comparable visual quality.

AI.tldr: RefAdapt：免训练的自适应联合注意力控制框架，利用目标-Q变化与目标对参考的注意力质量，在块粒度上动态决定参考计算，实现DiT条件生成的加速。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformers（DiTs）已成为高质量生成建模的主流骨干，但在条件生成任务中，双向联合注意力需反复处理大量参考流（reference streams），计算开销极大。现有优化方法多针对通用的时间冗余，采用粗粒度静态复用策略，忽略了参考与目标在动力学上的差异。
AI.method: 观察到两点现象：(1) 参考表示沿生成轨迹演化缓慢（reference drift）；(2) 目标对参考分配的注意力质量往往很小。二者共同决定过期参考状态对目标的影响强度。基于此提出RefAdapt——免训练框架，将连续的target-Q变化与历史观测到的target-to-reference注意力质量结合，在block粒度上自适应控制参考计算，替代刚性静态策略。
AI.result: 在超少步（ultra-few-step）设置下，4步MiniMax H3上取得最高2.097倍加速，8步Qwen Image Edit上取得3.54倍加速，同时保持可比的视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: RefAdapt通过对参考token的差异化、自适应复用，在条件生成中有效降低了DiT联合注意力的计算成本，且无需额外训练，兼顾了效率与生成质量。

title: CityToolVQA: Tool-Augmented Visual Question Answering for 3D Spatial Cognition in Urban Low-Altitude Environments
summary: CityToolVQA addresses the weak performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on quantitative tasks in urban low-altitude visual question answering. We divide the seven tasks into qualitative and quantitative groups: qualitative questions are answered directly by the VLM, whereas quantitative questions are handled by an external visual-geometric toolchain that performs object grounding, segmentation, depth back-projection, and spatial computation. The toolchain can be attached to different VLMs in a zero-shot manner; a Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference (DAPI) fallback is triggered when the main-chain detection is invalid or unreliable, and CityToolVQA-SFT adapts the 8B backbone to tool-conditioned inputs. On the 73,324-question Open3D-VQA-v2 test set, CityToolVQA-SFT (Qwen3-VL-8B) reaches 67.6% overall accuracy, and attaching the toolchain to ten open-source VLMs improves quantitative-task accuracy by 12.7-36.9 percentage points. These results indicate that externalizing explicit 3D geometric computation effectively complements the limited ability of RGB-only VLMs to estimate metric distances and object sizes.

AI.tldr: CityToolVQA将城市低空视觉问答任务分为定性与定量两类，定性题由VLM直接回答，定量题交由外部视觉-几何工具链处理，从而显著提升定量任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在城市低空视觉问答的定量任务上表现薄弱，尤其是基于RGB输入难以估计度量距离和物体尺寸。
AI.method: 将七类任务划分为定性与定量两组：定性问题由VLM直接作答，定量问题由外部视觉-几何工具链处理，工具链包含目标定位、分割、深度反投影与空间计算。工具链可以零样本方式挂载到不同VLM；当主链检测无效或不可靠时，触发深度辅助提示推理（DAPI）回退机制；CityToolVQA-SFT将8B骨干网络适配到工具条件输入。
AI.result: 在73,324题的Open3D-VQA-v2测试集上，CityToolVQA-SFT（Qwen3-VL-8B）总体准确率达67.6%；将工具链挂载到十种开源VLM后，定量任务准确率提升12.7–36.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将显式3D几何计算外部化，能有效弥补仅依赖RGB的VLM在度量距离与物体尺寸估计上的能力不足。

title: DualGuard: Dual-Mode Quality Control for Logic-Preserving Data Augmentation
summary: Large language models provide a practical way to generate augmented data for logical reasoning at scale, but a larger generation volume does not guarantee semantic, label, or logical reliability. Existing work has improved generation quality through generation constraints, candidate validation, filtering, and feedback-based revision; however, once a quality judgment is available, deciding whether a candidate should be retained, filtered, or repaired remains an important control problem. We propose DualGuard, a dual-mode quality-control framework for logic-preserving data augmentation. The first mode uses the current instance and candidate batch for selective retention, filtering, attribution, and targeted feedback. The second mode accumulates cross-instance execution records of augmentation actions on top of per-sample diagnosis and attribution, compares new executions against each action's own historical behavior, and supports retrospective anomaly inspection, targeted rollback, and bounded repair. Both modes share semantic verification and additionally use symbolic verification when a reliable logical form is available. Across seven downstream tasks in the Two-Stage Transfer setting, DualGuard achieves the highest Accuracy on five tasks and outperforms the no-augmentation BERT baseline on all seven. Controlled ablations further show complementary roles for Memory, Z3, and history-aware anomaly control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DualGuard，一种用于逻辑保持数据增强的双模式质量控制框架，通过选择性保留、过滤、归因与定向反馈，以及跨实例历史异常检测、定向回滚与有界修复，提升逻辑推理增强数据的语义、标签与逻辑可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可用于规模化生成逻辑推理增强数据，但生成量增大并不保证语义、标签或逻辑的可靠性。现有工作虽通过生成约束、候选验证、过滤和反馈修正提升质量，但在获得质量判断后，如何决定候选应被保留、过滤还是修复，仍是一个重要的控制问题。
AI.method: 提出DualGuard双模式质量控制框架。模式一基于当前实例与候选批次进行选择性保留、过滤、归因和定向反馈；模式二在单样本诊断与归因基础上，累积跨实例的增强动作执行记录，将新执行与各动作自身历史行为对比，支持回顾性异常检查、定向回滚和有界修复。两种模式共享语义验证，并在获得可靠逻辑形式时额外使用符号验证。
AI.result: 在Two-Stage Transfer设置下的七个下游任务中，DualGuard在五个任务上取得最高Accuracy，并在全部七个任务上优于无增强的BERT基线。受控消融实验进一步表明Memory、Z3和历史感知异常控制具有互补作用。
AI.conclusion: DualGuard通过双模式质量控制，将质量判断转化为可操作的保留、过滤与修复决策，并借助历史感知的异常控制实现逻辑保持的数据增强，验证了各组件在提升下游任务性能中的互补价值。

title: Masking Frequent Tokens Sharpens Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns language models by optimizing over sequence-level sums of token-wise implicit reward differences. However, we identify a pervasive pathology in this formulation: a disproportionately small subset of high-frequency token types dominates cumulative sequence scores while appearing symmetrically across both preferred and dispreferred responses. Specifically, under canonical Qwen tokenization on Anthropic HH-RLHF, merely 69 token types account for $55.1\%$ of all response tokens and $85.9\%$ of within-pair shared token mass, exhibiting substantially lower preference-side specificity than the remaining vocabulary. This symmetric ubiquity induces gradient entanglement and dilutes the discriminative preference signal propagated through the objective. To resolve this issue, we introduce \emph{Anisotropic DPO} (\textsf{ADPO}) and its canonical realization, \emph{Frequency-Hard DPO}. Using a fixed, label-agnostic vocabulary mask, our method zeroes the implicit reward contribution of high-frequency response tokens while assigning unit weight to informative positions, thereby suppressing gradient interference without modifying preference pairs, discarding context, or introducing learned parameters. Here, \emph{anisotropy} designates non-uniform token-level objective weighting rather than representational geometry. Extensive empirical evaluations on AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, and Arena-Hard demonstrate that Frequency-Hard DPO consistently outperforms standard DPO across Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B-Instruct, establishing that selectively masking shared high-frequency tokens offers an effective, zero-overhead mechanism for robust preference alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出DPO目标中高频共享词元主导序列得分、稀释偏好信号的病理，提出Anisotropic DPO/Frequency-Hard DPO，用固定词表掩码将高频响应词元的隐式奖励置零，在多个基准与模型上稳定优于标准DPO。
AI.motivation: DPO通过序列级、词元级隐式奖励差之和来对齐语言模型，但作者发现一个普遍病理：极少数高频词元类型在成对偏好与非偏好回复中对称出现，却主导累计序列得分。在Qwen分词与Anthropic HH-RLHF上，仅69个词元类型就占全部回复词元的55.1%、成对共享词元质量的85.9%，其偏好侧特异性显著低于其余词表。这种对称普遍性导致梯度纠缠，稀释了目标中传播的判别性偏好信号。
AI.method: 提出Anisotropic DPO（ADPO）及其典型实现Frequency-Hard DPO。采用固定、与标签无关的词表掩码，将高频响应词元的隐式奖励贡献置零，同时给信息性位置赋单位权重，从而抑制梯度干扰；不修改偏好对、不丢弃上下文、不引入可学习参数。此处的"各向异性"指非均匀的词元级目标加权，而非表示几何。
AI.result: 在AlpacaEval、MT-Bench与Arena-Hard上的大量实证评估表明，Frequency-Hard DPO在Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct与Llama-3-8B-Instruct上均持续优于标准DPO。
AI.conclusion: 选择性掩蔽共享高频词元是一种有效、零开销的稳健偏好对齐机制，验证了该病理诊断的正确性与方法的通用性。

title: ForkLeft: Entropy-First Rollouts for Prefix-Aligned Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Distillation
summary: Autoregressive Next-Token Prediction (NTP) has enabled strong reasoning capabilities in language models, while Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible token orders and parallel generation. We ask whether DLMs can acquire NTP-style reasoning through distillation without giving up their native generation process. Direct distillation, however, faces a fundamental mismatch: an autoregressive teacher predicts from a left prefix, whereas a DLM can condition on tokens on both sides. We introduce ForkLeft, a distillation framework that resolves this mismatch by separating the student's rollout from teacher supervision. During training, the student first performs entropy-first rollouts that commit uncertain positions and expose potential forks. We then fix the resulting student prefix and distill an NTP teacher under the same context, with answer correctness determining the supervision source. At inference, the student returns to its native confidence-first parallel decoding. With Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, ForkLeft improves Efficient-DLM-4B on all ten benchmarks, raising MATH500 from 72.60% to 79.60% and consistently outperforming three alternative designs. The gains scale with teacher strength and generalize to SDAR-4B with only $500$ updates. At matched scale, the distilled 4B and 8B students exceed the published SDAR-Chat and OPDLM models on seven benchmarks, showing that DLMs can learn NTP-style reasoning without sacrificing native parallel generation. Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出 ForkLeft 蒸馏框架，让扩散语言模型在不牺牲原生并行生成的前提下获得自回归式推理能力。
AI.motivation: 自回归下一词预测（NTP）赋予语言模型强大推理能力，而扩散语言模型（DLM）具备灵活词序与并行生成优势。本文探究 DLM 能否通过蒸馏获得 NTP 式推理。直接蒸馏存在根本性不匹配：自回归教师基于左侧前缀预测，而 DLM 可同时以两侧 token 为条件。
AI.method: ForkLeft 将学生模型的 rollout 与教师监督分离。训练时，学生先进行"熵优先"（entropy-first）rollout，提交不确定位置并暴露潜在分叉；随后固定学生前缀，在同一上下文下蒸馏 NTP 教师，并由答案正确性决定监督来源。推理时学生恢复其原生的"置信度优先"并行解码。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base 为教师，ForkLeft 在全部十个基准上提升 Efficient-DLM-4B，MATH500 从 72.60% 升至 79.60%，并持续优于三种替代设计。增益随教师强度提升，仅 500 次更新即可泛化至 SDAR-4B。同等规模下，蒸馏后的 4B 与 8B 学生在七个基准上超过已发布的 SDAR-Chat 与 OPDLM 模型。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 DLM 能够学习 NTP 式推理而无需牺牲原生并行生成能力，为扩散语言模型的推理增强提供了有效路径。

title: Self-Reports Do Not Identify Self-Models: An Identifiability Test for Counterfactual Reports
summary: Language-model self-reports are evidence about behavior in a prompt environment, not by themselves evidence of a self-model. We investigate counterfactual reports about affect-like states under activation interventions and ask whether the report remains bound to the named intervention when the demonstration environment changes. Across three open instruction models, wrong-source demonstrations move reports toward the source answer family, while explicit mechanism binding reduces this pull. Self-report benchmarks should include environment-shift invariance tests under fixed intervention before treating accuracy as evidence for an autonomous report mechanism.

AI.tldr: 语言模型的自我报告反映的是特定提示环境下的行为，而非自我模型本身的证据；通过激活干预与反事实报告实验发现，错误来源示范会使报告偏向来源答案族，而显式的机制绑定可削弱这种拉偏，因此自我报告评测须加入固定干预下的环境迁移不变性检验。
AI.motivation: 当前研究常把语言模型的自我报告直接当作其具备自我模型的证据，但这类报告可能只是对提示环境的条件性行为反应。论文旨在检验：在激活干预下产生的反事实情绪状态报告，当示范环境发生变化时是否仍与所命名的干预绑定，从而判断报告是否源自一个自主的报告机制。
AI.method: 对三个开源指令模型进行激活干预实验，采集关于类情感状态的反事实报告；操纵示范来源（引入错误来源示范）并在固定干预条件下改变示范环境，观察报告是否被拉向来源答案族；同时设置显式机制绑定条件，考察其对这种拉偏效应的削弱作用。
AI.result: 错误来源示范使报告分布向来源答案族偏移；显式的机制绑定能够降低这一拉扯效应。这表明报告在环境迁移下并非稳定绑定于所命名的干预，存在被示范内容带偏的倾向。
AI.conclusion: 自我报告本身不构成自我模型的证据，其可被环境与示范因素左右。自我报告基准测试应纳入"固定干预下的环境迁移不变性"测试，只有在通过此类不变性检验后，才能将报告准确性视为自主报告机制的证据。

title: What Should the Reflector See? An Empirical Study of Evidence in Reflective Prompt Optimization
summary: Reflective prompt optimization revises instructions using examples of a model's behavior, but which evidence the reflector should receive remains unclear. We study evidence composition, visibility of examples, candidate selection and domain-knowledge policy within a single-parent Pareto-guided search. Using Qwen3.5-9B as both task model and reflector, we evaluate nine reflection strategies on five datasets. From these experiments, we find three distinct patterns. For performance improvement, Failures-only produces the largest mean test gain (+8.0 percentage points), while Balanced-mix and No-examples+Val share the best mean performance rank. For reflection effectiveness, No-examples achieves the best rank for improving sampled parents, yet yields only a 1.4-point mean test gain: local reflection success does not necessarily produce a stronger final prompt. For overfitting assessment, Failures-only and Balanced-mix share the lowest mean calibration-gap rank, while larger gaps on GPQA and IFBench show that calibration gains can overstate held-out improvement. This gap is a descriptive indicator, not a direct measure of overfitting. Together, these results show why reflection strategies should be assessed separately on final performance, parent improvement and calibration-to-test transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究反思式提示优化中"反思器应接收何种证据"的问题，在单亲Pareto引导搜索框架下系统比较九种反思策略，发现最终性能、父代改进与校准-测试迁移三个维度需分开评估。
AI.motivation: 反思式提示优化依赖模型行为示例来改写指令，但证据该如何组成、示例是否可见、候选如何选择、是否引入领域知识等关键设计仍缺乏明确结论。作者希望厘清不同证据配置对优化效果的影响。
AI.method: 在单亲Pareto引导搜索框架内，研究证据组成、示例可见性、候选选择与领域知识策略四个维度；以Qwen3.5-9B同时作为任务模型与反思器，在五个数据集上评估九种反思策略，并从最终性能、父代改进（反思有效性）与过拟合评估三个角度分别分析。
AI.result: 性能提升方面，仅失败样本（Failures-only）取得最大平均测试增益（+8.0个百分点），均衡混合（Balanced-mix）与无示例+验证集（No-examples+Val）并列最佳平均性能排名。反思有效性方面，无示例策略在改进采样父代上排名最佳，但平均测试增益仅1.4个百分点，说明局部反思成功不一定带来更强的最终提示。过拟合评估方面，Failures-only与Balanced-mix并列最低平均校准差距排名，而GPQA与IFBench上更大的差距表明校准改进可能高估留出集提升，该差距只是描述性指标而非过拟合的直接度量。
AI.conclusion: 反思策略应在最终性能、父代改进与校准到测试的迁移三个维度上分别评估；局部反思成功与最终提示质量并不一致，校准增益也可能高估实际泛化提升。

title: De-biasing Skeleton-based Action Recognition with Convex Hull Adaptive Shift
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Necolizer/CHASE
summary: Skeleton sequences can represent both individual actions and multi-entity interactions, encompassing human bodies, hands, objects, and robots. Existing approaches to recognize skeleton-based actions and interactions usually adopt a late fusion strategy, which expects individuals are independent and identically distributed to train a robust weight-shared entity encoder. However, observed entity bias in various skeletal data violates this assumption, leading to suboptimal optimization of backbone models that might produce wrong recognition results. This bias arises from the world coordinate system's initial configuration, where the choice of origin often creates bias in representation. To this end, we propose a Convex Hull Adaptive Shift based normalization method to reduce Entity bias (CHASE), improving performance across a variety of skeleton-based action and interaction recognition tasks. To adaptively apply plausible shifts to the input skeletons, we formulate a plug-and-play parameterized network that ensures the relocated world origin lies within the skeleton convex hull, which avoids non-convergence by limiting the search space. To further minimize entity bias, we incorporate an auxiliary objective that leverages pair-wise distribution distances to guide network optimization. To support both single- and multi-entity actions, we propose a sub-entity strategy that offers a consistent formulation for both scenarios. Moreover, CHASE demonstrates compatibility with various intra-skeleton modalities, such as bones and velocities, highlighting its adaptability. Essentially, our method works as a normalization approach to reduce entity bias, enabling subsequent classifiers to achieve improved recognition performance across diverse settings. Extensive experiments on 7 datasets verify our approach by seamlessly integrating with various backbones and significantly boosting their performance.
