AI.tldr: 提出CHASE（凸包自适应偏移归一化）方法，通过自适应移动世界坐标原点以缓解骨骼数据中的实体偏置，作为即插即用归一化模块显著提升多类骨骼动作与交互识别任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有骨骼动作/交互识别方法多采用后融合策略，假设各实体独立同分布以训练权重共享的实体编码器；但各类骨骼数据中存在实体偏置，违背该假设，导致主干模型优化次优、识别错误。该偏置源于世界坐标系初始配置，原点选择本身即引入表征偏差。
AI.method: 1）构建可插拔参数化网络，自适应地为输入骨骼施加合理偏移，并约束新原点落在骨骼凸包内，以限制搜索空间、避免不收敛；2）引入基于成对分布距离的辅助目标，引导网络优化以进一步减小实体偏置；3）提出子实体（sub-entity）策略，为单实体与多实体动作提供统一表述；4）方法与骨骼、速度等骨骼内模态兼容，作为归一化手段降低实体偏置，便于后续分类器提升识别性能。
AI.result: 在7个数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法：可与多种主干网络无缝集成，并显著提升其性能，适用于多种骨骼动作与交互相识别设置。
AI.conclusion: CHASE作为一种归一化方法有效缓解骨骼数据中的实体偏置，兼具通用性与即插即用特性，能够跨数据集、跨主干、跨模态稳定提升骨骼动作与交互识别性能。

title: QuacamFM: Quaternion-Constrained Flow Matching for Camera Pose Estimation
summary: Camera pose estimation from multi-view images remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional methods often address this problem using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with bundle adjustment. However, camera poses estimated from sparse views are inherently ambiguous due to insufficient geometric constraints. Recent work leverages probabilistic models, such as diffusion models, to generate multiple camera pose hypotheses and therefore capture this uncertainty better. Most of these methods represent camera rotations using unit quaternions, but treat them as unconstrained 4D vectors during the generative processes, thereby ignoring the unit-norm constraint of quaternions. Unconstrained quaternions create non-smooth and suboptimal generation trajectories. To this end, we propose *QuacamFM*, a quaternion-constrained flow matching framework for camera pose estimation that preserves unit quaternion representations throughout the entire flow trajectory. We design the optimal transport of the quaternion flows using smooth spherical linear interpolation. Experiments on CO3Dv2 demonstrate our method's advantage in camera pose accuracy over diffusion-based methods and classical SfM approaches. We further show that our quaternion-constrained formulation outperforms the naive application of standard flow matching to 4D quaternion vectors on sparse-view camera pose estimation. Finally, it is observed that QuacamFM generalizes well across datasets and in-the-wild examples.

AI.tldr: 提出QuacamFM，一种四元数约束的流匹配框架，在整个流轨迹中保持单位四元数表示，用于多视图稀疏相机位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图下相机位姿估计因几何约束不足而存在固有歧义，近期利用扩散模型等概率模型生成多个位姿假设以刻画不确定性。但多数方法将四元数旋转当作无约束4D向量处理，忽略了单位范数约束，导致生成轨迹不光滑且次优。
AI.method: QuacamFM采用四元数约束的流匹配框架，在整个流轨迹中始终保持单位四元数表示；通过球面线性插值（slerp）设计四元数流的最优传输。
AI.result: 在CO3Dv2上，相机位姿精度优于基于扩散的方法和经典SfM方法；四元数约束公式优于将标准流匹配直接应用于4D四元数向量的朴素做法；在跨数据集和真实场景样本上泛化良好。
AI.conclusion: 保持单位四元数约束的流匹配能有效提升稀疏视图相机位姿估计的精度，并具备良好的泛化能力。

title: Seeing Parts, Reasoning about Worlds: Visual Inference under Partial Observation
summary: World modeling under partial observation requires reasoning about the complete worlds that remain compatible with limited visual evidence. Occluded objects and unseen regions can leave several world states possible; additional views can exclude alternatives and strengthen the conclusions supported by the observations. We introduce WorldScope to study this process through possible-world semantics, evidence-grounded data, and learned visual representations. WorldScope-1.2M provides 1.2 million English question-answer pairs spanning eight world properties, ten task interfaces, and three observation protocols. Its answers encode confirmed facts, supported bounds, and unresolved possibilities. Complementary supervision comprises 4,800 certified counterworld groups with equivalent base observations and different hidden object configurations and query answers. These groups provide physical witnesses of ambiguity and training-only labels for world compatibility and view-induced exclusions. We propose WorldFlow, which composes cross-view entity evidence and support-surface coverage into an image-subset evidence lattice. Counterworld compatibility and transition objectives train subset representations to reflect how new observations constrain possible worlds. A shared answer generator uses these representations to predict the strongest supported conclusion. WorldScope-Bench evaluates claim judgments and evidence-dependent conclusions as views are selected, combined, removed, or ordered. On its 5,000-question test set, WorldFlow reaches 64.34% exact accuracy, improving over the same backbone trained on QA alone by 24.88 percentage points. It retains 50.43% accuracy on the 3,000 questions from structure-disjoint scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WorldScope 基准与 WorldFlow 模型，研究部分观测下的世界建模：通过可能世界语义、证据支撑数据与学习到的视觉表征，使模型能依据新增视图排除候选世界并给出最强证据支持的结论。
AI.motivation: 部分观测下，遮挡与未见区域会导致多个世界状态均与有限视觉证据兼容；新增视图可以排除某些备选并强化结论。现有工作缺乏对"可能世界—证据—视图"这一推理过程的系统建模与评测。
AI.method: 构建 WorldScope-1.2M，含 120 万英文问答对，覆盖 8 类世界属性、10 种任务接口、3 种观测协议，答案区分已确认事实、有界支撑与未决可能性；补充 4,800 个经认证的 counterworld 组，具备相同基础观测但隐藏物体配置与查询答案不同，提供歧义的物理见证及世界兼容性和视图排除的训练标签。提出 WorldFlow，将跨视图实体证据与支撑面覆盖组合为图像子集证据格，用 counterworld 兼容性与转移目标训练子集表征，再由共享答案生成器预测最强支撑结论。WorldScope-Bench 评测声明判断与视图被选择、组合、移除或排序时的证据依赖结论。
AI.result: 在 5,000 题测试集上，WorldFlow 取得 64.34% 精确准确率，较同一主干仅用问答训练提升 24.88 个百分点；在 3,000 题结构不相交场景上保持 50.43% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过可能世界语义与 counterworld 监督，WorldFlow 能有效利用视图证据约束可能世界，显著优于纯问答训练基线，并在结构不相交场景下具备一定泛化能力。

title: Streamlined Reflective Evolution for Task-Adaptive Self-Refinement Pipelines
summary: Reflective prompt optimization improves large language model (LLM) systems without updating model weights, but fixed architectures constrain how self-refinement is organized. We introduce Workflow-Designing Agents (WDA), a framework for streamlined reflective evolution of task-adaptive self-refinement pipelines. Starting from a minimal prompt, WDA jointly evolves stage instructions and their sequential structure. During evolution, we find that repeated revisions can accumulate redundant instructions in a single prompt. In WDA, we propose to address this problem with SPLIT, which redistributes these instructions across specialized stages. Three-example reflection and local screening guide selective search, while calibration scores guide Pareto admission and rollback of unhelpful trailing updates. The resulting pipelines are task-adaptive: their instructions and depth are learned from task data, then fixed for all test inputs within that task. We evaluate WDA on five benchmarks spanning knowledge, mathematical reasoning, multi-hop question answering, and instruction following. On Qwen3.5-9B, WDA achieves an average score of 51.24%, improving over the initial solver by 8.63 percentage points and the variant without SPLIT by 2.60 points. On GPT-4.1-mini, it achieves 49.00%, with corresponding gains of 5.62 and 3.69 points. These results support task-adaptive self-refinement as a complementary direction to broader agentic workflow search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Workflow-Designing Agents (WDA) 框架，通过联合演化阶段指令与序列结构，实现面向任务自适应的自精炼流水线反思式进化，并引入 SPLIT 机制缓解冗余指令累积问题，在五个基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 反思式提示优化无需更新模型权重即可提升 LLM 系统性能，但固定架构限制了自精炼的组织方式，难以根据具体任务灵活调整流水线结构。
AI.method: WDA 从最小提示出发，联合演化各阶段指令及其序列结构；针对反复修订导致单条提示中冗余指令累积的问题，提出 SPLIT，将指令重分配至专用阶段。同时采用三示例反思与本地筛选指导选择性搜索，并用校准分数指导帕累托接纳与对无益尾部更新的回滚。所得流水线为任务自适应：指令与深度从任务数据中学习，再在该任务所有测试输入上固定使用。
AI.result: 在覆盖知识、数学推理、多跳问答与指令遵循的五个基准上，Qwen3.5-9B 达到平均 51.24%，较初始求解器提升 8.63 个百分点，较无 SPLIT 变体提升 2.60 个百分点；GPT-4.1-mini 达到 49.00%，相应提升 5.62 与 3.69 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持任务自适应自精炼作为更广泛智能体工作流搜索的互补方向。

title: REMEDY: How Far Is Video Generation from Medical Education World Models?
summary: Recent video generation models produce realistic videos and show potential as a foundation for world models. These advances create opportunities for generating medical teaching demonstrations, which requires both convincing visual quality and precise procedural actions. However, whether current generators can meet these requirements has not been measured. To address this problem, we introduce Readiness Evaluation of Medical Education Demonstration sYnthesis (REMEDY), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for AI-generated medical teaching demonstrations. REMEDY provides 900 first frames from real demonstration videos, covering 12 tasks across four scenarios: operating room, imaging, clinic and bedside, and resuscitation. Five contemporary open-source video generation models produce 4,500 videos from these frames. We combine task-specific clinical checklists with video and motion quality metrics. Evaluation covers four dimensions: clinical action following, clinical profiles, video quality, and motion quality. Our results show that realistic appearance and temporal consistency do not ensure correct clinical actions. Even the most advanced MiniMax-H3 achieves only 28.25% on strict clinical success rate, and fine-grained clinical actions remain challenging. These findings establish a foundation and roadmap for developing future medical education world models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出REMEDY——首个面向AI生成医学教学演示的基准，用900个真实首帧、4类场景12项任务和5个视频生成模型生成的4500个视频，从临床动作遵循、临床特征、视频质量与运动质量四维度评估，发现生成模型外观真实但临床动作正确率低（最佳仅28.25%）。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型日益逼真并被视为世界模型的基础，为生成医学教学演示带来机会；此类演示既要求可信的视觉质量，也要求精准的操作步骤，但现有生成器能否满足这些要求尚无度量手段，缺乏相应基准。
AI.method: 构建REMEDY基准：采集真实演示视频的900个首帧，覆盖手术室、影像、门诊与床旁、复苏四类场景共12项任务；用5个当代开源视频生成模型由这些首帧生成4500个视频；将任务专属临床检查表与视频质量、运动质量指标结合，从临床动作遵循、临床特征、视频质量和运动质量四个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 结果显示，逼真的外观与时间一致性并不能保证正确的临床动作；即使最先进的MiniMax-H3在严格临床成功率上也仅为28.25%，细粒度临床动作仍是难点。
AI.conclusion: REMEDY为AI生成医学教学演示提供了首个评估基准，揭示了当前视频生成模型在临床动作正确性上的显著不足，为未来医学教育世界模型的发展奠定了基础与路线图。

title: Can Motion-Language Models Ground Structure? STRIDE for Evaluating the Evaluators
summary: Motion-language models are typically scored by motion-language evaluators, but how well these evaluators ground language structure remains unclear. Here, we introduce the Structure grounding via Temporal-order, Reflection, and Identity Diagnostic Evaluation (STRIDE) benchmark to systematically evaluate the ability of evaluators to track temporal order, mirror reflection, and action identity. STRIDE comprises $5{,}869$ triples, each consisting of a motion, its original caption, and a perturbed caption, spanning both short and long descriptions. We likelihood-balance caption pairs to reduce text-only bias and estimate each evaluator's caption preference under unrelated motions to measure the discrimination gain from matched motions relative to this baseline. Our experiments reveal weak structural grounding and severe deficits in mirror sensitivity among the audited evaluators, which commonly used evaluation protocols fail to expose. To understand why these limitations go undetected in standard tests, we examine the evaluators more closely. We find that text-only priors alone can solve naive perturbation tests on existing datasets, while common retrieval and distributional metrics barely respond to structural corruption introduced by mirroring ground-truth motions. These findings suggest a natural intervention: structural hard negatives. Our experiments show that a simple modification to contrastive learning substantially improves performance on temporal order and mirror reflection. The benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRIDE基准，系统评估运动-语言评测器对时间顺序、镜像反射和动作身份的结构性 grounding 能力，发现现有评测器结构 grounding 薄弱且镜像敏感性严重不足，并提出结构硬负样本干预来改善。
AI.motivation: 运动-语言模型通常由运动-语言评测器打分，但这些评测器是否真正理解语言结构尚不清楚。现有评测协议可能无法暴露评测器在结构理解上的缺陷，因此需要系统性的诊断方法。
AI.method: 构建STRIDE基准，包含5,869个三元组（运动、原始描述、扰动描述），覆盖长短描述，聚焦时间顺序、镜像反射和动作身份三个维度。通过似然平衡描述对以减少纯文本偏置，并在无关运动下估计评测器的描述偏好，以测量匹配运动带来的判别增益。进一步分析纯文本先验、检索与分布指标对结构损坏的响应，并提出结构硬负样本干预。
AI.result: 实验发现评测器结构 grounding 薄弱，镜像敏感性严重不足，而常用评测协议未能暴露这些缺陷。纯文本先验即可解决现有数据集上的朴素扰动测试，常见检索和分布指标对镜像真值运动引入的结构损坏几乎无响应。结构硬负样本的简单对比学习修改显著提升时间顺序和镜像反射表现。
AI.conclusion: 现有运动-语言评测器在结构 grounding 上存在系统性缺陷，标准评测协议掩盖了这些问题。引入结构硬负样本是一种有效的干预手段，可显著改善时间顺序和镜像反射能力，基准与代码将公开。

title: PULSE: Identifying Demonstration-Utility Features with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: In-context learning is highly sensitive to demonstration choice, yet most methods select demonstrations using external query-demonstration similarity. Such criteria can miss model-specific signals: Similar demonstrations may activate different internal features and downstream behaviors. We introduce PULSE (Paired Utility Localization over Sparse Encodings), an SAE-based framework for identifying model-internal features associated with demonstration utility and using them for demonstration selection. Using a small labeled discovery set, PULSE samples candidate demonstration sets, measures their zero-shot-relative utility under the target model, and scores SAE features by how their activation differences align with utility differences. The top positive and negative coordinates form a sparse utility-localization vector. We use this vector in two complementary ways: as a signed score for controlled complete-set ranking, and as PULSE-Retriever, which converts its magnitude into a feature-relevance mask for scalable pool-scale retrieval. Across classification, generation, and reasoning benchmarks, PULSE-Retriever improves over the strongest baseline by 2-3 accuracy points, 0.6-0.9 BLEU-4, and 3.2 exact-match points, respectively, while controlled ranking validates the identified features encode a predictive set-level utility signal. Feature inspection and cross-dataset experiments suggest that the identified features capture task-relevant, dataset-conditioned patterns, yet retain utility signals that partially transfer across datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/aohenuo/PULSE.

AI.tldr: 提出PULSE框架，利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）识别目标模型内部与示例效用相关的特征，并据此选择上下文学习示例，在分类、生成、推理任务上均优于最强基线。
AI.motivation: 上下文学习对示例选择高度敏感，但现有方法多依赖外部的查询-示例相似度。这类判据忽略模型特异信号：相似的示例可能激活不同的内部特征与下游行为。因此需要从模型内部特征出发，识别真正与示例效用相关的信号。
AI.method: PULSE（Paired Utility Localization over Sparse Encodings）基于SAE：用一个小规模标注发现集，采样候选示例集，测量其在目标模型下相对零样本的效用，并按激活差异与效用差异的对齐程度对SAE特征打分。取正、负向得分最高的坐标构成稀疏的效用定位向量。该向量有两种用法：作为有符号分数用于完整集的受控排序；以及作为PULSE-Retriever，将向量幅值转为特征相关性掩码，用于大规模池级检索。
AI.result: 在分类、生成、推理基准上，PULSE-Retriever相比最强基线分别提升2-3个准确率点、0.6-0.9 BLEU-4、3.2个精确匹配点；受控排序验证了所识别特征编码了可预测的集合级效用信号。特征检验与跨数据集实验表明，所识别特征捕捉了任务相关、数据集条件化的模式，同时保留部分可跨数据集迁移的效用信号。
AI.conclusion: PULSE证明可从模型内部SAE特征中定位示例效用信号，并同时支持精确的完整集排序与可扩展的池级检索，为上下文学习示例选择提供了模型内部视角的新方案。

title: AdaTutoRank: Learning to Rerank Document Sets via Adaptive Tutoring Optimization for RAG and Deep Research
summary: Document rerankers determine what evidence reaches the downstream model in RAG and deep research, yet mainstream rerankers select by relevance matching, and individually relevant documents rarely constitute the complete, complementary, non-redundant set a complex information need demands. Prior work rewards a set by its aggregate rubric score, shifting the objective from ranking documents to composing sets. Yet that score is one scalar shared by every document in the set, so the supervision is sparse: a redundant document is rewarded with the rest whenever the set scores well, and a decisive one penalized with the rest whenever it does not; credit assignment leaves contributors indistinguishable from free riders. On-policy distillation could densify this supervision, but existing methods give every rollout the same fixed guidance, too prescriptive for strong rollouts and too abstract for weak ones. We therefore propose AdaTutoRank, a setwise reranker trained with Adaptive Tutoring Optimization (ATO) under a three-level hierarchy of nine rubric dimensions, which supplies silver labels for the cold start, rewards for reinforcement learning, and hints for distillation. ATO draws three hint forms of increasing specificity from the policy's own frozen snapshot: the rubrics alone, a self-selector's sibling-set chosen under rubrics, and a self-reflector's reflection contrasting the rollout with that sibling-set; each rollout receives the form matched to its quality. Re-scoring that rollout under the hint-conditioned frozen teacher and the hint-free snapshot distills the hint's effect into a token-level advantage that complements the group-relative outcome advantage. Across ten benchmarks spanning RAG, deep research, and setwise evaluation, AdaTutoRank attains the best overall performance while issuing fewer retrieval calls.

AI.tldr: AdaTutoRank：面向RAG与深度研究的集合式重排器，通过自适应辅导优化（ATO）在三层次九维 rubric 体系下，按 rollout 质量匹配不同粒度提示，并将提示效应蒸馏为 token 级优势，与组相对结果优势互补，在十个基准上整体最优且检索调用更少。
AI.motivation: 主流重排器按相关性匹配逐条选文档，而单个相关文档难以构成复杂信息需求所需的完整、互补、非冗余集合。已有集合级奖励虽将目标从"排序文档"转为"组合集合"，但该奖励是集合内所有文档共享的单一标量，监督稀疏：集合得分高时冗余文档被连带奖励，得分低时关键文档被连带惩罚，信用分配无法区分贡献者与"搭便车者"。on-policy 蒸馏虽可稠密化监督，但现有方法对所有 rollout 施加同样固定的指导，对强 rollout 过于规定性，对弱 rollout 又过于抽象。
AI.method: 提出 AdaTutoRank 集合式重排器，以自适应辅导优化（ATO）训练，构建三层次、九维 rubric 体系，同时提供冷启动银标签、强化学习奖励与蒸馏提示。ATO 从策略自身的冻结快照中抽取三种递增具体性的提示形式：仅 rubric；自选择器在 rubric 下选出的兄弟集合；自反思器对该 rollout 与兄弟集合的对比反思。每个 rollout 按质量匹配相应提示形式。在提示条件下的冻结教师与无提示快照下重新打分，将提示效应蒸馏为 token 级优势，与组相对结果优势互补。
AI.result: 在覆盖 RAG、深度研究与集合式评测的十个基准上，AdaTutoRank 取得最佳整体性能，同时检索调用次数更少。
AI.conclusion: 将重排目标从逐条相关性排序转向集合组合，并以自适应、按质量匹配的提示与 token 级优势蒸馏缓解集合级标量奖励的信用分配稀疏问题，可在提升集合质量的同时降低检索开销。

title: PC-SubMax: Efficient Prompt Compression via Regularized Submodular Maximization
summary: While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-context scenarios, lengthy prompts can increase inference costs and latency and exacerbate the ``lost-in-the-middle'' phenomenon. Selective prompt compression offers a model-agnostic approach to alleviating these issues. However, methods based on fixed token- or sentence-level importance scores may overlook how content contributions change with the selected subset, limiting their ability to account for inter-sentence redundancy. Compression procedures that rely on autoregressive LLM scoring can also introduce substantial overhead. We propose PC-SubMax, a theoretically grounded framework that formulates selective prompt compression as regularized monotone submodular maximization under a knapsack constraint. The objective is $U(S)-\ell(S)$, where the monotone submodular utility $U$ combines information coverage, query relevance, and log-determinant diversity, and the non-negative modular penalty $\ell$ captures token cost. Through diminishing marginal returns, the objective evaluates each sentence's contribution relative to the selected content. To optimize this objective, we develop the Regularized Greedy+Max (RGM) algorithm, which deterministically returns a feasible set $Q$ satisfying $U(Q)-\ell(Q)\geq \frac{1}{2}U(O)-\ell(O)$, where $O$ is an optimal feasible solution to the regularized problem. RGM uses $O(nκ)$ value-oracle queries, where $n$ is the number of candidate sentences and $κ$ is the maximum feasible subset size. PC-SubMax uses encoder representations and avoids autoregressive LLM scoring during compression. Experiments across seven diverse benchmarks demonstrate competitive downstream performance with low compression overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文将选择性提示压缩建模为背包约束下的正则化单调次模最大化问题，提出PC-SubMax框架及RGM算法，利用编码器表示实现高效压缩，在七个基准上取得有竞争力的下游性能且压缩开销低。
AI.motivation: 大模型长上下文场景下，冗长提示会增加推理成本与延迟，并加剧"中间迷失"现象。现有效果依赖固定token或句子级重要度评分的方法，忽略了内容贡献随所选子集变化的问题，难以建模句间冗余；而依赖自回归LLM打分的方法则带来显著开销。
AI.method: 将选择性提示压缩形式化为背包约束下的正则化单调次模最大化，目标为U(S)−ℓ(S)：单调次模效用U融合信息覆盖、查询相关性与对数行列式多样性，非负模惩罚ℓ刻画token成本。基于边际收益递减，目标函数可评估每个句子相对已选内容的贡献。提出Regularized Greedy+Max（RGM）算法进行优化，该算法确定性地返回可行集Q。
AI.result: RGM保证U(Q)−ℓ(Q) ≥ ½U(O)−ℓ(O)，其中O为正则化问题的最优可行解；使用O(nκ)次价值预言机查询（n为候选句子数，κ为最大可行子集规模）。PC-SubMax仅用编码器表示，压缩过程中无需自回归LLM打分。在七个多样化基准上，实现有竞争力的下游性能与低压缩开销。
AI.conclusion: PC-SubMax提供了一种理论完备、模型无关的选择性提示压缩框架，通过正则化次模最大化兼顾信息覆盖、相关性与多样性，并以高效编码器实现低开销压缩，在多个基准上验证了其有效性。

title: Back-Tracking from Clarity: Self-Learning to See Text from Afar
summary: We propose a self-supervised framework designed to enhance the capability of scene text detectors in identifying and recognizing text in scenarios where instances are shown at significant distances, typically small, blurred, and frequently missed by conventional models. Our approach leverages the high-fidelity performance of existing text spotting models on large, clear text as a foundational supervisor. By temporally back-tracking these high-confidence detections through video sequences, we automatically synthesize pseudo-labels for preceding frames where the distant text is still visually degraded or undersized. These pseudo-labels enable training a student model specialized for early text detection, without requiring any manual annotation. The success of this approach depends on accurate pseudo-label generation, for which we develop a dedicated scene text tracker capable of maintaining consistent text identities across challenging video sequences. In addition, we propose SceneText50, a diverse multilingual outdoor dataset to facilitate training and evaluation. Experiments show that our framework significantly improves early detection accuracy and robustness across varied scenes and languages. Code and data are at \href{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督框架，利用视频时序回溯将大而清晰文本的高置信检测结果合成为早期退化/小文本的伪标签，训练专门针对早期文本检测的学生模型，并构建多语言户外数据集SceneText50。
AI.motivation: 远距离场景下的文本实例通常尺寸小、模糊，常被常规检测器漏检；而人工标注早期退化文本代价高昂。
AI.method: 以现有文本定位模型对清晰大文本的高保真结果为监督信号，沿视频序列时序回溯，为远距离文本尚模糊/偏小的前序帧自动生成伪标签；为此设计专用场景文本跟踪器以在困难视频序列中保持文本身份一致；同时提出多语言户外数据集SceneText50用于训练与评测。
AI.result: 实验显示该框架在多种场景与语言下显著提升早期检测的准确性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 无需人工标注即可训练面向早期文本检测的学生模型，验证了时序回溯伪标签与专用跟踪器的有效性，并公开代码与数据。

title: JEPA Learns What the Mask Leaves Unrecoverable
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are unusually sensitive to how the input is masked: block masks work, scattered masks do not, and the explanations are empirical. We give a measurement account. A mask is a linear measurement, and in a compactly supported wavelet basis every atom whose support lies inside the hidden region falls in the measurement's null space and leaves no trace in the data. The JEPA loss asks only that the encoded context suffice for the target, so a target that a low-level prior can recover admits a shortcut, one the moving-average target encoder can make self-consistent. What removes the shortcut is the coarse-scale content the mask leaves unrecoverable, provided enough context stays within reach of each target. We score that content before training and test the account's distinctive predictions in 151 pre-training runs. On ImageNet-100, strip masks match blocks in area and contiguity yet are recoverable, and they land at 40.3% linear top-1, beside random masks at 40.8%, against 64.3% for blocks; within one geometry family, the placements that leave the least unrecoverable content lose 6.5 points to those that leave the most, over five seed pairs; pixel targets span 7 points where latent targets span 25; and against a frozen target the gap between random and block masks, 19 points on the same kind of GPU, closes to 1.5, so the geometry acts through the target the encoder produces for itself. On UCF101 the masking ratio decides which condition, content or reach, binds; removing whole frames, unrecoverable in space but recoverable from neighbouring frames, is worst at both ratios; and on V-JEPA's own masks, batching them intact instead of truncated changes little (36.0% against 35.1%), whereas making 100 target tokens inside the blocks visible lifts them to 48.7% and hiding 100 context tokens outside the blocks does not (33.7%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个测量理论解释JEPA对掩码几何的敏感性：掩码是线性测量，小波基下隐藏区内支撑的原子落入零空间；只有掩码留下的"不可恢复的粗尺度内容"才能消除低级先验捷径，并在151次预训练中得到验证。
AI.motivation: JEPA对输入掩码方式异常敏感（块掩码有效、散乱掩码无效），但既有解释多为经验性的，缺乏对"为什么"的测量层面理论刻画。
AI.method: 将掩码建模为线性测量，在紧支撑小波基下分析落入零空间的原子；结合JEPA损失仅要求编码上下文足以预测目标，指出可由低级先验恢复的目标会产生捷径，并被滑动平均目标编码器自洽化；据此提出"不可恢复粗尺度内容"评分，并在151次预训练中检验该理论的独特预测。
AI.result: ImageNet-100：条带掩码与块掩码面积和连续性相同却可恢复，线性top-1为40.3%，随机掩码40.8%，块掩码64.3%；同几何族内不可恢复内容最少者比最多者低6.5分（5对种子）；像素目标跨度7分、潜目标跨度25分；对冻结目标，随机与块的19分差距缩小到1.5。UCF101：掩码比例决定内容与可达性哪个条件起作用，整帧移除在两种比例下最差。V-JEPA掩码：整批保留截断变化小（36.0% vs 35.1%），使块内100个目标token可见提升到48.7%，隐藏块外100个上下文token不提升（33.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 掩码几何通过编码器自产目标的捷径起作用，真正关键的是掩码使其不可恢复的粗尺度内容；该测量解释能预测并统一多种掩码条件与数据集上的表现差异。

title: When Helpful Text Hurts: Option-Redirecting Bias in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). 25 pages, 16 figures. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: In tri-modal visual question answering (VQA), auxiliary text is commonly used to complement visual and textual inputs, yet its reliability is often uncontrolled. While prior work studies modality conflicts in general, it remains unclear how different types of unreliable auxiliary text affect answer selection under fixed image-question-option contexts. In this work, we show that the most harmful auxiliary text is not necessarily the most factually incorrect, but the one that aligns with the question while contradicting the image and favoring a specific distractor, leading to systematic redirection of model predictions. To isolate this effect, we introduce the Textual Reliability Ladder, a controlled diagnostic protocol that decomposes auxiliary text along three axes: image consistency, question relevance, and option support. Across multiple datasets (ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA) and recent VLMs, we find that such distractor-supporting text induces the largest accuracy drops (up to 53.1%) and concentrates errors on specific incorrect options. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a training-free inference-time intervention that explicitly counteracts this redirection effect via noise-stability steering and dynamic grounding, reducing redirected errors while largely preserving performance under faithful text. Our results highlight that auxiliary-text reliability must be understood at the decision level, rather than solely through factual correctness, and provide a practical pathway toward more robust tri-modal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三模态VQA中不可靠辅助文本对答案选择的影响，发现最具危害性的是"与问题相关、与图像矛盾、支持特定干扰项"的文本，并提出无需训练的推理时干预方法缓解该失效模式。
AI.motivation: 三模态VQA中辅助文本常被用来补充视觉与文本输入，但其可靠性往往不受控制。已有工作研究模态冲突，但在固定的图像-问题-选项情境下，不同类型的不可靠辅助文本如何影响答案选择仍不清晰。
AI.method: 提出"文本可靠性阶梯"（Textual Reliability Ladder）诊断协议，沿三个维度分解辅助文本：图像一致性、问题相关性、选项支持度。基于该协议系统评测多种数据集与近期VLM。并进一步提出一种无需训练的推理时干预方法，通过噪声稳定性引导与动态接地来抵消误导性的重定向效应。
AI.result: 在ScienceQA、VCR、A-OKVQA、Causal-VidQA等数据集及多种VLM上，支持干扰项的文本导致最大精度下降（最高达53.1%），且错误集中在特定错误选项上。所提干预方法减少了被重定向的错误，同时在可信文本下基本保持性能。
AI.conclusion: 辅助文本的可靠性应在决策层面理解，而非仅以事实正确性衡量。最有害的辅助文本未必是事实最错误的，而是能系统性地将预测重定向到特定干扰项者。研究为更稳健的三模态推理提供了可行路径。

title: Explaining Textual Entailment with Lexical Entailments: Using LLMs to Supply Lexical Relations for Formal Proofs
comment: Accepted at the 11th Workshop on Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC 2026)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are highly capable of natural language reasoning and appear to store a great deal of lexical knowledge, but it is still unclear how much of this knowledge they actually use when reasoning, and whether they use it in the right way. On the other hand, logic-based Natural Language Inference (NLI) systems provide transparent and formally grounded reasoning, but they need to be supplied with rich lexical knowledge to prove inferences beyond purely logical ones. In this paper, we evaluate whether LLMs can identify all lexical knowledge needed to solve NLI problems and how much this knowledge contributes to proof search in a logic-based NLI system. Our research focuses exclusively on structured lexical entailments (e.g., chinchilla$\sqsubseteq$small animal) as a proxy for structured explanations for NLI problems with an entailment label. First, we curate a dataset for a new task of explaining sentential entailments with a set of lexical entailments. The dataset is used to intrinsically evaluate LLMs on generating structured lexical explanations. Then, we use NLI as an extrinsic evaluation in a simple neuro-symbolic setting, assessing whether LLMs can supply sufficient lexical relations to LangPro, a natural-logic theorem prover for natural language. The results show that the proposed task remains challenging even for hosted proprietary LLMs, and that their contribution to theorem proving is moderate: generated relations are often only partially sound and may be tailored to the specific NLI problem rather than representing generally valid lexical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文评估大语言模型（LLM）能否识别求解NLI问题所需的全部词汇知识，并在神经符号框架下测试这些知识对LangPro定理证明器的贡献。
AI.motivation: LLM具备自然语言推理能力并似存储大量词汇知识，但其在推理时实际使用了多少知识、是否以正确方式使用尚不明确；而基于逻辑的NLI系统虽推理透明、形式化有据，却需大量词汇知识才能证明超出纯逻辑范围的推断。
AI.method: 聚焦结构化词汇蕴含（如 chinchilla⊑small animal）作为NLI蕴含标签的结构化解释代理。首先构建一个用词汇蕴含集解释句子级蕴含的新任务数据集，用于内在地评估LLM生成结构化词汇解释的能力；再以NLI作为外在评估，在简单神经符号设置中判断LLM能否为自然逻辑定理证明器LangPro提供充分的词汇关系。
AI.result: 即便对商用专有LLM而言，所提出的任务仍具挑战性；LLM生成的词汇关系对定理证明的贡献有限，生成的关系往往仅部分可靠，且可能针对特定NLI问题定制，而非代表普遍有效的词汇知识。
AI.conclusion: LLM虽存储丰富词汇知识，但难以完整、正确地调用以支撑逻辑推理，其提供的词汇关系在神经符号NLI系统中贡献中等且可靠性不足，表明从LLM到形式化推理的知识迁移仍存在显著差距。

title: Locally Sound, Globally Insufficient: The Local-Global Gap in Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Reliable multi-hop reasoning requires more than locally supported steps: a trace can be sound at every reasoning step yet still fail to answer the question as a whole. We call this failure regime the local-global gap (LGG), in which the trace is locally sound yet globally insufficient. Local soundness requires each step to be supported by the available evidence and preceding steps, whereas global sufficiency requires the reasoning trace to align with the question and establish the submitted answer. In a human-adjudicated diagnostic of 2,598 responses across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and three models, we find that the LGG occurs in every benchmark-model combination and accounts for nearly half of globally insufficient responses overall. However, conventional faithfulness verifiers that check claims against the evidence largely miss these failures: at thresholds retaining at least 95% of reliable traces, recall for LGG cases is substantially lower than that for locally unsound traces. To address these failures, we formalize three dependencies for reliable reasoning: evidence-to-step support, question-to-trace alignment, and trace-to-answer closure. Instead of post-hoc diagnosis, we introduce E-Closure to supervise these dependencies during training, combining generation supervision on supported original and counterfactual responses with bidirectional switching constraints. Averaged over three benchmarks and three backbones, existing fine-tuning baselines improve accuracy and local soundness over the base models, but at the cost of global sufficiency. E-Closure improves both: among all fine-tuned methods, it achieves the highest average accuracy (92.8%) and trace reliability (89.0%) while yielding the lowest LGG rate (6.2%).

AI.tldr: 论文提出"局部-全局差距(LGG)"失败模式并形式化三种依赖，提出E-Closure训练监督方法，在多跳QA上同时提升准确率与全局充分性。
AI.motivation: 多跳推理中，推理链每步都局部有据可依(局部可靠)，但整体仍可能无法回答问题(全局不充分)。这类"局部-全局差距"失败被现有忠实性验证器大量漏检，亟需新的分析框架与改进方法。
AI.method: 通过2598条人工裁决的回应(3个多跳QA基准×3个模型)量化LGG现象。形式化三种依赖关系：证据到步骤的支持、问题到推理链的对齐、推理链到答案的闭合。提出E-Closure，在训练阶段监督这些依赖，结合对原始与反事实回应的生成监督以及双向切换约束。
AI.result: LGG在所有基准-模型组合中均出现，占全局不充分回答的近一半；传统忠实性验证器在保留95%可靠链的阈值下对LGG的召回显著偏低。相比仅提升准确率和局部可靠性的微调基线，E-Closure在三个基准与三个骨干上平均取得最高准确率92.8%和链可靠性89.0%，LGG率最低为6.2%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的多跳推理不能仅靠局部步骤支持，必须同时满足问题对齐与答案闭合。E-Closure通过训练期监督三依赖关系，能兼顾准确率、局部可靠性与全局充分性，有效缓解LGG。

title: Learning an Anchored Prompt Space for Continual Adaptation of Large Language Models
summary: Continually adapting large language models requires acquiring new knowledge while preserving previously learned capabilities. Jointly adapting model parameters and task-specific soft prompts offers a promising solution, but faces two key limitations: historical prompts may become less effective as the model evolves, while their transferable cross-task relationships are not explicitly learned. We propose Learning an Anchored Prompt Space (LAPS), which preserves historical prompt effectiveness and learns relationships among task-specific soft prompts to facilitate positive transfer. LAPS first aligns historical prompts with the updated model through self-distillation. LAPS then constructs an anchored prompt space whose vertices correspond to learned task-specific soft prompts and whose intermediate geometry is shaped by learnable Bézier control prompts. Once this anchored prompt space is learned, LAPS identifies the best-performing prompt for each task on its validation set, allowing the optimized prompt to draw on knowledge acquired from observed tasks. Experiments on the TRACE benchmark across three Qwen3 model scales show that LAPS consistently outperforms distillation-based, prompt-based, and joint prompt--parameter adaptation baselines, improving average performance while reducing forgetting.

AI.tldr: LAPS通过结构化提示空间实现大语言模型持续适应，兼顾新知识获取与旧能力保留。
AI.motivation: 持续适应大语言模型需在获取新知识的同时保留旧能力。联合调整参数与任务软提示是有前景的方案，但存在两个问题：随模型演化历史提示会失效；任务间可迁移关系未被显式学习。
AI.method: 提出LAPS（Learning an Anchored Prompt Space）。先用自蒸馏将历史提示与更新后的模型对齐；再构建锚定提示空间，其顶点对应已学习任务软提示，中间几何由可学习Bézier控制提示塑造；学习后在各任务验证集上选择最佳提示，使优化提示可利用已见任务的知识。
AI.result: 在TRACE基准、三种Qwen3规模上，LAPS持续优于基于蒸馏、基于提示及提示-参数联合适应基线，平均性能提升且遗忘减少。
AI.conclusion: 锚定提示空间通过自蒸馏对齐与Bézier几何建模，显式学习任务提示间关系，实现正向迁移，是持续适应的有效方案。

title: GeoCR: Learning a Generalist Cloud Removal Prior from Heterogeneous Observations
summary: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GeoCR，一种通用云去除模型，在单一网络中统一了 RGB 与多光谱、单时相与多时相、可选 SAR 引导等多种输入配置，通过冻结预训练 RGB 自编码器主干并仅训练紧凑的输入/输出 stem 与共享 latent 接口，在十个数据集上联合预训练，实现跨数据集直接推理与 LoRA 高效适配。
AI.motivation: 现有云去除方法通常针对特定数据集和输入配置进行专门设计，难以在不同传感器、光谱波段和观测设置之间复用，缺乏可迁移的通用模型。作者希望构建一个能跨异构配置共享云去除先验的通用生成模型。
AI.method: GeoCR 以预训练的 RGB 自编码器为基础，保持其编码器和解码器主干冻结，仅引入紧凑的输入与输出 stem 以适配不同光谱域与传感域。该共享 latent 接口使单个 flow transformer 能够联合建模干净 RGB 与非 RGB latent，并以独立的云观测流和可选 SAR token 为条件。模型在十个数据集的训练划分（共 883,331 张无云目标图像）上联合预训练，学习跨异构配置的共享云去除先验；同一预训练权重支持无需数据集特定微调的直接推理，也可通过 LoRA 进行高效适配。
AI.result: 在贡献数据集测试划分的全波段与仅 RGB 设置下，对照通用图像复原方法与其他云去除方法进行评估。GeoCR 在全波段 SEN12MS-CR、Sen2_MTC_New 以及仅 RGB 的 CUHK-CR2 上取得最佳 FID 和 DISTS，优于现有模型。
AI.conclusion: GeoCR 证明了可复用的通用生成模型在多样云去除设置下的有效性：单一网络即可统一多种输入配置，并通过共享预训练先验实现跨数据集直接推理与高效适配，为通用云去除提供了可行范式。

title: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Writer Adaptation for Real-World Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
comment: Accepted at the 32nd IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP 2026)
summary: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) refers to the task of recognizing and converting handwritten mathematics into a parsable markup language, usually LaTeX. No current state-of-the-art-competitive system adjusts to the way a specific person writes, and the domain gap between training images (usually digital or perfectly binarized) and images physically taken with a camera used in inference has received fairly little attention for this specific problem. We characterize this domain gap through fragmentation and stroke-width analyses of the images as well as introduce a writer-adaptive fine-tuning pipeline to MFH-CoMER in an attempt to address it. We further introduce sample author-specific datasets, consisting of five handwriting category subsets from two authors, and evaluate using a McNemar's test and permutation tests adapted to limited data. Results suggest an increase in expression recognition rate and a decrease in CER for digital handwriting but more varied results for physical handwriting, with the model struggling for handwriting articles that the base model can already evaluate well. Nonetheless, adapted models were found to have improved results for four out of five subsets. Statistical testing results suggest a consistency in improvement for two of the tested author-specific subsets. Our results point towards the potential feasibility of writer adaptation for the HMER task.

AI.tldr: 本文针对手写数学表达式识别（HMER）中的作者写作风格差异和训练-推理域间差距，通过图像碎片化与笔画宽度分析刻画域差距，并提出面向MFH-CoMER的作者自适应微调流程。
AI.motivation: 现有HMER系统均无法适应特定作者的书写方式，且训练图像（数字化或完美二值化）与推理时相机拍摄图像之间存在域差距，该问题在HMER领域关注甚少。
AI.method: 通过碎片化（fragmentation）与笔画宽度（stroke-width）分析刻画域差距；在MFH-CoMER上引入作者自适应微调流水线；构建包含两位作者、五个手写类别子集的作者特定数据集；采用适用于小样本的McNemar检验与置换检验进行评估。
AI.result: 数字手写场景下表达式识别率提升、CER下降；物理手写场景结果差异较大，模型在基模型已能较好评估的手写样本上表现吃力；但自适应模型在五个子集中的四个上取得改进，统计检验显示其中两个作者特定子集的提升具有一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明作者自适应在HMER任务中具有一定可行性。

title: LocalProp: Neuro-Localized Memory-Efficient Backpropagation
summary: The current deep learning training paradigm employs end-to-end backpropagation, regardless of the training stage, i.e. pre-training or fine-tuning. However, backpropagating through the entire model is neither biologically plausible nor memory efficient, since learning inside the brain is highly localized. Therefore, we propose LocalProp, a training procedure that locally updates the weights of a model. Our neuro-localized weight updates follow the "pre-training then fine-tuning" paradigm, where the pre-training is based on I-JEPA. After locally updating the weights, a pruning operation is performed, followed by a short final fine-tuning phase. Pruning helps by sending the learning signal from higher blocks to lower blocks. We perform experiments on several datasets, including large-scale benchmarks such as ImageNet, and empirically show that LocalProp reaches good performance at a fraction of GPU peak memory. By varying the number of jointly optimized blocks, we identify gradient-propagation span as a practical control over the accuracy-memory trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LocalProp，一种在"预训练-微调"范式下对模型权重进行局部更新的训练方法，无需端到端反向传播，在大幅降低显存占用的同时取得良好性能。
AI.motivation: 当前深度学习训练（无论预训练还是微调）均采用端到端反向传播，但贯穿整个模型的反向传播既不符合大脑学习高度局部化的生物学特性，也不具备内存效率。
AI.method: LocalProp 采用神经局部化权重更新：遵循"先预训练后微调"范式，预训练基于 I-JEPA；局部更新权重后执行剪枝操作，再进行一次短时最终微调。剪枝作用在于将高层模块的学习信号传递到低层模块。通过改变联合优化的模块数量，将"梯度传播跨度"作为精度-内存权衡的可控调节手段。
AI.result: 在多个数据集（含 ImageNet 等大规模基准）上的实验表明，LocalProp 仅消耗峰值 GPU 显存的一小部分即可达到良好性能。
AI.conclusion: LocalProp 验证了局部化、非端到端训练在大规模任务上的可行性，并通过梯度传播跨度提供了精度与内存之间的实用折中控制。

title: UnStep: Training-Free Acceleration of Causal Video Diffusion with Fewer Steps Than Distillation
summary: Distilling bidirectional multi-step video diffusion transformers into few-step causal models has become a common approach for streaming video generation. While these few-step students are significantly faster than the teachers they are distilled from, they remain slow for real-time generation. In this work we present UnStep, a training-free wrapper that accelerates few-step causal video models at inference by running them with fewer diffusion transformer (DiT) steps than during distillation and limiting the temporal window retained in the attention KV cache. We propose two inference-only mechanisms to recover quality lost by step reduction and attention windowing: renoising the generated latent frames to a near-clean level and reusing the existing clean-cache pass to refine them, and applying truncated SVD to the DiT attention value and output projections. We also accelerate inference with a quality-preserving runtime stack for the DiT and VAE decoder, including more efficient attention calls and KV indexing, fused Triton RoPE with cached coefficients, and VAE decoding with optimized memory layout, precision, and convolution kernels. By reducing computation and optimizing the runtime stack, UnStep sets a new throughput regime for causal video diffusion, by running substantially faster than current methods, reaching 50 FPS on a single H100 without quality loss, and 77 FPS on GB200, all without retraining.

AI.tldr: UnStep是一个免训练推理加速框架，通过减少扩散步数、限制注意力KV缓存时序窗口，并配合去噪修复、截断SVD及运行时栈优化，将少步因果视频扩散模型加速至单卡H100上50 FPS、GB200上77 FPS且无质量损失。
AI.motivation: 少步因果视频扩散模型虽比其教师模型快，但仍难以满足实时生成需求。作者希望在不重新训练的前提下进一步加速推理。
AI.method: 提出免训练包装器UnStep：推理时使用比蒸馏时更少的DiT步数并限制注意力KV缓存保留的时序窗口；用两种仅推理机制补偿质量损失——对生成的隐帧重新加噪至近干净水平并复用已有干净缓存进行精修，以及对DiT注意力的value和输出投影应用截断SVD；同时引入质量保持的运行时优化栈，包括更高效注意力调用与KV索引、融合Triton RoPE与缓存系数、以及优化内存布局/精度/卷积核的VAE解码。
AI.result: UnStep显著快于现有方法，在单张H100上达到50 FPS、在GB200上达到77 FPS，且无质量损失，无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: UnStep为因果视频扩散设立了新的吞吐量范式，证明通过推理级机制与运行时优化的结合，可在不重训练的情况下实现实时高质量流式视频生成。

title: When Users Change Their Minds: Measuring and Repairing Intent Drift in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents often operate over multi-turn interactions in which user intent changes before execution. We study intent drift: the failure mode in which superseded parts of the user's intent continue to influence the final answer or tool action. We introduce IntentFlux, an executable benchmark that converts verifiable tasks into dialogues with controlled intent changes while preserving their original graders. In a 627-case calibration, mean task score falls from 0.476 to 0.384 as dialogues contain more superseded and withdrawn information. Across eight models, the rate of fully correct solutions is significantly lower when the same final task must be recovered from an evolving dialogue rather than given directly in a single turn. We further introduce StateForge, which explicitly maintains the active requirements before generation. On General-Test, it improves mean task score from 0.367 to 0.467. Providing the ground-truth final state improves performance further but still does not recover single-turn performance, indicating that state-estimation errors explain only part of the gap. These results establish intent drift as a measurable multi-turn failure mode and explicit state maintenance as a partial mitigation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并量化了多轮交互中"意图漂移"(intent drift)这一失效模式：用户被取代的旧意图仍会影响最终答案，并给出可执行基准IntentFlux与部分缓解方案StateForge。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体常在多轮交互中运行，用户意图在最终执行前会发生变化。然而现有研究缺乏对这一现象的度量：当用户意图被后续对话取代或撤回时，被取代的意图片段仍可能持续影响模型的最终回答或工具调用，导致性能下降。作者希望将这一失效模式定义清晰、可测量并加以缓解。
AI.method: 1) 提出IntentFlux——一个可执行基准，将可验证任务转换为包含受控意图变化的对话，同时保留原始评测器(grader)以确保结果可验证。2) 进行627个案例的校准实验，考察被取代(superseded)与撤回(withdrawn)信息随对话增加时的任务得分变化。3) 在八个模型上比较"单轮直接给定最终任务"与"需从演进对话中恢复最终任务"的完全正确率。4) 提出StateForge方法，在生成前显式维护当前活跃需求(active requirements)，并额外提供真实最终状态(ground-truth final state)作为上界对照。
AI.result: 校准实验中，随着对话含有更多被取代与撤回信息，平均任务得分从0.476降至0.384。在八个模型上，当同一最终任务需从演进对话中恢复时，完全正确解的比例显著低于单轮直接给定。StateForge在General-Test上将平均任务得分从0.367提升至0.467。提供真实最终状态可进一步提升性能，但仍无法恢复到单轮水平，说明状态估计错误只能解释性能差距的一部分。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确认意图漂移是一种可测量的多轮失效模式，而显式状态维护(StateForge)是一种部分有效的缓解手段。由于即使给定真实最终状态也无法完全恢复单轮性能，说明该差距还涉及除状态估计之外的机制，为后续研究指明了方向。

title: SetOPD: From Few Visual Exemplars to Multimodal Candidate Sets for Remote-Sensing Open-Prompt Detection
summary: Open-prompt detectors allow users to specify targets with text, visual exemplars, or both. We argue that existing designs underuse the visual modality in two ways. First, multiple exemplars are commonly compressed into a single class-level embedding. This textualizes visual prompting: the resulting vector plays the role of another class name, is often aligned to or injected into the text pathway, and may be suboptimal when only a few heterogeneous exemplars are available. Second, existing methods interact primarily in prompt or representation space, before modality-specific detection states are formed. We address both issues from a set perspective: \setopd preserves modality-specific decoding states from a shared prompt-conditioned initialization and performs explicit multimodal collaboration at the candidate-state level. For the first issue, we introduce \br prompting, which reads every boxed exemplar in its full scene context and decomposes the pooled support evidence into a Base anchor and a learned Residual correction; the resulting prompt has fixed capacity regardless of the number of examples and drives its own visual detection pathway. For the second, we recast text--visual collaboration from representation-level fusion into a candidate-set modeling problem. Paired-Query Arbitration (\pqa) then performs explicit cross-modal state arbitration only after modality-specific candidate states have been formed. The two readers share query initialization so their candidates are paired by index; a learned gate arbitrates within each pair, followed by a permutation-equivariant module that reasons over the fused set.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 \setopd，一种从集合视角重构开放提示检测的框架，包含 \br 提示（将视觉示例证据分解为 Base 锚点与学习的 Residual 修正，使提示容量固定）与 \pqa 配对查询仲裁（在模态专属候选状态形成后进行显式跨模态仲裁），以更充分地利用视觉模态。
AI.motivation: 现有开放提示检测器在两方面低估了视觉模态的价值：其一，多个视觉示例常被压缩为单一类别级嵌入，等同于将视觉提示"文本化"，该向量沦为另一个类名、被对齐或注入文本通路，且在仅有少量异构示例时表现次优；其二，现有方法主要在提示空间或表示空间进行交互，交互发生在模态专属检测状态形成之前。作者试图从集合视角同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: \setopd 保留来自共享提示条件初始化的模态专属解码状态，并在候选状态层面进行显式多模态协作。针对第一个问题，提出 \br 提示：在完整场景上下文中读取每个带框示例，将池化的支持证据分解为 Base 锚点与学习的 Residual 修正，所得提示容量固定、与示例数量无关，并驱动自身独立的视觉检测通路。针对第二个问题，将文本—视觉协作从表示级融合重构为候选集建模问题：\pqa 在模态专属候选状态形成之后执行显式跨模态状态仲裁。两个读取器共享查询初始化，使候选按索引配对；学习门控在每个配对内进行仲裁，随后由置换等变模块对融合集合进行推理。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体量化实验结果或数据集指标，仅给出方法的机制性结论（作为分析报告应如实说明摘要未报告实证数值）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作指出开放提示检测对视觉模态利用不足的两个设计缺陷，并以集合视角提出 \setopd：通过 \br 提示在视觉通路中保留固定容量的支持证据表示，通过 \pqa 将跨模态协作推迟到候选状态层面的配对仲裁，从而替代文本化的视觉提示与表示级早期融合。

title: Activation Flow: Manufacturing Activations for Steering
summary: Difference-in-means steering requires activations recorded while a model shows the desired behavior, which a sandbagging model withholds by deliberately underperforming. We introduce Activation Flow (ActFlow), which manufactures these activations from $k$ correct labels without fine-tuning. ActFlow sets target logits that rank each labeled item's correct answer first, and moves the logits toward them by adding one vector $x$ to all $k$ residual streams at one layer. ActFlow is a family of ordinary differential equations for $x$, one for each rule that maps the required logit change to the velocity of $x$. The smallest-norm rule lands exactly on the targets, while the others keep only the top singular directions of the Jacobian. We test ActFlow on three instruction-tuned models, each locked by a sandbagging prompt and by a password-locked LoRA. At $k=40$, ActFlow keeping five singular directions raises the mean held-out ARC-Easy accuracy over the six locked models from $0.05$ to $0.85$, against $0.88$ for rank-$16$ LoRA fine-tuning, which trains about $3{,}000$ times as many parameters, and $0.92$ for the honest models. Furthermore, it scores higher than the smallest-norm rule in 16 of the 18 combinations of locked model and $k$, and its steering direction is nearly orthogonal to the honest difference-in-means direction. It also unlocks two LoRA locks where the honest direction fails. Surprisingly, with one labeled item, the single-step smallest-norm rule raises the Qwen2.5-7B prompt lock from $0.04$ to $0.59$.

AI.tldr: ActFlow 无需微调，仅用 k 个正确标签即可合成激活转向向量，在沙袋/密码锁定模型上将 ARC-Easy 平均准确率从 0.05 提升至 0.85。
AI.motivation: 差分均值（difference-in-means）转向依赖模型表现目标行为时记录的激活，而沙袋模型会故意低性能从而掩盖这些激活，导致无法获取。
AI.method: ActFlow 设定目标 logits 使每个标注样本的正确答案排名第一，通过在一层向全部 k 个残差流加入同一向量 x 来逼近目标。它将所需 logit 变化映射为 x 的速度，构成一族常微分方程：最小范数规则精确落在目标上，其余规则仅保留 Jacobian 的顶部奇异方向。
AI.result: 在三个指令微调模型（各由沙袋提示和密码锁定 LoRA 锁定）上测试：k=40 时，保留五个奇异方向的 ActFlow 将六个锁定模型的留出 ARC-Easy 平均准确率从 0.05 提至 0.85，接近 rank-16 LoRA 微调的 0.88（其参数量约 3000 倍）与诚实模型的 0.92；在 18 种锁定模型与 k 组合中有 16 种优于最小范数规则，转向方向与诚实差分均值方向近乎正交，并在诚实方向失效的两个 LoRA 锁上实现解锁。单标签时单步最小范数规则将 Qwen2.5-7B 提示锁从 0.04 提至 0.59。
AI.conclusion: ActFlow 能从少量正确标签合成高效转向向量，无需微调即可解除沙袋与密码锁，性能接近全参数微调，且其机制区别于传统差分均值方向。

title: DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth
summary: Depth is a natural way to increase the computational capacity in Transformers, yet the contribution of deeper layers can diminish as depth grows larger. Recent approaches enhance normalization (\text{e.g.}, LayerNorm Scaling) or residual connections (\text{e.g.}, mHC, AttnRes) to enable better information flow and depth utilization. However, it remains unclear whether they truly translate increased architectural depth into effective computational depth, and whether their reported gains stem from better access to information across depth, or unaccounted-for confounding factors. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DepthBench}, a controlled benchmark for studying computational depth across various architectures. We systematically vary the width--depth aspect ratio ($d_{\text{model}}/n_{\text{layer}}$) from shallow--wide to deep--narrow shapes, while keeping the model size and pre-training recipe fixed. Across 10 representative architectures, we find that the benefit of allocating more capacity to depth is strongly architecture-dependent. Standard Pre-LN and most of its norm- and scaling-based variants provide little benefit and can even degrade performance as models become deeper and narrower, whereas HC and Full AttnRes improve consistently even at extreme deep shapes. These gains extend beyond pre-training loss and consistently translate into improved domain-specific performance and effective computation. Controlled layer-level analyses further show that the gains of HC and Full AttnRes are associated with more effective utilization of additional layers, revealing distinct mechanisms of computational depth across architectures. Overall, our results identify residual connection design as a key determinant of whether depth can serve as a meaningful scaling axis by enabling additional architectural depth to translate into effective computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出受控基准 DepthBench，系统研究不同架构下架构深度能否转化为有效计算深度，发现残差连接设计是决定深度能否成为有意义扩展轴的关键。
AI.motivation: 深度本可自然提升 Transformer 的计算容量，但更深层数带来的贡献会随深度增长而衰减。近期通过改进归一化（如 LayerNorm Scaling）或残差连接（如 mHC、AttnRes）来改善信息流与深度利用，但其是否真正把架构深度转化为有效计算深度尚不明确，收益来源也可能是未被控制的混淆因素。因此需要一个受控基准来研究跨架构的计算深度。
AI.method: 提出 DepthBench 受控基准。在固定模型规模与预训练配方的前提下，系统改变宽度—深度纵横比（d_model / n_layer），从浅宽到深窄形状，覆盖 10 种代表性架构进行对比。此外进行受控的层级分析。
AI.result: 将更多容量分配给深度的收益强烈依赖架构。标准 Pre-LN 及多数基于归一化和缩放的变体收益甚微，甚至随模型更深更窄而性能退化；而 HC 与 Full AttnRes 即使在极端深窄形状下也持续改善。这些增益不仅体现在预训练损失上，还一致地转化为领域特定性能和有效计算的提升。层级分析显示 HC 与 Full AttnRes 的增益与更有效利用额外层相关，揭示不同架构在计算深度上的机制差异。
AI.conclusion: 残差连接设计是决定深度能否作为有意义扩展轴的关键因素，它使额外的架构深度能够转化为有效计算。

title: Do Audio LLMs Listen Before They Act? Diagnosing Acoustic-Context Gating in Voice Agents
summary: Audio language models can recognize spoken commands and invoke tools, but an agent must first decide whether the acoustic and conversational context warrants action. We introduce VGBench, a 1,018-item diagnostic benchmark for action-level addressedness across side-talk, self-talk, and speaker-switch scenarios. Each item uses a shared action space comprising silence, a tool call, and a natural-language answer. Speaker-switch pairs hold the specified words fixed while source, distance rendering, and a temporal boundary define a controlled wearer-to-bystander shift. Six raw Audio LLMs and three training-free adaptations often identify the target tool yet rarely withhold action under this shift; the highest raw switch mute rate is 14%. We then use VoxGate as a post-training case study. Supervised training mutes 91.3% of switched commands while choosing the correct tool for all nearby wearer commands and text-only controls. An exploratory GRPO stage has similar switch performance; side-talk accuracy rises from 68.4% to 70.9%, and self-talk muting from 52.0% to 60.0%. Factorized controls identify an independent source-change effect, while sensitivity to the far-field manipulation varies across acoustic renderings. The benchmark therefore measures multi-cue acoustic-context gating rather than isolated speaker identity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VGBench，一个包含 1,018 条样本的诊断基准，用于评测音频语言模型在旁谈、自语与说话人切换场景下的"动作级被呼唤性"判断（即是否应执行动作）。实验表明现有音频大模型在说话人切换时很少抑制动作，最高静默率仅 14%；随后以 VoxGate 作为后训练案例，监督训练使切换指令静默率达 91.3%，GRPO 阶段进一步提升了旁谈与自语表现。
AI.motivation: 音频语言模型能够识别语音指令并调用工具，但智能体首先需要判断声学与对话语境是否值得采取行动。现有模型缺乏对"被呼唤性"（addressedness）的动作级判断能力，尤其在说话人切换等场景下容易误触发。
AI.method: 构建 VGBench 基准：1,018 条样本，覆盖旁谈、自语、说话人切换三类场景，共用统一动作空间（静默、工具调用、自然语言回答）。说话人切换对样本固定文字内容，通过声源、距离渲染与时间边界构造受控的佩戴者到旁听者转变。评测六个原始音频语言模型与三种免训练适配方法；并以 VoxGate 进行后训练案例研究，包括监督训练与探索性 GRPO 阶段。
AI.result: 六个原始音频语言模型与三种免训练适配常能识别目标工具，但在说话人切换下极少抑制动作，最高原始切换静默率仅 14%。监督训练使切换指令静默率达 91.3%，同时对邻近佩戴者指令与纯文本控制均选择正确工具；GRPO 阶段切换性能相近，旁谈准确率由 68.4% 提升至 70.9%，自语静默率由 52.0% 提升至 60.0%。因子化控制实验发现独立的声源变化效应，而远场操纵的敏感性在不同声学渲染间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 该基准衡量的是多线索声学语境门控能力，而非孤立的说话人身份识别。VGBench 可作为诊断与后训练音频语言模型动作级被呼唤性判断的有效工具。

title: RIPE-MambaSpike: Resolution-Independent Spiking-State-Space Interfaces for Parameter-Efficient Event-Based Vision
summary: Spiking-Mamba hybrids reach strong accuracy on event-based vision, but existing designs often require tens of millions of parameters. Much of that cost comes from how the spiking front-end is connected to the state-space backbone rather than from the hybrid architecture itself. In a representative model, a single resolution-dependent projection accounts for 33.55M of 36.25M parameters. To that end, we introduce RIPE-MambaSpike (Resolution-Independent, Parameter-Efficient), which replaces that projection with a hierarchical multi-resolution bridge of fixed channel width. Its deployed footprint is 0.870M parameters, constant at fixed time steps and widths across a 43x range of input areas. Reparameterized spiking stages, temporal decoupled modulation, and a dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention preserve accuracy under this compact design. Result-wise, RIPE-MambaSpike is pareto-optimal on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, and DailyDVS-200. Notably, on the 200-class DailyDVS-200, a scaled 8.04M configuration achieves 45.7% top-1 accuracy, the best reported spiking result on that benchmark, and outperforms prior spiking methods with 3.0-15.1x fewer parameters than dense ANNs. Overall, our findings demonstrate that competitive event-based recognition does not require resolution-dependent parameter growth. Code is available at https://github.com/MuhiminOsim/RIPE-MambaSpike.

AI.tldr: 提出 RIPE-MambaSpike，用分辨率无关的层次化多分辨率桥接替换导致参数爆炸的投影层，以0.870M参数量在多个事件视觉基准上达到 Pareto 最优。
AI.motivation: 现有 Spiking-Mamba 混合模型在事件视觉任务上精度高，但参数量常达数千万。分析发现开销主要来自脉冲前端与状态空间骨干之间的连接方式（分辨率相关的投影层），而非混合架构本身：代表性模型中单个投影即占36.25M参数中的33.55M。
AI.method: 以固定通道宽度的层次化多分辨率桥接替代分辨率相关投影；结合重参数化脉冲阶段、时间解耦调制，以及动态凸包约束的双流膜电位注意力，在紧凑设计下保持精度。部署参数量0.870M，在43倍输入面积范围内保持恒定。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101、DailyDVS-200 上达到 Pareto 最优。DailyDVS-200（200类）上，8.04M 配置取得45.7% top-1，为该基准已报告的最佳脉冲结果，并以比密集ANN少3.0-15.1倍的参数量超越先前脉冲方法。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性的事件识别性能不依赖分辨率相关的参数增长，紧凑的脉冲-Mamba混合设计即可实现高精度与高参数效率。代码已开源。

title: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion drift among chunks. To complement it, FlashForward produces sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents before the corresponding region is generated so the generation trajectories can be stabilized by this two-sided conditioning. The two memories operate at different temporal scales: sparse clean anchor KV supplies coarse, long-range two-sided structural guidance, while dense stage-matched history preserves fine, recent evolution. With up to four GPUs, FlashForward runs $1.16$--$1.69\times$ faster than HiAR and $1.42$--$2.92\times$ faster than Self-Forcing for 16 FPS videos of 20 seconds or longer across 1.3B and 14B backbone scales at 480p and 720p. On VBench, for the 1.3B model at 480p, it achieves higher scores and remains stable at longer durations, demonstrating that FlashForward generates high-quality and temporally consistent videos across durations of 20s, 35s and 65s at a much faster generation speed.

AI.tldr: FlashForward 复用去噪前向中已计算的 KV 缓存替代额外的仅更新缓存前向，并辅以稀疏干净锚点 KV 做双侧条件，实现少步自回归视频扩散的加速与长时一致性提升。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频扩散为记忆已生成 chunk，需通过额外的模型前向重建干净或低噪的 KV 缓存，但这不推进输出 latent，开销大且冗余。作者观察到每次去噪前向本身就计算了当前 chunk 的在途 KV，因此希望直接复用该缓存以消除仅更新缓存的前向。
AI.method: 令当前 chunk 完成一个去噪阶段后，其阶段专属 KV 缓存即可供下一 chunk 使用；将每个去噪阶段分配到不同 GPU，使不同 chunk 可并发占用不同阶段。针对由此引入的、阶段匹配历史噪声导致的画质与运动漂移，FlashForward 在对应区域生成前产生稀疏的辅助干净锚点 latent，形成双侧条件：稀疏干净锚点 KV 提供粗粒度长程双侧结构引导，密集阶段匹配历史保留细粒度近期演化。
AI.result: 最多 4 块 GPU 时，20 秒及以上的 16 FPS 视频上，FlashForward 比 HiAR 快 1.16–1.69×，比 Self-Forcing 快 1.42–2.92×，覆盖 1.3B 与 14B 主干规模、480p 与 720p。VBench 上，1.3B/480p 取得更高分数，并在更长时长下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: FlashForward 通过复用去噪前向的在途 KV 缓存并叠加稀疏干净锚点双侧条件，在 20s、35s、65s 时长上生成高质量、时序一致且速度显著更快的视频，验证了缓存复用加双侧记忆设计的有效性。

title: Shared Autoregressive Context Can Distort Relationships in Synthetic Data
summary: Large language models can generate several records within one autoregressive completion, making earlier answers available as context for later records. This paper shows that such shared-completion batching can distort relationships among variables in the resulting synthetic data, using controlled tests on synthetic survey respondents. In a matched experiment on 2,000 European Social Survey profiles, generating ten rather than one respondent per request increases mean absolute error in within-country correlations by 48-58% for Qwen3.8-27B and 114-127% for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct across three seeds, holding profiles, examples, questions and decoding parameters fixed. The distortion primarily reflects exaggerated relationship strength, while retaining substantial agreement with the human ordering of correlations. Controlled interventions establish answer history as a causal channel: re-pairing the same preceding values, with profiles and marginal distributions fixed, changes correlations among subsequently generated responses. Hiding preceding answers reduces correlation error in the tested settings but worsens marginal accuracy. Exploratory corrections across social-attitude, health and economic data likewise show that lower correlation error can coexist with worse marginal distributions and regression estimates. Request construction is therefore part of the data-generating process, and synthetic-data validity must be evaluated against the analyses the generated data are intended to support.

AI.tldr: 在大语言模型"共享完成批量生成"（一次自回归生成多条记录）中，先前生成的答案会成为后续记录的上下文，从而系统性地扭曲合成数据中变量间的关系；该效应在受控实验中可复现、可由回答历史因果解释，并提示请求构造本身即数据生成过程的一部分。
AI.motivation: LLM 可在一次自回归补全中生成多条记录，前序答案会作为后序记录的上下文，形成"共享完成批量"（shared-completion batching）。这种做法常用于降低合成数据生成成本，但其对变量关系（如相关系数）的影响未被系统检验。论文动机是检验这种高效批量生成是否会以牺牲合成数据的统计有效性为代价，并厘清其机制与边界。
AI.method: 以合成调查受访者为受控实验对象。在 2,000 份欧洲社会调查（European Social Survey）人物画像上做匹配实验，固定画像、示例、问题与解码参数，仅改变每请求生成 1 条还是 10 条记录；模型为 Qwen3.8-27B 与 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct，三个随机种子。以国家内相关系数的平均绝对误差为指标。进一步做受控干预：在固定画像与边际分布的前提下重新配对前序答案值，以检验"回答历史"是否为因果渠道；并测试隐藏前序答案的效果。最后在社会态度、健康与经济数据上做探索性校正。
AI.result: 相比每次生成 1 条，每次生成 10 条使国家内相关系数的平均绝对误差上升：Qwen3.8-27B 上升 48–58%，Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上升 114–127%（三个种子）。扭曲主要表现为关系强度被夸大，但仍较好保留了相关系数的人类排序。干预实验显示回答历史是因果渠道：仅重新配对前序数值即可改变后续生成答案间的相关性。隐藏前序答案可降低相关系数误差，但边际精度变差。跨社会态度、健康、经济数据的探索性校正亦显示，相关系数误差降低可能与更差的边际分布和回归估计并存。
AI.conclusion: 请求构造（每次请求生成多少条记录、前序答案是否可见）是数据生成过程的组成部分，而非中性的采样选择。合成数据的有效性不能仅凭单一指标判定，必须针对该数据所服务的目标分析（如相关性、边际分布、回归估计）进行评价，因为不同效度维度之间存在权衡。

title: Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Interaction Modeling
summary: Text-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires body motion, object trajectories & rotations, and hand articulation to remain coordinated. These components differ in scale and dynamics, but must agree on contact, relative pose, and timing. A shared representation may limit the distinct structure of each stream, while independent generation prevents each stream from responding to changes in the others. Latent supervision alone also does not directly constrain contact after decoding. We propose TRACE, a continuous latent framework that keeps stream states separate and couples their updates. TRACE encodes body, object, and hand motion into separate latents and predicts each stream velocity from the complete current interaction state. Geometric losses on decoded motion further constrain contact and object-relative motion over time. The same model supports completion of any single absent stream from the other two. Frozen flow features also serve as input to a language model for HOI understanding. Experiments on InterAct, OMOMO, and BEHAVE show that joint completion training improves generation and that frozen flow features improve understanding over raw-motion encoding. On InterAct, TRACE achieves the highest contact precision, recall, and F1 among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 TRACE 框架：以分离的流状态潜变量配合耦合更新，实现文本条件下的身体-物体-手部协调的 HOI 生成，并通过解码域几何损失约束接触与相对运动。
AI.motivation: 文本条件 HOI 生成需同时满足身体运动、物体轨迹与旋转、手部关节的协调：三者尺度与动力学不同，但必须在接触、相对位姿与时序上一致。共享表征会削弱各流的独立结构，独立生成又使各流无法响应彼此的动态变化，仅依赖潜空间监督也无法直接约束解码后的接触。
AI.method: 1) 连续潜变量框架，保持身体、物体、手部三个流的潜状态相互分离，同时耦合其更新；2) 由完整交互状态预测各流的速度；3) 在解码后的运动上施加几何损失，显式约束接触与物体相对运动的时间一致性；4) 同一模型支持由另两流补全任一缺失流；5) 使用冻结的 flow 特征作为语言模型输入，用于 HOI 理解。
AI.result: 在 InterAct、OMOMO、BEHAVE 数据集上：联合补全训练提升生成质量；冻结 flow 特征相比原始运动编码提升 HOI 理解性能；在 InterAct 上取得对比方法中最高的接触精确率、召回率与 F1。
AI.conclusion: 分离但耦合的潜变量建模结合解码域几何约束，能有效提升多流 HOI 生成的接触一致性与协调性，并统一支持流补全与 HOI 理解任务。

title: Feature Space Guidance for Breast Cancer Classification in DCE-MRI
summary: Dynamic contrast enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is a powerful clinical tool for breast cancer detection, providing high resolution anatomical detail together with rich temporal contrast information. However, high dimensional 4D inputs, small lesions, and heterogeneous acquisition protocols across clinical sites hinder robust automated classification of healthy, benign, and malignant cases. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that dynamically analyzes latent representations to adapt to protocol-specific characteristics. Spatial variability is mitigated by reducing confounding background uptake and compensating for misalignment caused by deformable soft tissue. Additionally, relationships in the latent space across phases are leveraged to select the most informative temporal features, improving robustness to protocol-specific temporal variability. Finally, task specific discriminative features are promoted through large scale supervised lesion segmentation pretraining, which substantially enhances downstream finetuning. Evaluated under leave-one-center-out validation on the ODELIA dataset and the held-out AMBL cohort, the proposed framework substantially outperforms finetuned radiology foundation models and prior methods, improving mean AUROC by nearly 8 points and balanced accuracy by 4 points over the strongest baseline. Additionally, our method achieved first place in the MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025, further demonstrating its effectiveness for robust breast cancer classification. We publicly release our codebase under https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种动态分析隐表征的DCE-MRI乳腺癌分类框架，通过抑制背景摄取的干扰、补偿软组织形变错位、跨期隐空间关系选择时序特征，并用病灶分割预训练增强下游微调；在ODELIA留一中心验证与AMBL队列上平均AUROC提升近8点、平衡准确率提升4点，并获MICCAI ODELIA 2025挑战赛第一名。
AI.motivation: DCE-MRI是乳腺癌检测的有力工具，但高维4D输入、小病灶以及跨临床中心采集协议异质性，严重阻碍了对健康、良性、恶性病例的稳健自动分类。
AI.method: 提出动态分析潜在表征以适配协议特征的框架：通过减少混杂背景摄取并补偿软组织形变导致的错位来缓解空间变异；利用跨期隐空间关系选择最具信息量的时序特征，提升对协议时序差异的鲁棒性；通过大规模有监督病灶分割预训练促进任务特定判别特征，显著增强下游微调。
AI.result: 在ODELIA数据集上采用留一中心验证，并在独立AMBL队列上评估，性能显著优于微调的放射学基础模型与既有方法：平均AUROC较最强基线提升近8点，平衡准确率提升4点；同时在MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025中获得第一名。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效应对DCE-MRI跨中心协议异质性与高维输入挑战，实现稳健的乳腺癌分类，代码已在 https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor 公开。

title: Language as an Independent Information Layer: A Conceptual Model of Communication, Cognition and Decision-Making
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for publication in the proceedigns of ISBM 2026 (Springer LNNS)
summary: Based on an analysis of the role of language in thought and communication, this article proposes a new concept for designing corporate knowledge bases. The concept integrates the probabilistic vector space of a corporate vocabulary, reflect-ing industry specifics, subject focus, terminology, and culture, with traditional ontological modeling. This combination enables the efficient extraction of knowledge from accumulated corporate documents while strictly accounting for specific business processes. Consequently, this concept bridges statistical and semantic (cause-and-effect) methodologies. Furthermore, analyzing the projec-tions of probabilistic spaces and causal relationships can help identify bottlenecks in business logic. As a dynamic system, language functions as a separate, inde-pendent layer within the overall information architecture. Introducing a dynamic component into the probabilistic space of word distribution allows it to be mod-eled as a multidimensional solution space for various problem formulations. In this context, input data defining the problem conditions serve as control parame-ters for dynamic transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文基于语言在思维与交流中作用的分析，提出一种融合企业词汇概率向量空间与本体建模的企业知识库设计新概念，以打通统计方法与语义（因果）方法。
AI.motivation: 现有企业知识库设计往往割裂统计方法与语义（因果）建模：概率方法擅长从海量文档中提取模式但缺乏业务逻辑约束，本体方法能刻画业务过程却难以高效利用积累文档。作者希望找到一种兼顾二者、并反映行业特性与业务过程的统一框架。
AI.method: 构建反映行业特点、主题重点、术语与文化的企业词汇概率向量空间，并将其与传统本体建模相结合；将语言视为整体信息架构中独立且动态的层次，在词分布概率空间中引入动态成分，使其成为面向多种问题表述的多维解空间，并以定义问题条件的输入数据作为动态变换的控制参数。
AI.result: 该概念实现了从企业积累文档中高效提取知识，同时严格对应具体业务流程；打通了统计方法与语义（因果）方法；通过分析概率空间投影与因果关系，可识别业务逻辑中的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 将企业词汇的概率向量空间与本体建模融合、并把语言作为动态独立层次引入，为企业知识库设计提供了一种统一统计与因果关系的新范式，并可用于业务逻辑瓶颈诊断。

title: CFCH: Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical Learning for Anterior Segment Disease Analysis
summary: Accurate classification of anterior segment diseases is crucial for ophthalmic screening and diagnosis. However, slit-lamp image analysis remains challenging due to substantial variability in imaging conditions and the intrinsic anatomical-disease hierarchy of ocular pathologies. Existing methods typically formulate this task as a flat multi-class classification problem, ignoring the structured dependency between anatomical regions (e.g., cornea, conjunctiva, and lens) and disease manifestations.To address these limitations, we propose CFCH, a Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning framework that explicitly models anatomical context and disease semantics through a dual-branch architecture. To enable effective cross-granularity collaboration, CFCH introduces semantic and cross-granularity attention consistency constraints, encouraging aligned yet complementary feature learning across branches. In addition, we construct AS-9K, a large-scale anterior segment dataset with 8975 images covering 12 common disease categories. To the best of our knowledge, AS-9K is the largest publicly available dataset for anterior segment image classification. Extensive experiments on two anterior segment datasets demonstrate that CFCH outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative visualizations further show more focused and lesion-relevant activation responses, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/ybupengwang/CFCH.

AI.tldr: 提出CFCH粗细协同分层学习框架，显式建模解剖上下文与疾病语义，并构建大规模前节图像数据集AS-9K，在两项数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 前节疾病分类对眼科筛查与诊断至关重要，但裂隙灯图像因成像条件差异大、眼病本身存在解剖-疾病的内在层级结构而难以分析。现有方法多将其简化为扁平多分类任务，忽略了角膜、结膜、晶状体等解剖区域与疾病表现之间的结构化依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出CFCH（Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning）框架，采用双分支架构显式建模解剖上下文与疾病语义；引入语义注意力一致性与跨粒度注意力一致性约束，促进跨粒度协同，实现双分支特征的对齐且互补学习。同时构建AS-9K数据集，含8975张图像、覆盖12类常见疾病。
AI.result: AS-9K是目前公开可用的最大前节图像分类数据集；在两个前节数据集上的大量实验表明CFCH优于现有SOTA方法；定性可视化显示其激活响应更聚焦、更贴合病灶区域。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层建模解剖-疾病结构并施加跨粒度一致性约束，CFCH有效提升前节疾病分类性能，验证了结构化分层学习在该任务中的必要性；代码将于指定GitHub地址开源。

title: How to Reduce Whisper Hallucination
summary: Whisper is still what runs in production: one permissively licensed checkpoint, 99 languages, no per-language tuning. But it writes sentences nobody said. On 42 clips of pure room tone, whisper-large-v3 emits words on 61.9% of them and emits something on 100%. The usual response is to distil a student from Whisper pseudo-labels, filtering the hallucinations out of the corpus first, which deletes the evidence while leaving the behaviour in place: the student is fitted to the subset where the teacher was right, and inherits a failure mode absent from its own training data. The second response, adding non-speech audio so the model learns to stay quiet, already ships and works, but teaches suppression without discrimination. The checkpoint best on every non-speech arm here is also the one that recovers the fewest genuinely spoken phrases and deletes 58% of repeated speech. The teacher has to be fixed, with both halves of the signal. Our benchmark scores both at once: 11,852 clips over eight arms, 6,267 synthetic positives, 8,296 clips of real audio that made a production model fail, and FLEURS in 58 languages. We collect 40,891 hallucination phrases in 100 languages, choose a text-to-speech system by measurement, and synthesise those phrases as positives, so the model meets the same text both as something to suppress and as something to transcribe. Across 33 matched pairs of fine-tunes differing only by those positives, adding them lowers word emission on real voice-free audio in 31 pairs and raises phrase recovery in 32; among the 30 pairs that hold English accuracy it is 30 out of 30. The best checkpoint takes hallucination on silence from 61.9% to 2.4% and words over real voice-free audio from 99.9% to 47.8%, while raising phrase recovery from 69.8% to 82.7%. The benchmark, lexicon and synthetic corpus are released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Scicom-intl/Whisper-Hallucination

AI.tldr: Whisper-large-v3在静音/无语音音频上大量输出虚假文字。作者主张不能只过滤或只做抑制，而要用同一批幻觉文本同时作为"抑制目标"和"转写目标"来修复教师模型，并发布含8个测试臂、11,852条音频的评测基准与多语言幻觉语料。
AI.motivation: Whisper仍是生产环境主力（单一宽松许可检查点、99种语言、无需按语言调优），但对纯房间底噪也会"写出没人说过的话"：42段纯底噪中whisper-large-v3有61.9%输出词、100%至少输出内容。现有两种应对各有缺陷：一是先过滤伪标签中的幻觉再蒸馏学生模型，等于删掉证据却保留行为，学生只拟合教师正确的子集，反而继承训练数据中不存在的失效模式；二是加入非语音音频训练抑制，虽已上线有效，但只教"闭嘴"不教"分辨"，在非语音各项最优的检查点同时漏掉最多真实语句、删除58%的重复语音。因此需要直接修复教师模型，且必须同时利用信号的两半。
AI.method: 构建同时评估"幻觉抑制"与"语音恢复"的基准：8个测试臂共11,852条音频，含6,267条合成正样本、8,296条使生产模型失败的真实音频、以及58种语言的FLEURS。收集100种语言的40,891条幻觉短语，通过测量挑选TTS系统，将这些短语合成为正样本，使模型在同一文本上既学习抑制又学习转写。实验采用33对仅在这些正样本上不同的匹配微调对进行对照。
AI.result: 在33对匹配微调中，加入这些正样本使31对在真实无语音音频上的词输出下降、32对短语恢复率上升；在保持英语准确率的30对中为30/30全胜。最优检查点将静音幻觉率从61.9%降至2.4%，真实无语音音频上的词输出从99.9%降至47.8%，同时短语恢复率从69.8%提升到82.7%。基准、词典与合成语料已开源。
AI.conclusion: 修复教师模型必须同时喂入信号的两半：把幻觉文本既当抑制对象又当转写对象，可在不牺牲真实语音恢复与英语准确率的前提下大幅降低无语音幻觉。作者发布基准、幻觉词典与合成语料供复现与后续研究。

title: Reading Is Not Leaking: Local, Auditable Measurement and Reduction of Inference Exposure from Public Footprints
summary: Anyone with a public footprint leaks facts that were never stated, and language models make the inference cheap. We present a framework for measuring and reducing this inference exposure that runs on the owner's own CPU with no language model at analysis time, instantiated on organisations and on individuals. It starts from a measurement result: scoring an inference system against the target's private truth conflates how well the system reads the record with how much the record leaks. On a 128-question instrument over sixteen synthetic firms, almost half of the questions are never answered correctly by any of six readers, four of them language models, and a majority-class guess accounts for most of every reader's score. We therefore separate reading accuracy from leakage rate and introduce an injection protocol that creates cells with known support. Our analyser combines rules, statistical solvers and a 106M-parameter encoder trained from scratch that marks verbatim evidence and never generates text; every answer carries a graded certificate whose recorded proof replays. Its certified answers are correct in 93% of resolved cases, against 49-73% for the language models' quote-backed answers, whose citations are produced alongside the answer rather than deriving it; with plain-prose articles in the record, 70% of its evidence-bearing answers rest on evidence that establishes them, against 18-56% for the models. A constrained defence that rewrites each fact's carrier as a true but coarser statement hides every single-carrier fact from four language-model adversaries at 40% lower edit cost than deletion. On sixteen synthetic people the guessing term is larger still, and a decoy planner with no language model halves the correct answers of the estimator it targets without transferring to a second.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个可在所有者本地CPU上运行、分析阶段不使用语言模型的推理暴露度量与削减框架，通过分离“读取准确率”与“泄漏率”、引入注入协议与可验证证书机制，在合成机构与个人数据上显著优于语言模型读取器。
AI.motivation: 公开足迹会隐含泄漏从未明说的事实，而语言模型使这类推理变得廉价；现有评测将“系统读取记录的能力”与“记录本身泄漏的程度”混为一谈，导致度量失真。
AI.method: 先在16家合成企业的128题工具上测量：近半题目无任何读取器答对，多数类猜测占据各读取器大部分得分。据此分离读取准确率与泄漏率，并提出创建已知支持度单元的注入协议。分析器结合规则、统计求解器与从零训练的106M参数编码器，仅标记逐字证据、不生成文本，每个答案附带可重放的评分证书。防御侧采用约束改写，将事实载体改写为真实但更粗粒度的陈述。
AI.result: 带证书答案在已解决案例中正确率93%，语言模型引用支持的答案仅49–73%；记录含普通散文时，其带证据答案有70%建立在可确立结论的证据上，模型为18–56%。约束防御以比删除低40%的编辑成本，对四个语言模型对手隐藏所有单载体事实。在16个合成人物上猜测项更大，无语言模型的诱饵规划器可将目标估计器的正确答案减半，但不迁移到第二个估计器。
AI.conclusion: 应把推理风险评测从“端到端准确率”转向读取准确率与泄漏率的分离，并以可验证证据、本地无语言模型分析与低成本的载体粗化实现可证明的暴露削减。

title: Attribution Gaps in Zero-Training LLM+OVOD Pipelines: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the CAAP--SNAP Discrepancy
summary: LAOD and similar zero-training LLM+open-vocabulary-detector (OVOD) pipelines score two things separately: class-agnostic localization accuracy (CAAP) and semantic naming accuracy (SNAP). The two consistently diverge, and nobody has asked why. This paper asks why, on the full 5,000-image COCO-Val split (27,273 detections) rather than the small subset the original work evaluated on. Object visual complexity turns out not to be the driver -- small and occluded objects are, if anything, localized better than large ones. Vocabulary novelty is: once the LLM's wording falls outside the detector's native category set, localization accuracy falls from 80.9% to 31.6%. That drop is not spread evenly across unfamiliar phrasing, though. Almost all of it comes from cases where the novel wording actually names a different object than the one COCO annotated (true synonyms still score 89.3%; semantically unrelated "noise" labels score 12.0%). A closer look at a further failure subset tells a similar story: 78-88% of what looks like complete localization failure is really the model correctly finding a real object that COCO's non-exhaustive 80-category scheme simply never labeled, not hallucination. Swap the detector backbone (YOLO-World for Grounding DINO) or the LLM (Gemma-3 for Qwen2.5-VL) and both the effect and its rough size hold up, so this looks like a general property of the pipeline family rather than a quirk of one model pairing. The upshot is that a large share of the apparent CAAP--SNAP gap traces back to closed-category annotation limits rather than a real grounding failure, which matters for how we detect hallucination, analyze failure modes, and design evaluation for grounded multimodal systems meant to work in the open world.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统追问LLM+开放词汇检测器(OVOD)流水线中定位精度(CAAP)与语义命名精度(SNAP)持续背离的原因，在完整COCO-Val 5000张图像上发现主因是词汇新颖性而非目标复杂度，且大部分"定位失败"实为COCO封闭类别标注缺失所致。
AI.motivation: 零训练的LLM+OVOD流水线在CAAP与SNAP两个指标上系统性背离，但此前无人探究原因；原始工作仅在小规模子集上评估，缺乏在全量数据上的可靠结论，这一背离直接影响幻觉检测、失败模式分析与开放世界评估设计。
AI.method: 在完整COCO-Val 5000张图像(27,273个检测)上进行评估，而非原工作的小子集。分别检验目标视觉复杂度(大小、遮挡)与词汇新颖性对CAAP的影响；将新颖措辞细分为真同义词与语义无关的"噪声"标签；进一步分析表面上的完全定位失败子集是否实为COCO非穷尽80类标注未覆盖；通过替换检测器骨干(YOLO-World→Grounding DINO)与LLM(Gemma-3→Qwen2.5-VL)进行跨模型泛化验证。
AI.result: 目标视觉复杂度并非主因，小目标与遮挡目标定位反而优于大目标。词汇新颖性才是关键：一旦LLM措辞超出检测器原生类别集，定位精度从80.9%降至31.6%。该下降高度集中——真同义词仍达89.3%，而语义无关"噪声"标签仅12.0%。在进一步失败子集中，78–88%貌似完全定位失败实为模型正确找到了COCO非穷尽80类方案从未标注的真实目标，而非幻觉。更换骨干或LLM后效应及其大致幅度依然成立。
AI.conclusion: CAAP–SNAP差距的很大部分源于封闭类别标注的局限，而非真实的grounding失败，这属于该流水线家族的普遍性质而非特定模型组合的偶然。该发现对幻觉检测、失败模式分析以及面向开放世界的grounded多模态系统评估设计具有重要影响。

title: OmniSmartHome: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Smart-Home Agents
summary: Smart-home assistants are expected to handle diverse, realistic requests that arise in daily life. In such interactions, users often rely on the surrounding multimodal context-pointing at objects or referring to what they see or hear, leaving their requests underspecified in language alone. Existing smart-home benchmarks, however, express user requests solely through language, leaving context-dependent real-world requests underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniSmartHome, a multimodal smart-home benchmark where each spoken request is paired with the surrounding visual and spatial-audio context, providing complementary cues to disambiguate underspecified requests. OmniSmartHome comprises 1,360 synthetic and 272 real-world episodes. We evaluate 16 omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) and reveal that, while they perform strongly when speech alone sufficiently conveys the user's intent, performance drops substantially when resolving it requires reasoning over multimodal contextual cues. As a simple agent baseline, we provide PROME (PROcedural Memory for multimodal Evidence gathering), which equips agents with specialized audio-visual perception tools and procedural memory for orchestrating their use. PROME generally improves performance across six Omni-LLMs. Demos and examples are available at https://omni-smart-home.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniSmartHome——一个多模态智能家居基准，将语音请求与视觉、空间音频上下文配对，以消解欠指定请求的歧义，并揭示现有 Omni-LLM 在多模态上下文推理上的明显短板。
AI.motivation: 现有智能家居基准仅用语言表达用户请求，忽略了真实场景中用户常借助指物、指所见所闻等周围多模态上下文，导致语言本身欠指定（underspecified）。这类依赖上下文消歧的真实请求尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建 OmniSmartHome 基准，包含 1,360 个合成与 272 个真实世界片段，每条语音请求都配有对应的视觉与空间音频上下文，提供互补线索以消解欠指定请求。评估 16 个全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLM），并提出简单智能体基线 PROME（面向多模态证据收集的过程记忆），为智能体配备专用音视频感知工具与过程记忆来编排工具调用。
AI.result: 当仅靠语音即可充分传达意图时，16 个 Omni-LLM 表现强劲；但当需要基于多模态上下文线索进行推理来消解意图时，性能大幅下降。PROME 在六个 Omni-LLM 上普遍提升性能。
AI.conclusion: OmniSmartHome 填补了上下文相关真实请求评估的空白，表明当前全模态模型在多模态上下文推理上仍存在显著不足；过程记忆加专用感知工具的智能体范式（PROME）是缓解该问题的有效方向。

title: CUE-Mem: Benchmarking Long-Term User Memory via Implicit Cues in Multimodal Conversations
comment: 28 pages. Submitted to AAAI 2027. Code: https://github.com/yulinlp/CUE-MEM. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Kkryptonite/CUE-Mem
summary: Long-term memory is essential for multimodal agents that interact with users across sustained conversations. However, user memories are not always explicitly stated: they may also be implied by recurring background objects in images, ambient sounds in audio, or other peripheral multimodal cues. Existing benchmarks largely focus on text-only memory or explicit multimodal evidence, leaving implicit multimodal cues underexplored. We introduce CUE-Mem, a text-image-audio benchmark for evaluating long-term user memory from implicit cues. CUE-Mem contains 2,674 questions across explicit and implicit evidence settings and covers four tasks: Entity Recall, Long Pattern, Personalized Recommendation, and Answer Refusal.
