ARSM introduces two key components: (i) a trajectory abstraction mechanism that reorganizes interaction histories into compact Hypothesis-Action-Result (HAR) micro-chains; (ii) a dynamic state machine that regulates hierarchical memory through atomic operations and a compression-control parameter. These components are unified within an auto-regressive, self-compressive generation space, where each model output jointly performs external action execution and internal state updates. We evaluate ARSM on Webshop, Multi-Objective Multi-Hop QA, and SWE-Bench Lite datasets. Experimental results show that ARSM maintains the task performance while simultaneously reducing token consumption, offering a practical, cost-effective route toward scalable autonomous agents for long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: ARSM是一个无需训练的轻量框架，通过结构化状态演化实现原位推理压缩，缓解LLM智能体长程任务中的上下文记忆瓶颈。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长程任务中通过推理与环境交互交替进行，但上下文持续累积迅速形成记忆瓶颈。现有记忆压缩方法依赖任务特定优化或外部辅助模型，计算开销大；且压缩表示易丢失结构化关系，导致信息稀释、注意力坍缩和决策一致性下降。
AI.method: 提出自回归状态机（ARSM），包含两个核心组件：（1）轨迹抽象机制，将交互历史重组为紧凑的Hypothesis-Action-Result（HAR）微链；（2）动态状态机，通过原子操作和压缩控制参数调控分层记忆。二者统一在自回归、自压缩的生成空间中，每次模型输出同时执行外部动作和内部状态更新。
AI.result: 在Webshop、Multi-Objective Multi-Hop QA和SWE-Bench Lite数据集上评估，ARSM在保持任务性能的同时减少了token消耗。
AI.conclusion: ARSM为长程任务的可扩展自主智能体提供了一条实用、低成本的路径。

title: FINE: Future-Informed Navigation Encoding for Data-Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Adapting vision-language navigation (VLN) policies to new environments is expensive because every additional route and instruction requires an embodied demonstration. Yet standard observation-to-action training uses only a small fraction of the information already contained in each trajectory. In particular, future observations reveal the instruction-relevant landmarks that the agent will encounter, including what they look like and how they are arranged in 3D. We introduce FINE, a Future-Informed Navigation Encoding framework that extracts this latent supervision from existing demonstrations. FINE equips a VLN backbone with two complementary auxiliary representations. First, explicit landmark tokens follow the ordered landmarks specified by the instruction and are trained to predict future landmark regions in both semantic 2D patch-feature space and viewpoint-dependent 3D geometric feature space. Second, an implicit future token learns to distinguish the landmark state that is actually reached from plausible same-scene counterfactual futures generated by a video world model. On R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, FINE improves InternVLA-N1 by 2.6 and 4.5 success-rate points, respectively, at full training data. More importantly, as demonstrations become limited, the benefit grows: at a 70% demonstration budget, FINE improves success rate by 6.8 points, recovering roughly one-third of the performance lost by reducing the training demonstrations. Project page is available at https://finevln.github.io/.

AI.tldr: FINE 是一个"未来感知导航编码"框架，从现有示范轨迹中挖掘未来观测所含的隐式监督，通过显式地标 token 与隐式未来 token 两种辅助表示增强 VLN 主干，在数据受限时显著提升导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 将视觉语言导航（VLN）策略迁移到新环境代价高昂，因为每条新增路线与指令都需具身示范。而已有的观测-动作训练仅利用了轨迹信息的一小部分，未来观测中蕴含的与指令相关的地标信息（外观与三维布局）未被利用。
AI.method: FINE 为 VLN 主干引入两种互补的辅助表示：(1) 显式地标 token，按指令指定的地标顺序排列，在语义二维 patch 特征空间与视角相关的三维几何特征空间中预测未来地标区域；(2) 隐式未来 token，借助视频世界模型生成同场景的合理反事实未来，学习区分真实到达的地标状态与反事实状态。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 上，全量训练数据下 FINE 将 InternVLA-N1 的成功率分别提升 2.6 与 4.5 个百分点；示范数据受限时收益更大，70% 示范预算下成功率提升 6.8 个百分点，约挽回因减少训练示范所损失性能的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 未来观测可作为现成示范中的免费监督信号，FINE 以显式地标预测与隐式未来判别两种方式加以利用，在数据充足时稳定增益、在数据稀缺时收益递增，表明该方法对降低 VLN 数据依赖具有实际价值。

title: PolyTopoBench: A Benchmark for Complex Vector Polygon Generation from Remote Sensing Imagery
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
summary: Vector polygon generation converts visual inputs, e.g., remote sensing (RS) images, into vectorized polygonal geometries, supporting applications such as autonomous driving, vector map construction, and remote sensing. Early pipelines predict raster masks and post-process them into polygons, which prevents end-to-end optimization and may miss small objects or introduce inaccurate vertices. Recent methods directly generate vector polygons, but most focus on simple exterior contours, while they either cannot represent complex polygons with holes or fail to preserve their topology. In this paper, we propose PolyTopoBench, a unified evaluation framework for vector polygon generation from RS images with explicit emphasis on complex polygons. PolyTopoBench evaluates both exterior and interior rings, and benchmarks 11 representative methods, including segmentation-based polygonization pipelines, vision foundation model baselines, and specialized vector polygon generators, on two RS-image datasets covering buildings, roads, vegetation, and unvegetated regions. Experiments show that existing methods often recover simple exterior boundaries but degrade substantially on polygons with holes or multiple rings. These results reveal complex polygon generation as an unresolved challenge and motivate topology-aware benchmarks and model designs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PolyTopoBench，一个面向遥感图像矢量多边形生成的统一评测框架，重点关注带孔洞的复杂多边形，并对11种代表性方法在两个数据集上进行基准测试，揭示复杂多边形生成仍是未解决的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有矢量多边形生成方法多聚焦简单外轮廓，难以表示带孔洞或多环的复杂多边形，且无法保持其拓扑结构；同时缺乏针对复杂多边形的统一评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 PolyTopoBench 统一评测框架，同时评估外环与内环；在两个覆盖建筑、道路、植被及无植被区域的遥感数据集上，对11种代表性方法（基于分割的多边形化流程、视觉基础模型基线、专用矢量多边形生成器）进行基准测试。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有方法通常只能恢复简单外边界，在带孔洞或多环多边形上性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 复杂多边形生成仍是有待解决的挑战，亟需拓扑感知的评测基准与模型设计。

title: Is H&E Image-to-Spatial Transcriptomics Simpler Than It Looks?
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from routine H&E histology offers a scalable route toward spatial molecular profiling. Recent work has pursued increasingly sophisticated architectures to capture spatial context and richer expression structure. At the same time, simple estimators have shown strong performance in several studies, but what they already solve and where additional complexity is needed remain unclear. We study this behavior through the structure of prediction error under the mean-squared error (MSE) objective. Differences in average expression across genes can account for a substantial part of aggregate prediction performance, while a key unresolved error lies in recovering variation within each slide. Decomposing MSE into slide-level and within-slide components, we find that the within-slide component has lower residual-normalized parameter sensitivity in controlled neural experiments. This motivates Component-Guided Loss (CGL), which increases supervision of the within-slide component. CGL-Linear is a closed-form affine instantiation that achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across HEST-1k cohorts and gene-panel sizes. The same within-slide supervision improves existing neural models. These results suggest that substantial gains can come from aligning the training objective with prediction-error structure rather than increasing model complexity.

AI.tldr: 该论文剖析了从H&E图像预测空间基因表达任务在MSE下的误差结构，发现基因间平均表达差异主导整体指标、而滑片内变异是真正的误差难点。作者提出Component-Guided Loss（CGL），加强对滑片内分量的监督；其闭式仿射版本CGL-Linear在HEST-1k各队列与基因组合规模上取得整体SOTA，并能提升现有神经模型，说明对齐训练目标与误差结构比增加模型复杂度更有效。
AI.motivation: 从常规H&E组织学图像预测空间基因表达是实现空间分子图谱可扩展化的重要途径。现有研究倾向于不断堆叠更复杂的网络架构以捕捉空间上下文与表达结构，但也有简单估计器表现强劲，因此"简单方法已解决了什么、何处真正需要额外复杂度"尚不明确。作者希望从MSE目标的预测误差结构出发，厘清性能来源与剩余难点，从而判断应提升模型复杂度还是改进训练目标。
AI.method: 作者对MSE进行误差分解，将预测误差拆分为滑片级（slide-level，主要反映基因间平均表达差异）与滑片内（within-slide）两个分量，并在受控神经实验中比较两者对参数扰动的残差归一化敏感度，以定位剩余误差来源。基于"滑片内分量参数敏感度更低、监督不足"的发现，提出Component-Guided Loss（CGL），对滑片内分量加大监督权重；并给出CGL-Linear——一种闭式仿射实例化。同时将该滑片内监督方式迁移用于改进现有神经模型验证其通用性。
AI.result: 基因间平均表达差异可解释总体预测性能的相当一部分，而真正未解决的误差主要在于恢复每张滑片内部的表达变异。分解后的滑片内分量在受控神经实验中表现出更低的残差归一化参数敏感度。CGL-Linear在HEST-1k的多个队列及不同基因panel规模上均取得整体SOTA性能；相同的滑片内监督策略也能提升现有神经模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，性能的大幅提升可来自让训练目标与预测误差结构相对齐，而非一味增加模型复杂度。误差分解思路为空间基因表达预测提供了明确的方向性指导：应重点强化滑片内变异的监督，而CGL与CGL-Linear正是这一原则的有效实现。

title: SV2V-RSim: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Self-Selective V2V Cooperative Perception with Near-Realistic Data
summary: Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) cooperative perception enhances autonomous driving by enabling vehicles to share information beyond their direct line of sight. However, existing V2V datasets are limited by a small number of participating agents, static collaborator selection strategies, and a significant domain gap between simulated and real-world environments. To overcome these challenges, we introduce SV2V-RSim, a large-scale, multi-modal, near-realistic simulation dataset engineered to elevate agent diversity and realism. Additionally, we present the Select Vehicles Adaptively (SVA) module, which optimizes collaborator selection to balance perception performance against communication bandwidth constraints. Our dataset is generated using the Unreal Engine 5-based simulator that integrates high-fidelity 3D assets, diverse environments, and intricate traffic scenarios. All vehicles within a specified range of the ego vehicle are equipped with sensor suites, enabling dynamic and adaptive collaborator selection. SV2V-RSim encompasses four maps, four weather conditions, six time periods from sunrise to night, 203K LiDAR frames, 402K RGB frames, and 788K annotated 3D bounding boxes across 17 object classes, supporting a range of cooperative perception tasks such as 3D object detection, segmentation, and depth estimation. Benchmarking on recent cooperative perception algorithms demonstrates that SVA achieves a superior performance-bandwidth trade-off, while sim-to-real experiments and No-Reference Image Quality Assessment validate the dataset's high realism and practical effectiveness. Our dataset and code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出大规模多模态近真实V2V协同感知仿真数据集SV2V-RSim，并设计自适应协作车辆选择模块SVA，在性能与通信带宽间取得更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有V2V数据集存在参与智能体数量少、协作者选择策略固定、仿真与真实环境域差距大的问题，限制了协同感知研究的多样性与实用性。
AI.method: 基于Unreal Engine 5构建仿真器，集成高保真3D资产、多样环境与复杂交通场景；自车一定范围内的所有车辆均配备传感器套件，支持动态自适应协作者选择；同时提出SVA模块优化协作者选择以平衡感知性能与通信带宽。数据集包含4张地图、4种天气、6个时段、203K LiDAR帧、402K RGB帧、788K标注3D框、17类目标。
AI.result: 在近期协同感知算法上的基准测试表明，SVA实现了更优的性能-带宽权衡；sim-to-real实验与无参考图像质量评估验证了数据集的高真实性与实用有效性。数据集覆盖3D目标检测、分割、深度估计等任务。
AI.conclusion: SV2V-RSim通过提升智能体多样性与真实感，配合SVA自适应选择策略，为协同感知研究提供了大规模、多模态、近真实的基准平台，数据集与代码将公开。

title: Are You Sure You're Sure? Two Confounds in a Sycophancy Benchmark
summary: Sycophancy is a language model's tendency to cave when a user pushes back, abandoning a correct answer for the user's. Several benchmarks now measure it by scripting an objection and recording how often the model caves. Because that objection is a prompt template, whatever else the template varies is measured along with the property it claims to isolate. We audit SycEval, which reports that objections raised before a model answers (preemptive) cause more caving than those raised after (in-context), and attributes the gap to timing. Two features of its templates vary alongside the property each is meant to test. First, SycEval's objections escalate through four strength levels, and at the two weakest only the preemptive template names a target answer, so timing and naming vary together. We build the missing comparison and test it on multiple-choice questions and SycEval's own free-form pipeline. Naming a target answer raises the follow rate, the share of samples matching the user's assertion, by 14.1--49.5 percentage points (pp), and once both templates name one, the timing comparison reverses on three of the five model conditions we test: models cave \emph{less} under preemptive objections than in-context ones, opposite to SycEval. Second, the output-format instruction benchmarks append for automatic grading also varies with objection placement. Moving it from the pushback into the question flips its effect in opposite directions across models on the same items ($p=0.0059$). The same effect appears in SycEval's free-form pipeline: relocating its instruction lowers caving by 5.1pp on Llama-3.1-8B, while an equivalence test confirms no effect on Qwen3-4B. Both confounds live in the template rather than the models under test, so both are correctable: we close with three checks benchmark authors can apply before publishing.

AI.tldr: 该文审计SycEval基准，发现其模板中"命名目标答案"与"输出格式指令位置"两个特征与所测属性（反驳时机）共变，构成混淆；修正后时机效应在多数模型上反转甚至消失。
AI.motivation: 现有谄媚（sycophancy）基准通过脚本化"反驳"来测量模型放弃正确答案的频率，但反驳本身是提示模板，模板中其他变化因素会与所声称隔离的属性一同被测量，导致结论被混淆。作者旨在审计SycEval关于"预先反驳比对话中反驳更易致谄媚"这一归因于时机的结论。
AI.method: 审计SycEval模板，识别出两个与时机共变的特征：(1)反驳按四个强度等级升级，仅在两个最弱等级下"预先"模板会命名目标答案，使时机与命名混淆——作者构建缺失的对照条件，在多项选择题及SycEval自有自由形式流程上测试；(2)用于自动评分的输出格式指令随反驳位置变化——将其从反驳中移至问题中，并做等价性检验。
AI.result: 命名目标答案使跟随率（与用户断言一致的样本比例）提升14.1–49.5个百分点；当两种模板都命名答案后，五个模型条件中有三个时机比较发生反转，模型在"预先反驳"下反而更少谄媚，与SycEval结论相反。输出格式指令位置的变化使同一题目上不同模型效应方向相反（p=0.0059）；在自由形式流程中，迁移指令使Llama-3.1-8B谄媚率下降5.1pp，而等价性检验显示对Qwen3-4B无影响。
AI.conclusion: 两个混淆均存在于模板而非被测模型本身，因此均可修正。作者提出三项检查，供基准作者在发布前应用，以排除模板层面的混淆因素。

title: Multimodal LLMs Outperform Pathology Foundation Models in Cross-Domain Histological Similarity
summary: State-of-the-art pathology foundation models, trained on millions of histology tiles, can fail to preserve tissue similarity when comparisons cross slide or institution boundaries. We show that general-purpose multimodal LLMs, without being trained as pathology foundation models, consistently outperform these specialized models in cross-domain histological similarity judgments. Using a relative similarity framework that we release as the MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) benchmark, we evaluate 17 models across 6 datasets and find that pathology encoders often rank same-institution, different-disease tiles as more similar than same-disease, different-institution tiles, a clinically dangerous failure mode invisible to standard within-domain evaluations. LLMs appear less susceptible to this failure, likely because they perform semantic visual comparison of morphology and tissue architecture rather than relying on shortcut features tied to acquisition context. Scaling training data does not resolve the problem for pathology encoders, implicating the learning objective rather than data coverage. Our results expose a fundamental robustness gap in current pathology foundation models and establish multimodal LLMs as a viable alternative for cross-institutional retrieval, dataset harmonization, and multi-site quality control. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现病理基础模型在跨切片、跨机构比较时难以保持组织相似性，而通用多模态LLM反而表现更好，并发布MOSAIC基准揭示这一鲁棒性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前病理基础模型虽在数百万组织切片上训练，但在跨切片或跨机构比较时无法保持组织相似性，存在临床隐患。作者希望系统评估这一失败模式，并寻找更鲁棒的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出相对相似性框架并发布MOSAIC基准（跨机构与队列的模型相似性评估），在6个数据集上评估17个模型，对比病理编码器与通用多模态LLM在跨域组织相似性判断上的表现。
AI.result: 病理编码器常将同机构不同疾病的切片判为比同疾病不同机构的切片更相似，这是标准域内评估无法发现的危险失败模式；通用多模态LLM不易受此影响，且扩大训练数据无法解决病理编码器的问题，说明问题源于学习目标而非数据覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前病理基础模型的根本性鲁棒性差距，并确立多模态LLM可作为跨机构检索、数据集协调和多站点质量控制的可行替代方案。

title: Improving Video Sparse Attention with Fine-grained Router and Sparse Rebasing
summary: We present VSA2, a frontier trainable sparse attention for video DiTs. VSA2 includes a variety of new architectural features and training procedures that we apply across all stages of the DiT development cycle, including pretraining, RL, and inference, to produce a DiT with comparable or better quality than a full attention counterpart. Architecturally, VSA2 introduces a fine-grained router that improves the precision of identifying critical tokens and supports dynamic computation by allowing each query to attend to a variable number of key-value pairs. In training, we identify a Hard-to-Easy Curriculum, where models trained under high sparsity and later evaluated with lower sparsity during inference not only generalize effectively, but also outperform models trained with full attention in motion quality. VSA2 is also flexible: it can replace full attention during the middle of progressive low-to-high resolution pretraining, rebasing early-stage full-attention checkpoints. Experiments show that VSA2 reduces attention computation by half over VSA with lower loss. On 720p videos, it accelerates attention by 8.9x and end-to-end generation by 4.62x compared to the FlashAttention-3 baseline, while achieving comparable or better video quality.

AI.tldr: VSA2是一种面向视频DiT的可训练稀疏注意力机制，融合细粒度路由器、Hard-to-Easy训练课程与动态计算，在保持或提升视频质量的同时大幅加速注意力与端到端生成。
AI.motivation: 视频DiT中全注意力计算开销巨大，尤其在高分辨率下成为瓶颈；此前稀疏注意力（VSA）在精度与训练灵活性上仍有不足，需要一种可在预训练、强化学习与推理全流程通用的高效可训练稀疏注意力方案。
AI.method: 架构上提出细粒度路由器，提升关键token识别精度，并支持动态计算，使每个query可关注可变数量的键值对；训练上提出Hard-to-Easy课程，即高稀疏度训练、低稀疏度推理；同时支持在低分辨率到高分辨率的渐进式预训练中途替换全注意力，对早期全注意力检查点进行rebase。
AI.result: 相比VSA，计算量减半且损失更低；在720p视频上相比FlashAttention-3基线，注意力加速8.9倍，端到端生成加速4.62倍，同时视频质量相当或更优；采用Hard-to-Easy课程训练的模型在运动质量上超过全注意力训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: VSA2是一种面向视频DiT的全流程稀疏注意力方案，兼顾效率与质量，可作为全注意力的实用替代，并具备训练灵活性与可扩展性。

title: Rethinking the Fully Hyperbolic Vision Transformer in Polar Coordinates
summary: Hyperbolic space can embed intrinsic hierarchies in data with low distortion due to the exponential growth of volume with distance from the origin. However, current Lorentz transformer blocks are formulated in ambient coordinates, where numerical errors increase at large radii due to instability in the Lorentzian inner product, leading many models to limit the radius to avoid this issue. This prevents us from utilizing the regions of hyperbolic space that motivate the geometry. To address this, we revisit the components of the transformer block in polar coordinates, where hyperbolic operations such as distance calculation and attention centroids can be computed without the numerical cancellation in their ambient-coordinate formulations. Specifically, we propose a polar fully connected layer that separately maps an embedding's direction and radius, allowing the radius of a feature to be learned rather than determined by the norm of a linear map. We additionally introduce horospherical shifts as relative positional encodings whose query-key distances grow logarithmically with the token gap. Finally, we reformulate the residual connection as average radius Lorentz boosts. Combining these components, we develop a fully hyperbolic transformer that substantially improves performance over Euclidean and hyperbolic baselines on standard vision tasks. We further evaluate our model on ImageNet and demonstrate its ability to generalize to other datasets using pre-trained weights, similar to Euclidean counterparts.

AI.tldr: 提出极坐标下的全双曲Transformer，解决Lorentz环境坐标数值不稳定问题，在视觉任务上超越欧氏与双曲基线。
AI.motivation: 双曲空间因体积随半径指数增长，能以低失真嵌入层次结构，但现有Lorentz transformer模块在环境坐标下表述，其Lorentz内积在大半径处数值不稳定，导致模型被迫限制半径，无法利用真正体现双曲几何优势的区域。
AI.method: 在极坐标下重构Transformer组件：1）极坐标全连接层，分别映射嵌入的方向与半径，使特征半径可学习而非由线性映射范数决定；2）引入horospherical shifts作为相对位置编码，使query-key距离随token间隔呈对数增长；3）将残差连接重新表述为平均半径的Lorentz boosts。据此构建全双曲Transformer。
AI.result: 在标准视觉任务上显著优于欧氏和双曲基线；在ImageNet上验证了模型可用预训练权重泛化到其他数据集，与欧氏模型表现类似。
AI.conclusion: 极坐标表述消除了环境坐标下的数值抵消问题，使模型能够有效利用大半径区域的双曲几何，构建的全双曲Transformer兼具性能优势与迁移泛化能力。

title: Linger and Lose: Knowledge Collapse in Low-Bit Language Models
summary: Training language models with ternary weights is commonly judged by loss and downstream accuracy, which record only a modest cost relative to full precision. We show that these metrics can conceal a much larger failure. We instead measure knowledge capacity, the factual bits stored per parameter, on synthetic biographies with known information content. We train GPT-2-style models from scratch with 2.5M to 50M parameters at five precisions. Under the standard cosine schedule, ternary models retain as little as 6% of an identically trained fp16 model's capacity. The deficit widens with model size while perplexity rises by only 1.4 to 1.6 times. Measured throughout training, these models first acquire capacity and then lose most of it. We identify this knowledge collapse as a learning-rate dwell instability. Held near $1$--$2\times10^{-4}$ with no decay, a pre-collapse model collapses within a few hundred exposures, and returning to a safe rate does not restore capacity. We then locate the collapse in the output head. It happens at a value the model can never predict. The weights there grow unchecked, while every other prediction the model makes is unchanged. We find that making the value predictable removes the collapse, regardless of which attribute carries it. A warmup-stable-decay schedule with a 10% cooldown increases ternary capacity by 2.7 times at 25M and 4.3 times at 50M. Gains are larger at lower precision. Cutting the output head's learning rate prevents failure when training from scratch. The post-training quantization methods we tested recover no measurable capacity below 4 bits. Our findings suggest judging low-precision training by retained capacity during training rather than final loss.

AI.tldr: 三元权重语言模型的标准评估指标（损失、下游准确率）会掩盖严重的知识容量损失：三元模型仅保留同规模fp16模型低至6%的事实知识容量，且随模型增大而恶化。该损失源于"知识坍塌"，即学习率驻留不稳定性，位置在输出头对某不可预测值的处理；通过让该值可预测、使用带10%冷却的warmup-stable-decay调度或降低输出头学习率可显著恢复容量。
AI.motivation: 三元（低精度）训练通常只用损失和下游准确率来评估，这些指标显示相对于全精度的代价不大。作者怀疑这类指标掩盖了更大的失败，因此需要一种更本质的度量——知识容量（每参数存储的事实比特数），以揭示低精度训练中被忽视的容量损失。
AI.method: 在具有已知信息量的合成传记数据上，从零训练2.5M至50M参数的GPT-2风格模型，覆盖五种精度，测量知识容量。对比标准余弦调度下的三元与fp16模型；追踪训练全过程的容量变化；通过将学习率维持在$1$–$2\times10^{-4}$且不衰减来定位坍塌；将坍塌归因于输出头对某不可预测值的权重失控增长；测试使其可预测、采用带10%冷却的warmup-stable-decay调度、降低输出头学习率、以及训练后量化等干预手段。
AI.result: 标准余弦调度下，三元模型仅保留fp16模型低至6%的容量，而困惑度仅上升1.4–1.6倍，且容量赤字随模型增大而扩大。训练中模型先获得容量再失去大部分。知识坍塌被识别为学习率驻留不稳定性：学习率维持在$1$–$2\times10^{-4}$且不衰减时，坍塌前模型在数百次曝光内坍塌，恢复安全学习率也无法挽回。坍塌定位于输出头，针对一个模型永远无法预测的值，其权重不受控增长而其他预测不变。使该值可预测可消除坍塌（不论由哪个属性承载）。带10%冷却的warmup-stable-decay调度使三元容量在25M提升2.7倍、50M提升4.3倍，精度越低增益越大；从头训练时降低输出头学习率可防止失败；所测试的训练后量化方法在4比特以下无法恢复任何可测容量。
AI.conclusion: 低精度训练的评估应以训练过程中保留的知识容量为标准，而非最终损失；三元模型存在标准指标无法察觉的严重容量坍塌，可通过针对性干预（可预测目标值、合适的学习率调度、降低输出头学习率）缓解。

title: How Vision Transformers Represent Position: A Mechanistic Comparison of Absolute and Rotary Positional Encodings
summary: Positional embeddings encode the spatial position of each image patch in a Vision Transformer (ViT), allowing the model to distinguish different spatial arrangements of visual content. However, we know little about how the choice of embedding shapes a vision transformer's internal representation. In this work, we show that Absolute Positional Embeddings (APE) and Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) encode spatial position through different internal mechanisms: APE stores position in explicit features, while RoPE builds it inside attention and rebuilds it when it is withheld. Specifically, in APE models, sparse autoencoders recover causal row- and column-specific features, whereas interventions on RoPE reveal distinct rotary components that separately encode row and column information. Additionally, causal interventions selectively disabling RoPE's row or column rotations show that decodable row and column information can be independently removed and, once rotations are restored, partly reconstructed, in part by axis-specialized attention heads. Both mechanisms are causally important for classification: permuting APE's positional features across patches reduces top-1 accuracy by 24--31 points, and ablating the rotations of RoPE's primary rebuilding head reduces it more than ablating those of any other head. Our findings show that the choice of positional encoding fundamentally changes how spatial information is organized and processed inside Vision Transformers. More broadly, our work demonstrates how mechanistic analysis can reveal how models construct, reconstruct, and maintain structured representations, providing a basis for targeted interventions in vision models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制可解释性分析发现，ViT中绝对位置编码（APE）与旋转位置编码（RoPE）以不同内部机制编码空间位置：APE将位置存于显式特征，RoPE在注意力中构建位置并可在被抑制后重建，二者均对分类具有因果重要性。
AI.motivation: 位置编码决定ViT如何区分图像块的空间排布，但学界尚不清楚不同位置编码选择如何塑造模型的内部表征。作者希望从机制层面揭示位置信息在ViT内部的组织与处理方式，为视觉模型的定向干预提供依据。
AI.method: 采用机制可解释性方法：用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在APE模型中恢复因果性的行/列特征；对RoPE实施干预，识别分别编码行、列信息的旋转分量；进一步通过因果干预选择性关闭RoPE的行或列旋转，并结合注意力头分析重建过程。
AI.result: APE模型中SAE可恢复行、列特异特征；RoPE中存在可独立移除并部分重建的行/列旋转分量，部分由轴特化注意力头完成。因果干预显示：置换APE的位置特征使top-1准确率下降24–31个百分点；消融RoPE主要重建头的旋转比其他任何头造成更大精度损失。
AI.conclusion: 位置编码的选择从根本上改变ViT内部空间信息的组织与处理方式。研究也表明机制分析能揭示模型如何构建、重建并维持结构化表征，为视觉模型的定向干预提供了基础。

title: Logical subspace in LLMs
summary: Recent work has identified a human brain network specialized for abstract formal reasoning (Kean et al., 2025). Does the same hold true in language models? To answer this question, we introduce the minimal viable subspace (MVS) method, which searches for the lowest-rank activation subspace at a layer that preserves task performance when everything outside that subspace is ablated. Using MVS, we demonstrate low-rank subspaces supporting logical inference on Gemma and Qwen models. Furthermore, these subspaces exhibit a clear dissociation from model capacities on other tasks, such that retaining these late logic subspaces preserves inference while impairing factual knowledge, working memory, cognitive control, and arithmetic. Conversely, ablating them reduces logical inference accuracy to chance while largely sparing these other capacities. Our results suggest a functionally localizable core machinery for logic akin to that in the human brain.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"最小可行子空间(MVS)"方法，在大语言模型中定位到支持逻辑推理的低秩激活子空间，其功能可与事实知识、工作记忆、认知控制、算术等能力相分离，提示模型存在类似人脑的可功能定位的逻辑核心机制。
AI.motivation: 已有研究在人脑中发现了专门负责抽象形式推理的网络(Kean et al., 2025)，作者希望验证语言模型是否也存在类似的、可功能分离的逻辑专用机制。
AI.method: 提出最小可行子空间(MVS)方法：在某一层搜索最低秩的激活子空间，使得仅保留该子空间、消融其外全部维度时任务性能仍得以保持。将该方法应用于Gemma和Qwen模型。
AI.result: 在Gemma和Qwen中发现支持逻辑推理的低秩子空间；这些子空间与其他任务能力呈现清晰的双重分离：保留晚期逻辑子空间可维持推理，却损害事实知识、工作记忆、认知控制与算术；反之消融这些子空间使逻辑推理准确率降至随机水平，而对其他能力基本无影响。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型存在一个可功能定位的逻辑核心机制，与人类大脑中的情况相类似，暗示抽象形式推理能力可能具有跨系统的共通组织结构。

title: Planner-as-Router: Joint Plan-Time Model Routing for Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Workflows
comment: Accepted at AIxSET 2026. 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Data and Code in github: https://github.com/vsingh45/par-entbench
summary: Running large language model (LLM) agents in production gets expensive fast. A frontier model (the largest, most capable tier) is accurate but can cost 25 times what a small model costs per token, and the gap compounds once a workflow chains several calls together. Planner-as-Router (PaR) attacks this from a different angle. Instead of leaving model-tier selection to some component downstream, it folds the choice into planning itself. As the planner breaks a query into subtasks, it also assigns each one a model size tier (small, mid, or frontier, ordered by capability and price), so the dependencies between subtasks are visible before any specialist runs. Unlike per-call routers such as cascade routing, which look at one node at a time, PaR sees the whole workflow up front and needs no separate router model or training data. We evaluate PaR with EntBench, a benchmark of 54 enterprise agentic tasks across seven classes, graded by actually running the generated Structured Query Language (SQL) and MongoDB queries against live databases. Over 1,157 evaluations spanning eight routers and three seeds, PaR stays on the observed cost-accuracy frontier. It matches a sink-frontier heuristic (frontier model on terminal nodes only) in accuracy at comparable cost and a faithful FrugalGPT cascade at lower cost, and cuts cost 44% against all-frontier routing while giving up 2.9 points of accuracy. Several accuracy gaps fall inside the plus-or-minus six-point confidence interval of a 54-task study, so we frame PaR's advantage as frontier position rather than a clean accuracy win. We also report a preliminary observation, not a validated result: a small pilot hints that cheap routing may carry a hidden compounding penalty on compositional workflows, which we frame as a hypothesis for future measurement. PaR, EntBench, and all evaluation code are open source.

AI.tldr: Planner-as-Router (PaR) 将模型规模层级选择（小/中/前沿）直接嵌入规划阶段，使子任务依赖关系在全流程运行前可见，无需独立路由器模型或训练数据，在成本-准确率前沿上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 在生产环境运行 LLM 智能体成本急剧上升：前沿模型每 token 成本可达小模型的 25 倍，且工作流中多次链式调用会放大这一差距。现有 per-call 路由器（如级联路由）逐节点决策，缺少全局视角，且往往需要额外路由器模型或训练数据。
AI.method: PaR 将模型层级选择并入规划过程：规划器在将查询分解为子任务时，同步为每个子任务分配模型规模层级（small/mid/frontier，按能力与价格排序），从而在任何专家模型执行前即暴露子任务依赖。评估采用 EntBench——覆盖七类、54 个企业智能体任务的基准，通过实际对实时数据库运行生成的 SQL 与 MongoDB 查询进行评分；共 1,157 次评估、8 个路由器、3 个随机种子。
AI.result: PaR 始终处于观测到的成本-准确率前沿：在成本相近时准确率匹配 sink-frontier 启发式（仅终端节点用前沿模型），成本低于忠实的 FrugalGPT 级联；相比全前沿路由降本 44%，准确率仅损失 2.9 个百分点。多个准确率差距落在 54 任务研究的 ±6 点置信区间内。此外，一个小型先导实验提示廉价路由在组合式工作流上可能存在隐藏的累积惩罚，但该结果尚未验证。
AI.conclusion: PaR 通过将模型层级选择前移至规划阶段，在不引入独立路由器模型或训练数据的前提下实现了良好的成本-准确率权衡；作者将其优势定位为"前沿位置"而非绝对的准确率胜利。小样本下廉价路由的潜在累积惩罚被作为未来测量假设提出。PaR、EntBench 及全部评估代码均开源。

title: Vision-Language Agents for Active Perception in Optics Laboratories
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being used in scientific workflows, but their ability as agents to directly control laboratory experiments from visual feedback remains underexplored. This capability is important because many laboratory tasks do not naturally provide dense, pre-defined numerical objectives: informative signals can be sparse, intermittent, or visually ambiguous. A more general laboratory agent should instead be able to interpret visual observations, take actions to acquire useful feedback, and adapt its behavior based on the consequences of those actions. We study whether general-purpose VLMs can perform this kind of closed-loop scientific control using experimental optics as a testbed. We evaluate agents on three experimental systems that isolate distinct capabilities: a Michelson interferometer, a two-mirror cavity, and a four-mirror optical relay. The agents observe camera images, directly issue actuator and measurement commands, and retain their interaction history without receiving an engineered scalar objective during control. Across these experiments and matched simulations, we find that, given task-specific natural-language guidance, VLMs can estimate actuator-response relationships, resolve ambiguous observations through intervention, and actively create informative visual feedback when signals are sparse. These results suggest that pretrained multimodal models can serve as important decision-making agents within the experimental loop. Our work also establishes optics as a physically grounded testbed for visual reasoning and active perception in scientific agents.

AI.tldr: 该研究以光学实验为测试平台，检验通用视觉语言模型（VLM）能否作为闭环科学控制智能体，仅凭视觉反馈直接操控实验。结果表明，在任务专属自然语言指导下，VLM能够估计执行器响应关系、通过干预消解观测歧义，并在信号稀疏时主动创造信息性视觉反馈。
AI.motivation: VLMs正越来越多地用于科学工作流，但其作为智能体直接依据视觉反馈控制实验的能力尚未充分探索。许多实验任务并不天然提供密集、预定义的数值目标，有效信号可能稀疏、间歇或视觉上模糊；更通用的实验室智能体应能解读视觉观测、采取行动获取有用反馈，并依据行动后果调整行为。
AI.method: 以实验光学为测试平台，在三个隔离不同能力的实验系统（迈克尔逊干涉仪、双镜腔、四镜光学中继）上评估智能体。智能体观察相机图像，直接下达执行器与测量指令，并保留交互历史，且在控制过程中不接收工程化的标量目标；同时进行匹配的仿真实验。
AI.result: 在实验与匹配仿真中，给定任务专属自然语言指导后，VLM能够估计执行器-响应关系、通过干预消解模糊观测，并在信号稀疏时主动创造信息性视觉反馈。
AI.conclusion: 预训练多模态模型可作为实验闭环中的重要决策智能体；该工作同时确立了光学作为科学智能体视觉推理与主动感知的物理接地测试平台。

title: Posterior Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching learns how to transport noise toward data, but its mean prediction does not directly report the endpoint uncertainty remaining at an intermediate state. This paper introduces Posterior Flow Matching (PFM), a general generative modeling framework that learns conditional velocity means and componentwise variances with a Gaussian posterior model. The same model evaluation supplies both a transport prediction and endpoint uncertainty, making posterior diagnostics available throughout generation. These learned moments support a mean-driven ordinary differential equation (ODE) and a posterior-driven stochastic differential equation (SDE), whose local noise scales adapt to the predicted uncertainty. Across image, point-cloud, molecular, and action generation, PFM improves generation quality and provides endpoint-posterior readouts throughout generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Posterior Flow Matching（PFM），用高斯后验同时学习条件速度均值与逐分量方差，使单次模型评估即可同时给出传输预测与端点不确定性，并据此导出均值驱动 ODE 与后验驱动 SDE，在图像、点云、分子、动作生成上提升质量并提供贯穿生成过程的端点后验诊断。
AI.motivation: Flow matching 只学习如何把噪声输运到数据，其均值预测无法直接给出中间状态残留的端点不确定性，缺乏生成过程中的不确定性刻画。
AI.method: 以高斯后验模型学习条件速度均值与逐分量方差；同一次模型评估同时输出输运预测与端点不确定性；基于学到的矩构建均值驱动的 ODE 与后验驱动的 SDE，其局部噪声尺度随预测不确定性自适应调整。
AI.result: 在图像、点云、分子与动作生成任务上，PFM 提升了生成质量，并在整个生成过程中提供端点后验读数。
AI.conclusion: PFM 是一种通用生成建模框架，将端点不确定性估计内嵌于流匹配的输运过程，兼顾生成质量与全过程不确定性诊断。

title: Theory of Scene: Breaking the Symmetry Trap in Multi-Agent LLM Coordination
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are largely homogeneous, as their agents behave alike even across distinct LLMs. We show that when such agents act concurrently without communication, they collide on targets they must split and diverge on targets they must take together, a double failure we term the symmetry trap. Theory of Mind (ToM), widely used for coordination without communication, cannot escape this trap, since homogeneous agents form the same prediction of one another and respond to it in the same way. We propose Theory of Scene (ToS), a training-free reasoning schema in which each agent reads its public role, the only difference between the agents, and the task context they all observe. Homogeneous agents thereby derive one division of labor, each taking the part its role fixes, which turns homogeneity from the cause of the trap into the cure. ToS reads the role together with the scene through role gating, which determines whether ownership overlaps or is already divided, and the task context through task coupling, which infers whether the team must converge on each target, divide it, or take its stages in turn. We evaluate on DivvyBench, a controlled environment we introduce, whose target types make an episode Competitive, Cooperative, or Mixed across Tabletop, Airspace, and Household scenarios, and on two established agentic benchmarks, GovSim and Overcooked. ToS outperforms all six baselines on every benchmark, and each baseline falls far behind it in at least one setting. Against ToM given the same inputs, ToS raises the DivvyBench success rate from 71.1% to 99.6%, the GovSim total gain from 207 to 400, and the Overcooked level-normalized throughput from 1.41 to 1.67.

AI.tldr: 本文指出同构多智能体在无通信并发行动时陷入"对称性陷阱"，并提出免训练推理范式Theory of Scene (ToS)，让同构智能体通过读取公共角色与任务情境推导出统一分工，在DivvyBench、GovSim与Overcooked上全面超过六个基线及ToM。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统高度同构，即便使用不同LLM，智能体行为也彼此相似。当它们无通信地并发行动时，会在需要分配的共享目标上发生碰撞，在需要共同占据的目标上产生分歧，这一"双重失败"被称为对称性陷阱。常用于无通信协调的心智理论（ToM）无法摆脱该陷阱，因为同构智能体会对彼此形成相同预测并做出一致反应。
AI.method: 提出Theory of Scene (ToS)，一种免训练的推理模式（schema）。每个智能体读取其公共角色（agents之间唯一的差异）以及所有智能体共同观察到的任务情境，从而推导出唯一的分工方案，各智能体承担角色所固定的部分，使同构性从陷阱的成因转变为解法。ToS通过角色门控（role gating）结合场景读取角色，判断归属权是重叠还是已划分；并通过任务耦合（task coupling）读取任务情境，推断团队对每个目标应收敛、分配还是按阶段轮流处理。
AI.result: 在作者提出的受控环境DivvyBench（含Competitive、Cooperative、Mixed三类目标类型，覆盖Tabletop、Airspace、Household场景）以及两个既有智能体基准GovSim和Overcooked上进行评估。ToS在所有基准上均优于全部六个基线，且每个基线至少在某一设置下远落后于它。与输入相同的ToM相比，ToS将DivvyBench成功率从71.1%提升至99.6%，GovSim总收益从207提升至400，Overcooked等级归一化吞吐量从1.41提升至1.67。
AI.conclusion: 同构多智能体的无通信并发协调难题源于对称性陷阱，而ToS通过角色门控与任务耦合实现免训练的分工推导，将同构性转化为协调优势，并在多个基准上取得显著且一致的性能提升。

title: The Key Handoff: Retrieval in Hybrid Language Models
comment: 36 pages, 5 figures in the main text
summary: A two-hop question makes a language model retrieve twice: once to produce a bridge entity, and once to retrieve with it. Transformers resolve that entity in their early layers. Hybrid models replace most of the attention with a recurrent state, so where the key becomes usable, and where it is spent on an answer, is not known. Answering "Where is the ball?" from "the ball belongs to Alice" and "Alice is in the garden" turns on Alice, a name the question does not mention. A model could reach garden through Alice, the key it computed, or through where the fact sits in the prompt. Across twelve models, dense and hybrid, we move a hidden state from one story into another where the two routes lead to different places, and read off which place the model gives. An attention layer converts the key in every model we tested, and crossing that layer removes its usable effect, all of it where no attention follows. In sequential hybrids this makes the answer a handoff: recurrent layers carry the key forward, and attention spends it. Retrieval does not always stop there. Writing a different fact into the memory of the recurrent layers that follow the last attention layer can move the answer toward that fact, multiplying its odds by 1.3 to 2.7, and which hybrids do this is not settled by their architecture or training. That read is addressed by the key, not by position: recurrent state in a hybrid is not only a carrier, but a memory that later layers can query.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过将隐藏状态跨故事迁移的因果干预实验，考察稠密与混合（注意力+循环）语言模型在两跳问答中"桥接实体"键的计算位置与使用位置，发现：注意力层负责将键转化为可用形式，其后无注意力的循环状态不仅承载键，还能作为被后续层查询的记忆参与检索。
AI.motivation: 两跳问答要求模型先检索出桥接实体（如"Alice"），再用它检索答案（"garden"）。Transformer 在早期层完成实体解析，但混合模型用循环状态替代大部分注意力，键在何处变为可用、在何处被用于作答尚不清楚；同时需厘清答案究竟经由键（桥接实体）还是经由事实在提示中的位置到达。
AI.method: 在十二个模型（稠密与混合）上采用隐藏状态迁移的因果干预：把一个故事中的隐藏状态移入另一个故事，使"经键的路径"与"经位置的路径"指向不同地点，读取模型输出的地点。同时向最后一个注意力层之后的循环层记忆中写入另一事实，检验其是否改变答案。
AI.result: 在所测每个模型中，均存在一个注意力层完成键的转化，跨过该层即消除其可用效应，且该效应完全出现在无注意力跟随的位置。在顺序混合模型中，答案呈"交接"结构：循环层向前携带键，注意力层将其消费用于作答。检索并不总止于该处——向最后一个注意力层之后的循环记忆写入不同事实，可使答案向该事实偏移，几率提高 1.3 至 2.7 倍；哪些混合模型表现如此，无法由其架构或训练方式判定。
AI.conclusion: 该读取由键而非位置所寻址：混合模型中的循环状态不仅是键的载体，更是一种可被后续层查询的记忆。这揭示了混合架构中检索执行为"循环携带—注意力消费—循环再查询"的多阶段过程。

title: Synthetic Thermal Image Generation for Real-Time Animal Detection Under Low-Visibility Conditions
comment: Accepted at The IEEE Cyber Awareness Research Symposium (CARS), 2026
summary: Wildlife-vehicle collisions remain a significant road safety concern, particularly during nighttime and low-visibility conditions when RGB-based perception systems are often unreliable. Thermal imaging offers a promising alternative for detecting animals under poor illumination. However, the limited availability of annotated infrared animal datasets restricts the development of robust deep learning-based detection models. This paper investigates synthetic thermal image generation as a scalable approach for real-time animal detection under low-visibility conditions. A subset of 514 annotated visible-spectrum animal images from the NTLNP dataset is translated into synthetic thermal representations using CycleGAN-Turbo, while a limited real thermal dataset of 60 images is expanded through thermal-focused augmentation. Multiple object detection architectures, including YOLOv8, YOLOv9, YOLOv10, and RT-DETR, are trained independently on synthetic and real thermal datasets and evaluated using precision, recall, mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95, model size, and inference latency. Experimental results show that synthetic thermal images provide competitive detection performance, with RT-DETR achieving the highest synthetic-data mAP@0.5 of 0.9613. Models trained on augmented real thermal data achieve the strongest overall performance, with YOLOv10s obtaining 0.9879 mAP@0.5 and 0.9571 mAP@0.5:0.95. Computational analysis further indicates that lightweight YOLO variants provide favorable inference latency, supporting their potential for real-time deployment. These findings demonstrate that synthetic thermal imagery can reduce dependence on scarce infrared datasets and support the development of efficient animal detection systems for future vehicle-mounted wildlife collision mitigation applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文探索用合成热成像图像解决红外动物数据稀缺问题，以支撑低能见度下的实时动物检测，实验表明合成数据性能具竞争力且轻量YOLO适合实时部署。
AI.motivation: 夜间与低能见度条件下，基于RGB的感知系统检测野生动物不可靠，热成像是有前景的替代方案；但带标注的红外动物数据集稀缺，限制了鲁棒深度学习检测模型的发展。
AI.method: 从NTLNP数据集中选取514张已标注可见光动物图像，用CycleGAN-Turbo翻译为合成热成像表示；同时用面向热成像的增强方法扩增60张真实热成像图像。分别在合成与真实热成像数据集上独立训练YOLOv8、YOLOv9、YOLOv10和RT-DETR，并以precision、recall、mAP@0.5、mAP@0.5:0.95、模型大小与推理延迟进行评估。
AI.result: 合成热成像图像取得有竞争力的检测性能，RT-DETR在合成数据上mAP@0.5最高达0.9613；增强真实热成像数据训练的模型整体性能最强，YOLOv10s达0.9879 mAP@0.5与0.9571 mAP@0.5:0.95。计算分析显示轻量YOLO变体推理延迟较优。
AI.conclusion: 合成热成像数据可降低对稀缺红外数据集的依赖，支持高效动物检测系统开发，面向未来车载野生动物碰撞缓解应用。

title: DynamicDx: Evaluating Evidence Acquisition in Video-Based Diagnosis
summary: Diagnosing a patient from video requires more than recognizing the sign: a vision-language model must turn what it sees into hypotheses, questions and tests. DynamicDx evaluates each step in 71 neurological consultations across 11 sign categories, linking authentic patient videos to confirmed diagnoses and fixed charts built from the same case reports, so that every model queries the same evidence. Across five such models, video improves accuracy by 9.9-22.5 percentage points over blind input, but neither recognition alone nor temporal order explains the gain: the cause is usually missing from the model's video-only differential diagnosis even when the sign is recognized, and shuffling the frames produces no reliable accuracy loss. Instead, a trajectory replay traces most of the gain to the investigation results the video prompts. Evidence acquisition is the bottleneck: supplying the decisive investigations raises accuracy to 73.2-93.0%. Two interventions act on it. A post-trained 4B video describer improves sign descriptions, especially from a short, densely sampled segment, and source-clean literature retrieval expands initial hypotheses; both bring the tests a model orders closer to those the treating clinicians documented and, through them, raise accuracy. For video-based diagnosis, seeing better helps when it leads to asking better.

AI.tldr: DynamicDx基准通过71例神经科会诊、11类体征，评估视觉语言模型"识别→假设→提问→检查"的完整诊断轨迹，发现视频增益主要来自其引发的检查取证而非识别或时序。
AI.motivation: 现有视频诊断评测多停留在"是否识别出体征"的层面，无法说明视频究竟在诊断链条的哪一环起作用。作者希望拆解从视频观察到确诊的逐步骤认知过程，定位性能瓶颈所在。
AI.method: 构建DynamicDx：将真实患者视频与确诊结果、由同一病例报告构建的固定病历（charts）相链接，使所有模型查询相同证据；覆盖11类体征、71例神经科会诊。对5个视觉语言模型进行轨迹回放（trajectory replay），并对比：盲输入、单帧识别、帧序打乱、以及提供决定性检查结果等条件；另测试两种干预——后训练4B视频描述器、来源干净的文献检索。
AI.result: 相对盲输入，视频使准确率提升9.9–22.5个百分点；但单纯识别或时序都无法解释该增益——即便识别出体征，其在纯视频鉴别诊断中通常仍缺失，打乱帧序也未带来可靠精度下降。轨迹回放显示增益多来自视频促发的检查结果。检查证据获取是瓶颈：提供决定性检查后准确率升至73.2–93.0%。两种干预使模型所开检查更接近临床医生记录，从而提高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 视频诊断中"看得更好"仅在转化为"问得更好（更准确的检查取证）"时才有效；检查证据获取是当前模型的核心瓶颈，改进描述与假设检索可部分弥合该差距。

title: Distributed Hydrological Modeling in the Feature Space
summary: Accurate forecasting of river discharge and floods is very challenging. River dynamics are affected by storage, meteorological forcing, and flow propagation at different spatial and temporal scales. Forecasting thus requires a framework that considers the upstream-to-downstream flow through river networks across grid cells and catchments. This modeling is known in hydrology as distributed modeling and routing. Existing deep learning approaches either ignore this topology, operate on lumped catchments, or route predicted physical quantities through a separate graph or physical routing model. We instead introduce feature-space routing: a topology-aware state-space operator embedded directly in the forecasting dynamics. At every forecast step, the operator gathers latent states from upstream grid cells and causally updates the downstream state according to the known river network. This preserves the physical connectivity of the river system while allowing the propagated state itself to be learned end-to-end and allows the model to predict river discharge considering both local dynamics and neighboring upstream contributions. To address uncertainty and provide probabilistic forecasts, we minimize the fair continuous ranked probability score (fCRPS) as a training objective. Our experiments on the European Flood Awareness System (EFAS) and observational data for river discharge forecasting demonstrate that encoding the physical structure of river networks explicitly in the feature space substantially improves the forecasting skill, particularly in an ungauged setting. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on both reanalysis and observational data and is able to forecast maps of river discharge at 1 arcminute and 6-hourly resolution up to 10 days lead time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"特征空间路由"（feature-space routing），将拓扑感知的状态空间算子直接嵌入预报动力学中，在特征空间实现上游到下下游的因果传播；以fCRPS为训练目标实现概率预报，在欧洲EFAS与观测数据上取得最优径流预报效果，尤其适用于无测站情景。
AI.motivation: 河流径流与洪水预报极具挑战：河流动力学受蓄水、气象强迫和不同时空尺度的流量传播影响，需在河网中跨网格与流域建模上游—下游流动（分布式建模与汇流）。现有深度学习方法要么忽略拓扑结构，要么在集总流域上操作，要么需借助独立的图模型或物理汇流模型来传播预测的物理量，未能将物理连通性与端到端学习统一。
AI.method: 提出特征空间路由：一种嵌入预报动力学的拓扑感知状态空间算子。每个预报步中，该算子从上游网格单元收集潜在状态，并依据已知河网对下游状态进行因果更新。由此在保持河流系统物理连通性的同时，使传播的状态本身可端到端学习，兼顾局地动力学与相邻上游贡献。为刻画不确定性并给出概率预报，以公平连续排序概率评分（fCRPS）作为训练目标。
AI.result: 在欧洲洪水预警系统（EFAS）与观测数据的径流预报实验中，将河网物理结构显式编码进特征空间显著提升了预报技巧，在无测站（ungauged）情景下尤为明显。方法在再分析数据和观测数据上均达到当前最优水平，可预报1弧分、6小时分辨率、最长10天预见期的径流地图。
AI.conclusion: 在特征空间显式编码河网物理结构是提升径流预报技巧的有效途径，能够在统一端到端框架内融合物理连通性与可学习状态传播，并在概率预报与无测站场景下展现优势。

title: ReVision3D: Attribution-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement for 3D Medical Perception
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising path for overcoming the limited visual capability of current medical imaging agents. Yet applying RSI to volumetric imaging remains difficult: failures can arise from acquisition, perception, training recipe, or downstream inference, while self-generated feedback and logged trajectories provide little guidance on which component should change. We introduce ReVision3D, an RSI system that leverages 3D volumes with spatially grounded annotations to determine where visual evidence is lost and recursively improve the corresponding visual capability. A frozen language-model designer proposes revisions to acquisition, perception, training, or inference, while the verifier and system-level objective remain fixed. Our key insight is that an annotated volume forms an exact replay world for view rendering and spatial verification: unvisited views can be rendered on demand, and localized predictions can be checked directly against reference masks. This grounded feedback directs targeted revision, while only changes that improve beyond measured seed noise are retained. Each accepted change triggers renewed attribution, allowing the dominant bottleneck to shift across rounds. On abdominal CT, attribution identifies perception as the dominant remaining limitation. Revising that level enables ReVision3D to achieve 79% liver recall and 83% kidney recall at under 0.4 false positives per patient, outperforming the evaluated frozen multimodal foundation models, with the largest gains on small lesions. Our framework is public available with interactive demo in this project page: \url{https://leeh43.github.io/ReVision3D/}

AI.tldr: ReVision3D提出一种面向三维医学影像的递归自我改进（RSI）系统，利用带空间标注的体数据作为可回放世界，实现针对性视觉能力修订，在腹部CT上取得优于冻结多模态基础模型的病灶召回表现。
AI.motivation: 当前医学影像智能体视觉能力有限，递归自我改进（RSI）有潜力突破该限制，但将其应用于体数据（volumetric）成像仍很困难。失败可能源于采集、感知、训练配方或下游推理等多个环节，而自生成反馈与日志轨迹难以指明应当修改哪个组件。此外，3D场景中缺乏可靠的定位监督，使反馈与改进方向脱节。
AI.method: 核心洞察：带标注的体数据构成用于视图渲染与空间验证的精确"回放世界"——未访问视角可按需渲染，局部预测可直接与参考掩码比对。系统由冻结的语言模型设计器提出对采集、感知、训练或推理的修订方案，验证器与系统级目标保持固定。基于可定位反馈进行定向修订，仅保留改进超过实测种子噪声的变更；每次被接受的变更触发重新归因，使主导瓶颈可跨轮次转移。
AI.result: 在腹部CT上，归因指出感知是当前主导性剩余瓶颈。修订该层级后，ReVision3D在每患者少于0.4个假阳性的条件下实现79%肝脏召回率与83%肾脏召回率，优于所评估的冻结多模态基础模型，且在小病灶上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: ReVision3D表明，将3D体数据作为可回放的验证环境，可支撑跨组件归因与递归自我改进，从而系统性提升医学影像智能体的视觉能力。框架已公开并提供交互式演示（https://leeh43.github.io/ReVision3D/）。

title: Oracle Gaps in Reliability Coverage: Sampling Noise or Policy Specialization?
summary: Policies trained from the same base model can appear to solve different problems. An oracle that chooses the best policy for each problem may therefore appear much stronger than any single policy. Selecting the largest estimated success rate also selects favorable sampling errors. We study this effect through reliability coverage, the fraction of problems whose success probability reaches a chosen threshold. Our first test redistributes stored correctness outcomes across policies within each problem. A second also preserves each policy's total successes, accounting for overall quality differences under a specified statistical model. For five training seeds of a seven-billion-parameter vision-language model, redistribution reproduces 0.096 of an estimated 0.113 oracle gap at threshold 0.10. Neither test finds significant evidence at this threshold. Small advantages remain unresolved. Mixtures, routers, voting, and weight averaging show no detectable improvement over their corresponding single-policy baselines. Training policies on different datasets shows little detectable specialization under light post-training, and no router gain. A stronger recipe does create it, both tests detect it, and a router gain appears only at the high thresholds where the specialists separate. In a control with predictable specialization, a router recovers about half the oracle gap. Coverage bounds explain why even a genuine oracle advantage need not yield a deployment gain. The tests assess apparent specialization from stored responses before investment in routing. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/oracle-gaps

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可靠性覆盖率"框架与两种置换检验，证明同基座训练的多策略在同一问题上表现出的大多"专家化"优势实为对采样误差的选择（最大成功率即最大噪声），在7B视觉语言模型上并非真实专长。
AI.motivation: 选择"最大估计成功率"的策略会同时选中有利的采样误差，使"每问题选最优策略"的oracle看似远强于任何单一策略。作者希望区分"表观专家化"是真实能力分化还是统计选择偏差，从而在投入路由系统开发前给出低成本判定手段。
AI.method: 引入可靠性覆盖率指标（成功率超过给定阈值的问题占比）。设计两种检验：(1) 在每个问题内将已存储的正确性结果在策略间重新分配；(2) 在特定统计模型下进一步保持每个策略的总成功数以控制整体质量差异。实验基于7B视觉语言模型（5个训练种子），并对比混合、路由、投票、权重平均等组合方式，另设可预测专家化的对照组与更强训练配方。
AI.result: 阈值0.10下，重分配可复现0.113 oracle差距中的0.096，两种检验在该阈值均无显著证据，仅存小的未解释优势。混合/路由/投票/权重平均相对单策略基线无可检测提升。轻后训练下不同数据集训练几乎无专长，也无路由增益；强配方下产生真实专长且两种检验均可检测，路由增益仅出现在专家区分度高的高阈值处。可预测专长对照中路由恢复约一半oracle差距。
AI.conclusion: 表观的oracle优势大多可由统计选择偏差解释，真实专长未必带来部署收益（覆盖率上界给出解释）。该检验可在投入路由开发前，仅用已存储的响应评估专家化是否真实。

title: TriDrive: Joint Driver, Vehicle, and Road Modeling for Forecasting and Driver Monitoring
comment: 32 pages (10-page main text plus appendices), 4 figures, 25 tables. Under review. Code, checkpoints, and demo video: https://huggingface.co/HenryYHW/TriDrive
summary: Predicting how drivers, vehicles, and road scenes interact and evolve together is central to driver monitoring. Prior work models in-cabin activity or traffic-conditioned driver motion in isolation, motivating joint driver, vehicle, and road modeling with real-time on-vehicle evaluation. We introduce TriDrive, to our knowledge the first unified framework that jointly forecasts driver kinematics, vehicle dynamics, and road demands through an automation-conditioned transition model. Modality-specific encoders (an anchored kinematic representation of the driver, causal CAN-bus dynamics, and frozen V-JEPA 2 road latents with structured road margins) are connected by directed residual connections through which driver and road context refine vehicle forecasts. We evaluate TriDrive on three downstream tasks. On the public AIDE benchmark, its kinematic encoder recipe sets a new full-set state of the art (SOTA) among published baselines (48.05 versus 71.47 All-MPJPE). On 197.2 hours of naturalistic BATON subset, directed connections and road margins raise assistance-engaged PR-AUC by 0.084 for steering onset and 0.286 for time-to-collision drops. For real-time use, we distill the road encoders and run TriDrive on a comma four with an external 8 GB GPU, where a lightweight current-state warning probe updates at 5 Hz with 177 ms p95 latency while the joint model forecasts concurrently. The probe is above an openpilot-based baseline on human-labeled manual-driving warnings (AUROC 0.725 versus 0.563), and in a paired on-road study 14 drivers rate its warnings as more appropriate (+1.79) and timely (+2.67) than those of openpilot's driver-monitoring system.

AI.tldr: TriDrive：首个联合预测驾驶员运动学、车辆动力学与道路需求的统一框架，通过自动化条件转移模型与有向残差连接实现，并在多个基准与实车部署中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有工作孤立地建模舱内活动或交通条件下的驾驶员运动，缺乏对驾驶员、车辆、道路三者交互演化的联合建模，且缺少实车实时评估。
AI.method: 提出统一框架TriDrive，采用自动化条件转移模型；各模态独立编码器（驾驶员的锚定运动学表示、因果CAN总线动力学、冻结V-JEPA 2道路潜在表征及结构化道路边界）通过有向残差连接，使驾驶员与道路上下文精炼车辆预测；并对道路编码器蒸馏以实车部署。
AI.result: 在AIDE基准上运动学编码方案达到SOTA（48.05 vs 71.47 All-MPJPE）；在197.2小时BATON子集上有向连接与道路边界将辅助介入的PR-AUC提升0.084（转向起始）与0.286（碰撞时间下降）；comma four加外接8GB GPU上轻量级当前状态预警探针以5Hz更新、p95延迟177ms，与联合模型并发运行；人工标注警告AUROC 0.725 vs openpilot 0.563；14名驾驶员实车配对研究中其警告更恰当（+1.79）更及时（+2.67）。
AI.conclusion: TriDrive验证了联合建模驾驶员—车辆—道路交互的可行性与实时部署潜力，在预测精度、辅助驾驶预警与实车用户体验上均优于基线，为驾驶员监控提供了统一且可落地的方案。

title: Certified Interface Aliases: Exact Collisions in Vision-Language Preprocessing, and When They Exist
summary: Vision-language verifiers and routers must distinguish errors repairable by more reasoning from those caused by visual evidence never reaching the language model. This distinction lacks ground truth because annotators see full-resolution images while models receive preprocessed tensors. We introduce AliasForge to create cases where the relevant fact is provably absent from the interface. Fixed-point resampling makes the pre-rounding resize an exact integer linear map that can send nonzero integer perturbations to zero. Hiding a label-flipping perturbation there produces images with opposite step-correctness labels but bit-identical interface states. Every verifier therefore has the same output law on both members, giving pair-balanced accuracy exactly one half and zero gain from language-side repair. We prove that every fixed-point downscaler has such null vectors and bound their smallest size at the most common ratios, which rules out an 8-bit fit whenever the bound exceeds 255. From the resize configuration alone, a lattice criterion supplies realizable collisions and certifies their absence within the specified construction family. It resolves all 20 screened configurations, 17 as constructible and 3 as non-constructible. We construct certified pairs across three architectures and certify four additional processors, with zero decision-logit gap on all 18 scored pairs and none of the 18 controls. The pairs also screen routers that waste computation on re-attention or further reasoning. On natural items, per-item routing headroom exists, but no tested interface-only router improves over stopping. Our fiber ceiling bounds the headroom recoverable from the interface. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/aliasforge.

AI.tldr: 提出 AliasForge，构造"接口态比特相同但正确性标签相反"的对抗样本对，证明仅凭界面信息的验证器/路由器在此类样本上准确率恒为 1/2、无法通过更多推理修复。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言验证器与路由器需区分"可通过更多推理修复的错误"和"视觉证据从未到达语言模型的错误"，但该区分缺乏真值标注：标注者看到全分辨率图像，模型只接收预处理后的张量。作者希望构造出"相关事实可从接口层面证明缺失"的样本，以给出严格的判定基准。
AI.method: 核心是定点重采样（fixed-point resampling）：令取整前的缩放为精确整数线性映射，可将非零整数扰动映为零。在隐藏该标签翻转扰动处生成图像，得到反向步级正确性标签但接口态比特完全相同的样本对。理论上证明任意定点下采样器均存在此类零向量（null vectors），并在常见缩放比下给出其最小尺寸界；当界超过 255 时即可排除 8-bit 拟合。基于缩放配置，用格（lattice）判据给出可实现的碰撞并证明其在指定构造族内的不存在性。据此筛选 20 种配置，17 种可构造、3 种不可构造；并在三种架构上构造认证样本对，另认证四个处理器。
AI.result: 在 18 组计分样本对上决策-logit 差为零，且 18 个对照样本均无此现象。样本对还可用于筛选那些在重注意力或进一步推理上浪费计算的路由器。在自然样本上，逐项路由存在提升空间（headroom），但所测的纯接口路由器均未优于"停止"策略；"纤维上界"（fiber ceiling）界定了可从接口恢复的提升空间上限。
AI.conclusion: AlienForge 提供了可从接口本身证明视觉事实缺失的构造性基准，证明纯接口信号存在不可逾越的被证上界，说明当前仅依赖接口的验证器与路由器在本质上无法修复此类错误。

title: Safety-Constrained Cascade Inference for Robust Malaria Cell Classification Under Field Corruptions
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code available at https://github.com/josehagbe3/MalariaVision
summary: Automated malaria diagnosis from thin blood-smear microscopy could meaningfully reduce the burden on under-resourced laboratories, but a model that maximises accuracy on clean laboratory images fails badly the moment an inexpensive smartphone camera introduces sensor noise. This paper introduces MalariaCascade, a two-stage inference system in which a lightweight MobileNetV2 sentinel (2,225,153 parameters) makes confident classifications at low compute cost and escalates uncertain cases to an EfficientNet-B3 expert (10,697,769 parameters) that sees only clean, standardised images regardless of how corrupted the incoming frame is. Structural isolation of the expert stage, not learned robustness, is the mechanism. The sentinel is trained under a safety-score objective that places an explicit floor on Recall(Parasitised) (>=0.95) and Recall(Uninfected) (>=0.40) before precision is optimised, ensuring the checkpoint satisfies clinical safety constraints by construction. On the NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset (27,558 cells), the cascade reaches Accuracy=0.9736, Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570, Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912, F1=0.9738, and AUROC=0.9955 on the clean test set. Under Gaussian sensor noise at full severity, cascade Recall(Parasitised) degrades by only 2.4 pp (0.9570 to 0.9329), while the flat single-model baseline collapses by 63.0 pp (0.9584 to 0.3281). McNemar's test confirms the cascade improvement is statistically significant (chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085). An ablation isolating the structural property shows that routing clean images to the expert is responsible for a 16.8 pp Recall(Parasitised) advantage under sensor noise relative to a cascade where the expert also sees corrupted inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MalariaCascade 两阶段推理系统：轻量 MobileNetV2"哨兵"模型在低算力下做置信分类，将不确定样本升级至仅接收干净标准化图像的 EfficientNet-B3"专家"模型，通过结构隔离而非学习鲁棒性来抵御手机传感器噪声，实现疟疾诊断的稳健性与临床安全性。
AI.motivation: 自动疟疾诊断可减轻资源匮乏实验室的负担，但高精度模型在廉价智能手机摄像头产生传感器噪声时会严重失效，亟需在低算力条件下同时保证准确性与抗噪性的方案。
AI.method: 提出两阶段级联推理：MobileNetV2 哨兵（2,225,153 参数）进行低成本置信分类，将不确定样本升级至 EfficientNet-B3 专家（10,697,769 参数），专家仅接收干净、标准化图像，与输入帧的损坏程度无关。哨兵采用安全分数目标训练，在优化精确率前对 Recall(Parasitised)≥0.95 与 Recall(Uninfected)≥0.40 设置显式下限，使检查点按构造满足临床安全约束。
AI.result: 在 NIH Malaria Cell Images 数据集（27,558 个细胞）上，干净测试集达到 Accuracy=0.9736、Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570、Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912、F1=0.9738、AUROC=0.9955。全强度高斯传感器噪声下，级联 Recall(Parasitised) 仅下降 2.4 个百分点（0.9570→0.9329），而单模型基线崩塌 63.0 个百分点（0.9584→0.3281）。McNemar 检验确认级联改进具统计显著性（chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085）。消融实验显示，将干净图像路由至专家在传感器噪声下带来 16.8 个百分点的 Recall(Parasitised) 优势。
AI.conclusion: 结构隔离（而非学习鲁棒性）是级联系统抗噪的关键机制；该设计在满足临床安全约束的同时显著优于单模型基线，为资源受限场景下的稳健疟疾诊断提供可行方案。

title: GameSmith: Scaling Zero-Sum Self-Play with Synthesised Games
summary: Post-training large language models (LLMs) on two-player zero-sum games provides a verifiable reward, and the gains have been shown to transfer to general reasoning. Existing pipelines, however, rely on a handful of hand-written games and on advantage estimators tied to them, so both the supply of games and the advantage estimate on a large corpus limit scaling. We present GameSmith, which scales both. An LLM synthesises games inside templates whose reward, observation, and hidden-information code is fixed. Each game is verified by seed-paired replay and by an independent re-implementation of its specification, then expanded into encoding, rule, and size variants, giving 26 new games in 29 families and 336 verified variants from the three SPIRAL templates. The model is distilled from the self-play of a larger teacher (Qwen3-32B) on these games and then trained by self-play reinforcement learning with CRAB, an advantage estimator that credits each decision against a shrinkage estimate of the expected return of its position and is defined on every variant. On Qwen3-4B-Base, distillation raises the 13-benchmark mean pass@1 from 45.5 to 62.5, above the three SPIRAL games at the same budget, and self-play with CRAB reaches 64.9. The ordering holds across models, and transfer grows with the number of game families.

AI.tldr: GameSmith通过LLM合成并验证新游戏、自动生成变体，并提出CRAB优势估计器，在Qwen3-4B-Base上显著提升通用推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于双人零和游戏的后训练流程依赖少量手工编写的游戏及其绑定的优势估计器，游戏供给与大规模语料上的优势估计均受限，难以扩展。
AI.method: 由LLM在奖励、观测与隐藏信息代码固定的模板内合成游戏；通过种子配对回放与独立重实现规范进行验证；再扩展为编码、规则和规模变体（从3个SPIRAL模板得29个家族共26个新游戏、336个验证变体）。先用更大大模型教师（Qwen3-32B）在这些游戏上的自对弈蒸馏，再用CRAB（按位置的期望回报收缩估计对每个决策进行信用分配，且在每个变体上均有定义）进行自对弈强化学习。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base上，蒸馏将13个基准的平均pass@1从45.5提升至62.5，超过同预算下3个SPIRAL游戏；使用CRAB自对弈达到64.9。该排序在不同模型间保持一致，且迁移能力随游戏家族数量增加而增强。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动化游戏合成与通用优势估计，可同时扩大游戏供给与训练规模，验证了双人零和游戏后训练向通用推理迁移的可扩展性。

title: TCMQA: A 38K-Question Traditional Chinese Medicine Benchmark with a Licensed-Practitioner Reference
summary: Medical benchmarks for language models are built almost entirely on Western biomedicine. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is a separate system, with its own diagnostic framework and its own literature, and it remains largely unmeasured. The few TCM evaluations that exist are small, narrow, and rarely paired with a human reference. We present TCMQA, an open benchmark of 38,279 questions from Chinese TCM licensing examinations, paired with 15,151 responses from 101 licensed practitioners. We evaluate 29 instruction-tuned models from 9 families, spanning 0.27B to 14.8B parameters. Accuracy ranges over 59 points, and no model approaches saturation. Pretraining data predicts TCM ability far better than scale: a 12B Western-pretrained model reaches 39.6%, while a Chinese-pretrained model an eighth its size reaches 60.8%. Nine models exceed the practitioner majority vote of 64.9%, the best by 21.8 points, and all nine come from that same Chinese-pretrained family. Yet difficulty does not transfer between models and practitioners: accuracy is flat across practitioner-rated difficulty, item-level agreement is near zero for all 29 models, and on $8.4\%$ of items the practitioners are correct where the leading model is wrong. We release the corpus, the practitioner responses, the harness, and per-item model outputs at https://huggingface.co/datasets/TechTCM/TCMQA.

AI.tldr: 提出TCMQA中医开放基准（38,279道中国中医执业考试题+101位持证从业者的15,151条作答），评测29个指令微调模型；发现预训练数据比模型规模更能预测中医能力，且模型与从业者的难度感知和题目级一致性近乎无关。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型医学基准几乎全部基于西方生物医学，中医作为拥有独立诊断框架与文献体系的医学系统长期缺乏评测；已有的少数中医评测规模小、范围窄，且很少配有人类参考答案。
AI.method: 构建TCMQA基准：38,279道源自中国中医执业资格考试的问题，配套101位持证从业者的15,151条作答；评测来自9个家族、参数量0.27B–14.8B的29个指令微调模型，并与从业者多数投票及逐题难度评分进行对比分析。
AI.result: 模型准确率跨度达59个百分点，无模型接近饱和；12B西方语料预训练模型仅39.6%，而规模仅其八分之一的中文预训练模型达60.8%；9个模型超过从业者多数投票64.9%（最佳高出21.8分），且全部来自同一中文预训练家族；但难度不可迁移——准确率随从业者评定难度基本持平，29个模型的项目级一致性接近零，在8.4%的题目上从业者正确而领先模型错误。
AI.conclusion: 预训练数据来源比参数量更能决定中医能力；模型尚未接近饱和，但模型与人类从业者在难度结构和逐题判断上几乎不相关。语料、从业者作答、评测框架及逐题模型输出已开源。

title: Trust and Task Completion in the World of Consumer AI Agents
summary: Action agents do things for people. They send email, spend money, and call businesses while the user is busy with something else, so a mistake can turn into an action before anyone notices. They fail their users in two ways. They break trust when they do something the user never agreed to, or hold back after the user clearly said go. And they fall short on completion when they give up on errands that turn out to be hard. Both depend heavily on the harness around the model, meaning its instructions, tools, context, and guardrails. We built an evaluation that scores trust and completion on the same runs, in a simulated world of businesses with their own websites, inboxes, and phone lines, and of people who write back. A simulated user answers the assistant's questions. Trust means that nothing happens the user did not agree to. No email goes to someone they never approved, no private detail ends up on a group thread, no money is spent past their limit, no stranger's instructions are followed, and nothing is claimed without a source. Every trap has a matched control in which acting is the right call. We use the evaluation to measure Fo, Wajo's personal assistant, against a base model with basic instructions on three foundation models, and against the Fo harness with its guardrails switched off. Fo completes 71% of the errands and keeps the user's trust on 94% of the trap runs. The base models complete 50% to 64% and keep trust on 59% to 75%. On the matched controls, Fo goes ahead slightly less often. OpenClaw, a popular open-source assistant given the same access, completes 42% of the errands it shares with Fo, against 71%, and keeps the user's trust on 74% of the shared trap runs, against 94%. Measuring trust and completion together, on the whole system rather than the model alone, is how we think action agents become safe to hand real work to.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个在模拟世界中同时评测行动型智能体"信任"与"任务完成率"的框架，并以个人助理Fo为例，验证了harness（指令、工具、上下文、护栏）对两项指标的决定性作用。
AI.motivation: 行动型智能体（如代发邮件、花钱、打电话）在用户分身乏术时替其行事，错误会在无人察觉时转化为实际行动。其失败分两类：一是违背用户意愿（未获授权就行动，或用户明确同意后反而退缩）导致信任崩塌；二是遇到困难任务就放弃，导致完成度不足。这两类失败都高度依赖模型外围的harness（指令、工具、上下文、护栏），因此需要把信任与完成度放在同一评测中整体衡量。
AI.method: 构建一个模拟评测环境：世界由拥有各自网站、收件箱和电话线的商家以及会回信的人组成，并由一个模拟用户回答助手提问。在每个"陷阱"任务中同时设置一个"匹配对照"任务——在对照中行动才是正确选择，以此区分"该动却不动"与"该止却乱动"。信任的判定标准为：不向未批准对象发邮件、不把隐私细节发到群聊、不超额花钱、不执行陌生人指令、不作无来源的断言。在此环境下将Fo（Wajo的个人助理）与"基础模型+基本指令"在三个基座模型上对比，并对比关闭护栏的Fo harness。
AI.result: Fo完成71%的任务，在94%的陷阱运行中保持用户信任；基础模型完成50%–64%，信任保持率59%–75%。在匹配对照上，Fo行动的比例略低（即更少在应行动时犹豫）。开源助手OpenClaw在相同权限下，对与Fo共有的任务完成42%（Fo为71%），在共有陷阱运行中信任保持率74%（Fo为94%）。
AI.conclusion: 应在整个系统（而非仅模型）层面同时测量信任与完成度。作者认为，这种联合评测方式是行动型智能体能够被安全交付真实工作的关键。

title: CruxBench: A Benchmark of Information Discovery
summary: Benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) typically evaluate the accuracy of answers against fixed reference labels. But a central step in many complex real-world tasks is identifying which questions are worth asking in the first place: decomposing a difficult problem into subquestions -- which we call cruxes -- whose answers provide key steps on the path toward solving the target problem. To evaluate this capability of information discovery, we introduce CruxBench, a benchmark that grades LLM-generated questions by their Value of Information (VOI): how much a model-proposed crux updates beliefs about a target forecasting question. CruxBench enjoys a rare combination of three key properties: it is (1) contamination-resistant by construction, since ground truth is generated by future world events; (2) open-ended, admitting unbounded and complex text-based submissions rather than one correct numeric answer; and (3) grounded, with informativeness measured against quantified changes in real-world beliefs. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models on 293 target forecasting questions and find that VOI correlates highly with independent measures of model capability (r=0.90) and captures cruxes' usefulness for answering target questions. However, information discovery remains challenging even for frontier LLMs, which only narrowly outperform a random-timing baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 CruxBench 基准，用信息价值（VOI）评估 LLM 生成关键子问题（crux）的能力，发现 VOI 与模型能力高度相关（r=0.90），但前沿模型仅略优于随机基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 基准多以固定参考答案的准确率来评估，无法衡量"识别哪些问题值得提问"这一复杂真实任务中的核心能力——将难题分解为关键子问题。
AI.method: 构建 CruxBench：以模型提出的 crux 对目标预测问题信念更新程度（Value of Information）作为评分标准，具备三大特性——因真值来自未来事件而天然抗污染、开放式文本提交而非唯一数值答案、以真实世界信念的量化变化为衡量依据。在 293 个目标预测问题上评测 8 个模型。
AI.result: VOI 与独立模型能力指标高度相关（r=0.90），并能反映 crux 对回答目标问题的有用性；但即使前沿 LLM 在信息发现任务上仍具挑战性，仅微弱优于随机时序基线。
AI.conclusion: 信息发现（提出有价值的关键子问题）是 LLM 尚未解决的能力短板，CruxBench 为评估该能力提供了抗污染、开放式且真实世界锚定的新范式。

title: Residual Diffusion Implicit Models
comment: 38 pages, 17 figures. Implementation available at https://github.com/joaolcguerreiro/RDIM
summary: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple tasks. However, in inverse problems, standard initialization from pure Gaussian noise misaligns the generative process with real-world degradations. More recent methods such as diffusion bridges impose strict endpoint constraints and often require long reverse processes that are prone to hallucinations. Alternative consistency models provide noise-invariant, one-step mappings but lack inherent variance modeling and can degrade under severe corruption. Hence, residual diffusion implicit models (RDIMs) are proposed, constituting a generalized framework that explicitly models the residuals between high-quality (HQ) and low-quality (LQ) images, aligning the forward process with the actual degradation. A non-Markovian implicit reverse sampler is derived, which can skip intermediate timesteps, enabling accurate few-step or even single-step reconstruction, while mitigating the hallucinations inherent to long diffusion chains. RDIM also introduces a controllable variance mechanism that interpolates between deterministic and stochastic sampling, balancing fidelity and diversity. Furthermore, it enables the straightforward use of perceptual losses, when needed. Experiments on denoising and super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that RDIMs consistently outperforms the state of the art, including bridge and consistency models, in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, reducing hallucinations while requiring only a few sampling steps (often just one). The results position RDIMs as an efficient solution for a broad range of image restoration tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差扩散隐式模型（RDIM），通过显式建模高质量与低质量图像间的残差来对齐前向退化过程，并推导非马尔可夫隐式逆向采样器，实现少步甚至单步重建，同时引入可控方差机制平衡保真度与多样性，在去噪和超分辨任务上取得SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在逆问题中从纯高斯噪声初始化，与真实退化过程不匹配；扩散桥虽引入端点约束但要求长逆向过程且易产生幻觉；一致性模型虽支持一步映射但缺乏固有方差建模，严重退化下性能下降。因此需要一种既对齐真实退化、又支持高效少步重建的框架。
AI.method: 提出残差扩散隐式模型（RDIM），显式建模高质量（HQ）与低质量（LQ）图像之间的残差，使前向过程与实际退化对齐；推导非马尔可夫隐式逆向采样器，可跳过中间时间步以支持少步甚至单步重建；引入可控方差机制，在确定性采样与随机采样之间插值以调节保真度与多样性；并支持按需使用感知损失。
AI.result: 在去噪与超分辨基准上，RDIM在PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS指标上一致优于包括扩散桥和一致性模型在内的现有SOTA方法，在减少幻觉的同时仅需少量采样步（往往仅一步）。
AI.conclusion: RDIM是面向图像复原任务的通用且高效的解决方案，兼顾了退化对齐、少步重建质量与可控的随机性建模。
